      m.floats.push({ x: p.x, y: p.y - 16, text: `+${actual}♥`, life: 22, color: "#ef4d4d" });
      m.drops.splice(i, 1);
      return;
    }

    // Compare scores using THIS player's archetype preference
    const slot = d.slot;
    const currentScore = gearScore(slot, p[slot], p.position);
    const newScore     = gearScore(slot, d.gear,   p.position);

    // Pick up if it's an upgrade for THIS player. Items always swap.
    const shouldPickUp = (slot === "item" && !p.itemUsed) ? newScore >= currentScore
                                                          : newScore > currentScore + 0.5;
    if (!shouldPickUp) continue;

    // Pick it up — replace gear, mark scavenge stat
    d.gear.scavengedCount = (d.gear.scavengedCount || 0) + 1;
    // === ROADMAP 2.4: track per-knight gear history for memorials ===
    // Record what we WERE carrying before the swap (so the memorial can
    // show the full lineage). Only record on actual changes.
    if (!p.career.gearLog) p.career.gearLog = [];
    const prev = p[slot];
    if (prev && (prev.id !== d.gear.id || prev.displayName !== d.gear.displayName)) {
      p.career.gearLog.push({
        season: LEAGUE.season,
        slot,
        from: prev.displayName || prev.name,
        to: d.gear.displayName || d.gear.name,
        scavenged: d.gear.scavengedCount,
        ico: d.gear.ico,
      });
    }
    p[slot] = d.gear;
    if (slot === "item") p.itemUsed = false;
    p.career.scavenged = (p.career.scavenged || 0) + 1;
    const legendary = d.gear.scavengedCount >= 3 ? " ⭐LEGENDARY⭐" : "";
    feed("item", `🎒 ${p.name} scavenges ${gearDisplayName(d.gear)}!${legendary}`);
    m.floats.push({ x: p.x, y: p.y - 16, text: "+gear", life: 22, color: "#4dd58a" });
    m.drops.splice(i, 1);
    return;
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   ROUND FINALIZATION
   Determines round winner (the team with at least one alive player).
   Increments round score. Checks for match end (best-of-N reached
   OR a team has no fielded players for the next round). Otherwise
   transitions to "betweenRounds" so the user can place bets / shop.
   ============================================================ */
function finalizeRound(forfeit) {
  const m = LEAGUE.match;
  if (!m) return;

  const aAlive = m.teamAplayers.filter(p => p.alive).length;
  const bAlive = m.teamBplayers.filter(p => p.alive).length;
  let roundWinnerId = null, roundLoserId = null, isDraw = false;
  if (forfeit) {
    const eligibleA = m.teamAplayers.filter(p => !p.deceased && p.lives > 0);
    const eligibleB = m.teamBplayers.filter(p => !p.deceased && p.lives > 0);
    roundWinnerId = eligibleA.length ? m.teamAId : m.teamBId;
    roundLoserId  = eligibleA.length ? m.teamBId : m.teamAId;
    feed("match", `⚐ ${TEAM_BY_ID[roundLoserId].short} cannot field a roster — ${TEAM_BY_ID[roundWinnerId].short} wins by forfeit!`);
  } else if (aAlive > bAlive) {
    roundWinnerId = m.teamAId; roundLoserId = m.teamBId;
  } else if (bAlive > aAlive) {
    roundWinnerId = m.teamBId; roundLoserId = m.teamAId;
  } else if (aAlive > 0 && bAlive > 0) {
    // Both teams have living players AND equal counts (timeout). Real draw.
    isDraw = true;
  } else {
    // Mutual wipe (0-0) — coin flip
    if (SIM_RNG.next() < 0.5) { roundWinnerId = m.teamAId; roundLoserId = m.teamBId; }
    else { roundWinnerId = m.teamBId; roundLoserId = m.teamAId; }
  }

  if (isDraw) {
    feed("match", `🤝 Round ${m.currentRoundIndex} ends in a DRAW (${aAlive}–${bAlive}, neither team wiped). No round point awarded.`);
    m.rounds.push({
      index: m.currentRoundIndex,
      winner: null,
      isDraw: true,
      aAlive, bAlive,
    });
  } else {
    if (roundWinnerId === m.teamAId) m.roundsWonA++;
    else m.roundsWonB++;

    settleRoundBets(roundWinnerId);

    m.rounds.push({
      index: m.currentRoundIndex,
      winner: roundWinnerId,
      aAlive, bAlive,
    });

    if (typeof saveLocal === "function") saveLocal();
  feed("match", `🏁 Round ${m.currentRoundIndex} won by ${TEAM_BY_ID[roundWinnerId].emoji} ${TEAM_BY_ID[roundWinnerId].short} (${m.roundsWonA}–${m.roundsWonB} match score).`);
  }

  // Check for match end. Match ends if a team hits roundsToWin OR forfeits
  // OR we've played all bestOf rounds and there's still a leader (a draw at
  // bestOf may need a sudden-death extra round).
  const matchOver =
    m.roundsWonA >= m.roundsToWin ||
    m.roundsWonB >= m.roundsToWin ||
    forfeit ||
    (m.currentRoundIndex >= m.bestOf && m.roundsWonA !== m.roundsWonB);
  if (matchOver) {
    finalizeMatch();
    return;
  }
  // If we've played all rounds and they're tied, the match itself is a draw
  if (m.currentRoundIndex >= m.bestOf && m.roundsWonA === m.roundsWonB) {
    finalizeMatch(/*matchDraw*/ true);
    return;
  }

  m.phase = "betweenRounds";
  if (typeof showRoundIntermission === "function") showRoundIntermission();
}

function continueAfterRound() {
  // Called from the round-intermission "Begin Next Round" button.
  const m = LEAGUE.match;
  if (!m) return;
  startRound();
}

/* ============================================================
   MATCH FINALIZATION
   Reached when one team wins `roundsToWin` rounds OR by forfeit.
   ============================================================ */
function finalizeMatch(matchDraw) {
  const m = LEAGUE.match;
  if (!m) return;

  m.phase = "post";

  if (matchDraw) {
    // True match-level draw — bestOf rounds played, score tied
    m.winnerId = null;
    for (const p of [...m.teamAplayers, ...m.teamBplayers]) p.career.matchesPlayed++;
    LEAGUE.records[m.teamAId].draws = (LEAGUE.records[m.teamAId].draws || 0) + 1;
    LEAGUE.records[m.teamBId].draws = (LEAGUE.records[m.teamBId].draws || 0) + 1;

    // Bracket can't have a draw advance — coin flip determines who advances
    // (the league must have a champion). Tracked separately in records.
    const advancingId = SIM_RNG.next() < 0.5 ? m.teamAId : m.teamBId;
    LEAGUE.bracket[m.slot].winner = advancingId;
    LEAGUE.bracket[m.slot].casualties = LEAGUE.graveyard
      .filter(g => g.season === LEAGUE.season && g.slot === m.slot);

    // Refund all match-level bets (no clear winner)
    settleBetsAsRefund();

    if (typeof saveLocal === "function") saveLocal();
    feed("match", `🤝 Match ends in a DRAW (${m.roundsWonA}–${m.roundsWonB}). Coin flip → ${TEAM_BY_ID[advancingId].emoji} ${TEAM_BY_ID[advancingId].short} advances.`);
    // Sportscaster — DRAW commentary
    if (typeof commentate === "function") {
      commentate("play", ccPick(COMM_MATCH_DRAW, {
        a: TEAM_BY_ID[m.teamAId].emoji + " " + TEAM_BY_ID[m.teamAId].short,
        b: TEAM_BY_ID[m.teamBId].emoji + " " + TEAM_BY_ID[m.teamBId].short,
        sa: m.roundsWonA,
        sb: m.roundsWonB,
      }), { flavor: "sad" });
    }
    if (typeof showIntermission === "function") showIntermission();
    return;
  }

  const winnerId = m.roundsWonA > m.roundsWonB ? m.teamAId : m.teamBId;
  const loserId = winnerId === m.teamAId ? m.teamBId : m.teamAId;
  m.winnerId = winnerId;

  for (const p of [...m.teamAplayers, ...m.teamBplayers]) {
    p.career.matchesPlayed++;
  }
  for (const p of (winnerId === m.teamAId ? m.teamAplayers : m.teamBplayers)) {
    if (!p.deceased) p.career.matchesWon++;
  }

  LEAGUE.records[winnerId].wins++;
  LEAGUE.records[loserId].losses++;

  LEAGUE.bracket[m.slot].winner = winnerId;
  LEAGUE.bracket[m.slot].casualties = LEAGUE.graveyard
    .filter(g => g.season === LEAGUE.season && g.slot === m.slot);

  // Scan the field for "Legendary" items that no one picked up — these
  // are LOST FOREVER. Display in the About-tab roadmap as a memorial.
  if (!LEAGUE.lostItems) LEAGUE.lostItems = [];
  for (const d of m.drops) {
    if ((d.gear.scavengedCount || 0) >= 2) {
      LEAGUE.lostItems.push({
        season: LEAGUE.season,
        slot: m.slot,
        slotType: d.slot,
        name: d.gear.displayName || d.gear.name,
        baseName: d.gear.name,
        scavengedCount: d.gear.scavengedCount,
        ico: d.gear.ico,
        lostBy: d.fromName || "the void",
      });
      feed("item", `📉 ${d.gear.displayName || d.gear.name} (${d.gear.scavengedCount}× scavenged) was LOST on the field.`);
      if (typeof window !== "undefined" && window.toast) {
        window.toast(`<b>${d.gear.displayName || d.gear.name}</b> lost on the field after ${d.gear.scavengedCount} scavenges`, "warn", { ico: "📉", ttl: 7000 });
      }
    }
  }

  // Record this match's seed + outcome for replay/audit. The seed alone is
  // enough to reproduce the match exactly (assuming the league state going
  // into it is the same).
  if (!LEAGUE.matchHistory) LEAGUE.matchHistory = [];
  LEAGUE.matchHistory.push({
    season: LEAGUE.season,
    slot: m.slot,
    seed: computeMatchSeed(LEAGUE.season, m.slot),
    teamA: m.teamAId, teamB: m.teamBId,
    winner: winnerId,
    score: `${m.roundsWonA}-${m.roundsWonB}`,
    casualties: LEAGUE.graveyard
      .filter(g => g.season === LEAGUE.season && g.slot === m.slot)
      .map(g => g.name),
  });

  settleBets(winnerId);

  if (typeof saveLocal === "function") saveLocal();
  feed("match", `🏆 ${TEAM_BY_ID[winnerId].emoji} ${TEAM_BY_ID[winnerId].name} WIN the match ${m.roundsWonA}–${m.roundsWonB}!`);

  // Sportscaster — pick dominant vs close pool by margin
  if (typeof commentate === "function") {
    const margin = Math.abs(m.roundsWonA - m.roundsWonB);
    const pool = margin >= 3 ? COMM_MATCH_WIN_DOM : COMM_MATCH_WIN_CLOSE;
    const w = TEAM_BY_ID[winnerId], l = TEAM_BY_ID[loserId];
    commentate("play", ccPick(pool, {
      w: w.emoji + " " + w.short,
      l: l.emoji + " " + l.short,
      sa: m.roundsWonA,
      sb: m.roundsWonB,
    }), { flavor: margin >= 3 ? "deadpan" : "hype",
        aiContext: { type: "matchEnd", winner: w, loser: l, score: [m.roundsWonA, m.roundsWonB] } });
  }

  if (typeof showIntermission === "function") showIntermission();
}

// Refund all match-scoped bets (used on draws — no winner exists)
function settleBetsAsRefund() {
  const m = LEAGUE.match;
  if (!m) return;
  const remaining = [];
  for (const bet of LEAGUE.bets) {
    if (bet.slot !== m.slot) { remaining.push(bet); continue; }
    LEAGUE.bits += bet.amount;
    if (typeof window !== "undefined" && window.toast)
      window.toast(`Match drew — bet refunded: <b>+${bet.amount}</b> bits`, "warn");
  }
  LEAGUE.bets = remaining;
}

function continueAfterMatch() {
  // Called from the intermission "Continue" button.
  const wasFinal = LEAGUE.currentSlot === "final";
  advanceBracket();

  if (wasFinal || !LEAGUE.currentSlot) {
    // Season complete
    finalizeSeason();
    return;
  }

  // Reap deceased and build the next match.
  // v28.16: backfillRosters runs structural-integrity check first; startMatch
  // also runs it, but doing it here provides the user-facing call-up feed
  // before the new match's matchup label appears.
  const { callups, reaped } = backfillRosters();
  for (const c of callups) {
    const team = TEAM_BY_ID[c.team];
    const posLabel = POS_BY_ID[c.rookie.position]?.label || c.rookie.position;
    feed("spawn", `📣 Rookie call-up: ${c.rookie.name} (${posLabel}) joins ${team.name}.`);
  }
  if (reaped.length) {
    feed("spawn", `📋 ${reaped.length} duplicate-position knight${reaped.length === 1 ? "" : "s"} reassigned to the graveyard.`);
  }
  LEAGUE.match = null;
  startMatch();
}

/* ============================================================
   SEASON FINALIZATION
   - Champion crowned
   - History recorded
   - All deceased reaped, rookies called up
   - New bracket built for next season
   ============================================================ */
function finalizeSeason() {
  const finalSlot = LEAGUE.bracket.final || {};
  const champion = finalSlot.winner;
  const runnerup = champion === finalSlot.teamA ? finalSlot.teamB : finalSlot.teamA;
  if (champion) {
    LEAGUE.records[champion].championships++;
    feed("season",
      `🏆 SEASON ${LEAGUE.season} CHAMPION: ${TEAM_BY_ID[champion].emoji} ${TEAM_BY_ID[champion].name}!`);
  }

  const seasonCasualties = LEAGUE.graveyard.filter(g => g.season === LEAGUE.season);
  // Save bracket results for season history (all slots)
  const bracketResults = {};
  for (const slot of (LEAGUE.bracket._order || [])) {
    bracketResults[slot] = LEAGUE.bracket[slot]?.winner || null;
  }
  LEAGUE.history.push({
    season: LEAGUE.season,
    champion, runnerup,
    bracketResults,
    casualties: seasonCasualties.length,
  });

  // === ROADMAP 2.6: Snapshot the current ladder for next-season delta ===
  // computeLadderRanking is defined in render-side; we replicate the
  // formula here so the snapshot is sim-side and survives saves.
  if (typeof computeLadderRanking === "function") {
    const ladder = computeLadderRanking();
    LEAGUE.previousLadder = {};
    for (const entry of ladder) {
      LEAGUE.previousLadder[entry.team.id] = entry.rank;
    }
  }

  if (typeof showSeasonEnd === "function") showSeasonEnd(champion, runnerup, seasonCasualties.length);
}

function beginNextSeason() {
  // Reap, replace, and ensure structural integrity.
  // v28.16: backfillRosters covers everything reapDeceased did, plus
  // missing-position / duplicate-position / oversized-roster recovery.
  const { callups, reaped } = backfillRosters();
  for (const p of Object.values(LEAGUE.rosters).flat()) {
    p.career.seasonsPlayed++;
  }
  if (callups.length) {
    feed("season", `📣 Off-season call-ups: ${callups.length} rookies join the league.`);
  }
  if (reaped.length) {
    feed("season", `📋 Off-season reorganization: ${reaped.length} duplicate-position knights reassigned.`);
  }
  LEAGUE.season++;
  LEAGUE.match = null;
  // === v28.16: roll fresh AI-style assignments for the new season ===
  // The Coaches' Caucus convenes between seasons and re-assigns playbooks.
  // We roll BEFORE buildBracket so any UI rendering at the start of the new
  // season reflects the new style assignments.
  if (typeof rollSeasonAiStyles === "function") {
    rollSeasonAiStyles();
    if (typeof feed === "function" && LEAGUE.aiStyles) {
      // Show a short feed line per "notable" style assignment (only the
      // distinctive ones — balanced + 5-most-common would spam).
      const distinctive = ["berserker", "stoic", "anarchist", "frenzy", "doctrine", "wolfpack", "sniperstack", "holdout", "glasscannon"];
      let count = 0;
      for (const teamId of Object.keys(LEAGUE.aiStyles)) {
        if (count >= 4) break;
        const styleId = LEAGUE.aiStyles[teamId];
        if (!distinctive.includes(styleId)) continue;
        const team = TEAM_BY_ID[teamId];
        const style = AI_PATHING_STYLES[styleId];
        if (!team || !style) continue;
        feed("season", `📋 ${team.short} adopts <em>${style.label}</em> for Year ${27 + LEAGUE.season}.`);
        count++;
      }
    }
  }
  buildBracket();
  startMatch();
}

/* ============================================================
   BETTING — both team-level and per-player (last-standing)
   Odds are computed from rough roster strength.
   ============================================================ */
function teamStrength(teamId) {
  // If a match is in progress AND this team is one of the two participants,
  // use LIVE state — current lives, current HP, gear-modified stats. This
  // makes round-bet odds shift between rounds based on actual position.
  // Outside a match (or for non-participating teams), use roster baseline.
  const m = LEAGUE.match;
  const inMatch = m && m.phase !== "post" && (teamId === m.teamAId || teamId === m.teamBId);

  if (inMatch) {
    const players = teamId === m.teamAId ? m.teamAplayers : m.teamBplayers;
    let s = 0;
    for (const p of players) {
      if (p.deceased) continue;
      const livesLeft = Math.max(0, p.lives || 0);
      // A knight with 0 lives contributes nothing; one with full lives contributes
      // their gear-modified stats; one with partial HP contributes proportionally.
      if (livesLeft === 0) continue;
      const hpFrac = p.alive ? clamp(p.hp / p.stats.hp, 0.1, 1) : 0.5;
      const wDmg = p.stats.dmg + (p.weapon?.dmgMod || 0);
      const wDef = p.stats.def + (p.armor?.defMod || 0) + (p.weapon?.defMod || 0);
      const wSpd = p.stats.spd + (p.armor?.spdMod || 0);
      // Lives multiplier: 1.0 / 0.85 / 0.7 / 0.55 ... so a 3-lives knight is
      // worth meaningfully more than a 1-life knight even at full HP.
      const livesMult = 0.55 + 0.15 * livesLeft;
      s += (p.stats.hp * hpFrac + wDmg * 4 + wDef + wSpd * 8) * livesMult;
    }
    return Math.max(1, s);
  }

  const r = (LEAGUE.rosters[teamId] || []).filter(p => !p.deceased);
  let s = 0;
  for (const p of r) {
    s += p.stats.hp + p.stats.dmg * 4 + p.stats.def + p.stats.spd * 8;
  }
  return Math.max(1, s);
}

function teamOdds(teamA, teamB) {
  const sA = teamStrength(teamA), sB = teamStrength(teamB);
  const total = sA + sB;
  const probA = sA / total, probB = sB / total;
  // Convert to payout multiplier (with a small house edge of 5%)
  const margin = 0.95;
  return {
    [teamA]: +(margin / probA).toFixed(2),
    [teamB]: +(margin / probB).toFixed(2),
  };
}

/* ============================================================
   LIVE MATCH ODDS (ROADMAP 2.5)

   Static teamOdds() above is computed at match start from team
   strength only. During a live match, the odds should update as
   rounds resolve and knights die — a team down 0-2 with 2 dead
   knights is genuinely longer odds than they were at coin flip.

   liveMatchOdds(m) takes the active match snapshot and returns
   updated payout multipliers reflecting:
     - Round score (each round won is meaningful progress toward
       best-of-N — this is the dominant signal)
     - Remaining lives across the active roster
     - Total remaining HP fraction
     - Original team strength (still matters if both teams are even)

   The returned object has the same shape as teamOdds() so the bet
   UI doesn't need to special-case it.
   ============================================================ */
function liveMatchOdds(m) {
  if (!m) return null;
  const teamA = m.teamAId, teamB = m.teamBId;
  // === Component 1: Round score ===
  // Best-of-5 means 3 wins to take the match. A team at 2-0 has won
  // ~80% of equivalent matches (extrapolation). A team at 2-1 is ~67%.
  const sA = m.roundsWonA || 0;
  const sB = m.roundsWonB || 0;
  const winsNeeded = Math.ceil((m.bestOf || 5) / 2);  // 3 for bestOf 5
  const remA = winsNeeded - sA, remB = winsNeeded - sB;
  // If a team has already won enough, return certain odds
  if (remA <= 0) return { [teamA]: 1.01, [teamB]: 99 };
  if (remB <= 0) return { [teamA]: 99, [teamB]: 1.01 };
  // Naive Markov chain for remaining rounds: assume per-round 50/50
  // (we'll mix in strength next). Probability of winning the match
  // given (remA, remB) rounds-needed: p = sum of negative binomial.
  function winProb(needA, needB) {
    // p(A wins match) given needA, needB rounds remaining each.
    // Each round: 50% A wins (will tune below).
    // Closed form: P = sum_{k=0..needB-1} C(needA-1+k, k) * 0.5^(needA+k)
    let p = 0;
    let comb = 1;  // C(needA-1, 0)
    for (let k = 0; k < needB; k++) {
      p += comb * Math.pow(0.5, needA + k);
      comb = comb * (needA - 1 + k + 1) / (k + 1);  // C(needA-1+k+1, k+1)
    }
    return p;
  }
  let pAroundsOnly = winProb(remA, remB);

  // === Component 2: Original team strength (mix in) ===
  // If team strengths differ, shift the per-round 50/50 baseline.
  const strA = teamStrength(teamA), strB = teamStrength(teamB);
  const strFrac = strA / (strA + strB);  // 0.5 = even, > 0.5 favors A
  // Re-run winProb with the strength-shifted per-round prob.
  // (Approximate: for asymmetric per-round prob, we rebuild winProb.)
  function winProbShifted(needA, needB, pA) {
    const pB = 1 - pA;
    let p = 0;
    let comb = 1;
    for (let k = 0; k < needB; k++) {
      p += comb * Math.pow(pA, needA) * Math.pow(pB, k);
      comb = comb * (needA - 1 + k + 1) / (k + 1);
    }
    return p;
  }
  pAroundsOnly = winProbShifted(remA, remB, strFrac);

  // === Component 3: Remaining-lives shift ===
  // If a team has fewer surviving knights, their per-round prob drops.
  // We re-do the calculation with per-round prob = strFrac shifted by
  // the lives delta. ~3% per missing knight is a moderate signal.
  let liveA = 5, liveB = 5;
  if (m.teamAplayers) liveA = m.teamAplayers.filter(p => p.alive || p.lives > 0).length;
  if (m.teamBplayers) liveB = m.teamBplayers.filter(p => p.alive || p.lives > 0).length;
  const livesDelta = (liveA - liveB) * 0.03;
  const adjustedPA = clamp(strFrac + livesDelta, 0.02, 0.98);

  let pA = winProbShifted(remA, remB, adjustedPA);
  pA = clamp(pA, 0.01, 0.99);
  const pB = 1 - pA;

  const margin = 0.95;
  return {
    [teamA]: +(margin / pA).toFixed(2),
    [teamB]: +(margin / pB).toFixed(2),
  };
}
window.liveMatchOdds = liveMatchOdds;

function playerOdds(teamA, teamB) {
  // Probability of "last standing" (or last-killed) for each player.
  // Crude: stat strength relative to the entire match pool, weighted toward survivors.
  const all = [
    ...(LEAGUE.rosters[teamA] || []).filter(p => !p.deceased),
    ...(LEAGUE.rosters[teamB] || []).filter(p => !p.deceased),
  ];
  const strengths = all.map(p =>
    p.stats.hp / 100 + p.stats.dmg / 8 + p.stats.def / 20 + p.stats.spd / 1.5);
  const total = strengths.reduce((a,b)=>a+b, 0);
  const odds = {};
  for (let i = 0; i < all.length; i++) {
    const prob = strengths[i] / total;
    odds[all[i].id] = +(0.85 / Math.max(0.01, prob)).toFixed(2);
  }
  return odds;
}

function placeBet(kind, target, amount) {
  // kind: "team"      → target is teamId, resolves at MATCH end
  //       "round"     → target is teamId, resolves at end of NEXT round
  //       "player"    → target is playerId, resolves at MATCH end
  //       "firstkill" → target is teamId, resolves on first kill of the match
  //       "totalcas"  → target is "over"/"under", resolves at MATCH end (5.5 line)
  //       "rounds"    → target is "over"/"under", resolves at MATCH end (3.5 line)

  // === v28.5: Lock betting during live matches ===
  // Previously allowed bets at any time including mid-match, which lets
  // a viewer wait until the outcome is visually obvious (~10s in, when
  // one team has clearly broken serve) and then place a "guaranteed"
  // wager. Now bets are only accepted before the round starts (preRound),
  // between rounds (betweenRounds), after the match concludes (post),
  // or before any match has begun for the slot.
  //
  // "round" bets DO get a per-round window (between rounds) — so you
  // can bet on the next round's winner during intermissions but not
  // while the round is being fought.
  const liveMatch = LEAGUE.match;
  if (liveMatch && liveMatch.phase === "round") {
    feed("item", "🔒 Betting locked — wait for the round to end.");
    return false;
  }

  if (amount <= 0 || amount > LEAGUE.bits) return false;
  if (!LEAGUE.currentSlot) return false;
  const slotData = LEAGUE.bracket[LEAGUE.currentSlot];
  if (!slotData || !slotData.teamA || !slotData.teamB) return false;

  let payoutMult = 1;
  if (kind === "team" || kind === "round") {
    const o = teamOdds(slotData.teamA, slotData.teamB);
    payoutMult = o[target] || 0;
    if (!payoutMult) return false;
    if (kind === "round") payoutMult = +(payoutMult * 0.85).toFixed(2);
  } else if (kind === "player") {
    const o = playerOdds(slotData.teamA, slotData.teamB);
    payoutMult = o[target] || 0;
    if (!payoutMult) return false;
  } else if (kind === "firstkill") {
    // Lock the market once the first kill of the match has been scored.
    // The UI already hides the section, but the backend must enforce too.
    const m = LEAGUE.match;
    if (m && m.firstKillTeam) return false;
    // Both teams roughly equal probability — payouts mirror match odds × 0.95
    const o = teamOdds(slotData.teamA, slotData.teamB);
    payoutMult = +((o[target] || 1.9) * 0.95).toFixed(2);
    if (!payoutMult) return false;
  } else if (kind === "totalcas") {
    // Over/under 5.5 casualties this match. Roughly even-money bet.
    if (target !== "over" && target !== "under") return false;
    payoutMult = 1.85;
  } else if (kind === "rounds") {
    // Over/under 3.5 rounds played in the match. Most matches are 3-0 sweeps;
    // "over" is moderately less likely so it pays slightly more.
    if (target !== "over" && target !== "under") return false;
    payoutMult = target === "over" ? 2.10 : 1.65;
  } else return false;

  LEAGUE.bits -= amount;
  const m = LEAGUE.match;
  const roundIndex = (kind === "round" && m) ? (m.currentRoundIndex + (m.phase === "betweenRounds" || m.phase === "preRound" ? 1 : 0)) : null;
  LEAGUE.bets.push({ kind, target, amount, payoutMult, slot: LEAGUE.currentSlot, roundIndex });
  if (typeof saveLocal === "function") saveLocal();
  const labelMap = {
    team: "match winner", round: "round winner", player: "last standing",
    firstkill: "first kill", totalcas: "total casualties", rounds: "rounds played",
  };
  feed("item", `💰 Bet placed: ${amount} bits on ${labelMap[kind] || kind} = ${target} @ ${payoutMult}×`);
  return true;
}

// Resolves "round winner" bets after each round.
function settleRoundBets(roundWinnerTeamId) {
  const m = LEAGUE.match;
  if (!m) return;
  const remaining = [];
  for (const bet of LEAGUE.bets) {
    if (bet.kind !== "round" || bet.slot !== m.slot) {
      remaining.push(bet);
      continue;
    }
    if (bet.roundIndex !== m.currentRoundIndex) {
      remaining.push(bet);
      continue;
    }
    const tName = TEAM_BY_ID[bet.target]?.short || "?";
    if (bet.target === roundWinnerTeamId) {
      const payout = Math.round(bet.amount * bet.payoutMult);
      LEAGUE.bits += payout;
      feed("item", `💸 Round bet won! +${payout} bits (round ${m.currentRoundIndex})`);
      if (typeof window !== "undefined" && window.toast)
        window.toast(`Round ${m.currentRoundIndex} bet WON: <b>+${payout}</b> bits on ${tName}`, "win");
    } else {
      feed("item", `💔 Round bet lost: ${bet.amount} bits.`);
      if (typeof window !== "undefined" && window.toast)
        window.toast(`Round ${m.currentRoundIndex} bet lost: <b>-${bet.amount}</b> bits on ${tName}`, "lose");
    }
  }
  LEAGUE.bets = remaining;
  if (typeof saveLocal === "function") saveLocal();
}

// Resolves match-level bets ("team" + "player") after a match concludes.
function settleBets(winnerTeamId) {
  const m = LEAGUE.match;
  if (!m) return;
  const lastStanding = (() => {
    const all = [...m.teamAplayers, ...m.teamBplayers]
      .filter(p => !p.deceased && p.lives > 0);
    if (!all.length) return null;
    all.sort((a,b) => (b.lives - a.lives) || (b.career.kills - a.career.kills));
    return all[0];
  })();

  const remaining = [];
  for (const bet of LEAGUE.bets) {
    if (bet.slot !== m.slot) {
      remaining.push(bet);
      continue;
    }
    if (bet.kind === "round") {
      LEAGUE.bits += bet.amount;
      feed("item", `↩️ Unsettled round bet refunded: ${bet.amount} bits.`);
      if (typeof window !== "undefined" && window.toast)
        window.toast(`Round bet refunded: <b>+${bet.amount}</b> bits (match ended early)`, "warn");
      continue;
    }
    let win = false;
    let label = "";
    if (bet.kind === "team") {
      label = TEAM_BY_ID[bet.target]?.short || "?";
      if (bet.target === winnerTeamId) win = true;
    }
    if (bet.kind === "player") {
      const p = Object.values(LEAGUE.rosters).flat().find(x => x.id === bet.target);
      label = p ? p.name : "?";
      if (lastStanding && bet.target === lastStanding.id) win = true;
    }
    if (bet.kind === "firstkill") {
      label = (TEAM_BY_ID[bet.target]?.short || "?") + " first kill";
      if (m.firstKillTeam && bet.target === m.firstKillTeam) win = true;
    }
    if (bet.kind === "totalcas") {
      // Casualty count = unique deceased knights this match
      const matchDeaths = LEAGUE.graveyard.filter(g => g.season === LEAGUE.season && g.slot === m.slot).length;
      const line = 5.5;
      label = bet.target === "over" ? `over ${line} deaths` : `under ${line} deaths`;
      if ((bet.target === "over" && matchDeaths > line) || (bet.target === "under" && matchDeaths < line)) win = true;
    }
    if (bet.kind === "rounds") {
      const totalRounds = m.rounds.length;
      const line = 3.5;
      label = bet.target === "over" ? `over ${line} rounds` : `under ${line} rounds`;
      if ((bet.target === "over" && totalRounds > line) || (bet.target === "under" && totalRounds < line)) win = true;
    }
    if (win) {
      const payout = Math.round(bet.amount * bet.payoutMult);
      LEAGUE.bits += payout;
      feed("item", `💸 Bet won! +${payout} bits (${bet.kind})`);
      if (typeof window !== "undefined" && window.toast)
        window.toast(`Match bet WON: <b>+${payout}</b> bits on ${label}`, "win");
    } else {
      feed("item", `💔 Bet lost: ${bet.amount} bits on ${bet.kind}.`);
      if (typeof window !== "undefined" && window.toast)
        window.toast(`Match bet lost: <b>-${bet.amount}</b> bits on ${label}`, "lose");
    }
  }
  LEAGUE.bets = remaining;

  // Always award some bits for watching
  const watchReward = 5 + RI(0, 5);
  LEAGUE.bits += watchReward;
  feed("item", `🪙 +${watchReward} bits (broadcast tip)`);
  if (typeof saveLocal === "function") saveLocal();
}

/* ============================================================
   SHOP
   ============================================================ */
function buyItem(itemId, teamId) {
  const item = SHOP_BY_ID[itemId];
  if (!item) return false;
  if (LEAGUE.bits < item.cost) return false;
  if (LEAGUE.match && LEAGUE.match.phase === "round") return false; // can't buy during a live round
  // Specific-player targeted items must use buyTargetedItem instead.
  if (item.target === "specific_player") return false;

  // Saboteur targets the OPPONENT in the next active match
  let appliedToTeam = teamId;
  if (item.target === "opp") {
    if (!LEAGUE.currentSlot) return false;
    const m = LEAGUE.bracket[LEAGUE.currentSlot];
    appliedToTeam = (teamId === m.teamA) ? m.teamB : m.teamA;
  }

  const boost = LEAGUE.pendingBoosts[appliedToTeam] || (LEAGUE.pendingBoosts[appliedToTeam] = {});
  item.apply(boost);
  LEAGUE.bits -= item.cost;
  feed("item", `🛒 Purchased ${item.nm} for ${TEAM_BY_ID[appliedToTeam].name}.`);
  if (typeof saveLocal === "function") saveLocal();
  return true;
}

/* === v28.1: Targeted shop items (e.g. Personal Sandbag) ===
   These need a specific knight as target. Caller provides both itemId
   and the knight ID; we look up the knight, charge the cost, and store
   the boost in pendingTargetedBoosts under the knight's team. */
function buyTargetedItem(itemId, knightId) {
  const item = SHOP_BY_ID[itemId];
  if (!item) return false;
  if (item.target !== "specific_player") return false;
  if (LEAGUE.bits < item.cost) return false;
  if (LEAGUE.match && LEAGUE.match.phase === "round") return false;
  // Find the knight + their team
  let knight = null, knightTeamId = null;
  for (const tid in LEAGUE.rosters) {
    const found = LEAGUE.rosters[tid].find(p => p.id === knightId);
    if (found) { knight = found; knightTeamId = tid; break; }
  }
  if (!knight || knight.deceased) return false;
  // Initialize pending targeted boost for this knight
  if (!LEAGUE.pendingTargetedBoosts) LEAGUE.pendingTargetedBoosts = {};
  if (!LEAGUE.pendingTargetedBoosts[knightTeamId]) LEAGUE.pendingTargetedBoosts[knightTeamId] = {};
  const slot = LEAGUE.pendingTargetedBoosts[knightTeamId][knight.id]
            || (LEAGUE.pendingTargetedBoosts[knightTeamId][knight.id] = {});
  item.apply(slot);
  LEAGUE.bits -= item.cost;
  feed("item", `⚓ Personal sandbag placed on ${knight.name} (${TEAM_BY_ID[knightTeamId].short}).`);
  if (typeof saveLocal === "function") saveLocal();
  return true;
}
window.buyTargetedItem = buyTargetedItem;

</script>

<!-- ============================================================
     UI — Part A
     Canvas pixel-art renderer + DOM render functions
     ============================================================ -->
<script>
'use strict';

/* ============================================================
   ELEMENT REFS
   ============================================================ */
const $ = (sel) => document.querySelector(sel);
const $$ = (sel) => Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(sel));
const arenaCanvas = $("#arena");

// Camera shake — set by triggerShake(magnitude); decays each frame.
// Drawn as a CSS transform on the canvas wrapper so it doesn't fight
// the canvas's own coordinate system.
let _shakeAmp = 0;
function triggerShake(amp) {
  // Settings toggle — skip if user has disabled camera shake
  if (typeof LEAGUE_CONFIG !== "undefined" && LEAGUE_CONFIG.disableShake) return;
  _shakeAmp = Math.max(_shakeAmp, amp);
}
function applyShake() {
  if (typeof document === "undefined") return;
  // v28.24: in broadcast view, the canvas was re-parented OUT of arena-wrap
  // and into the broadcast overlay. Shaking arena-wrap is invisible in that
  // mode (it has no canvas inside). Shake the canvas itself so the shake
  // is visible in either mode. We deliberately don't shake the overlay
  // because that would also shake the scorebug, ticker, and exit button.
  const target = (window._broadcastState && document.getElementById)
    ? (document.getElementById("arena") || document.querySelector(".arena-wrap"))
    : document.querySelector(".arena-wrap");
  if (!target) return;
  if (_shakeAmp <= 0.05) {
    target.style.transform = "";
    // v28.24: also clear the OTHER possible target so a residual shake
    // doesn't persist when the user toggles broadcast view between
    // shake events.
    const other = (target.id === "arena")
      ? document.querySelector(".arena-wrap")
      : document.getElementById("arena");
    if (other) other.style.transform = "";
    _shakeAmp = 0;
    return;
  }
  const t = (typeof performance !== "undefined" ? performance.now() : Date.now());
  // Smooth high-frequency jitter
  const dx = Math.sin(t * 0.07) * _shakeAmp;
  const dy = Math.cos(t * 0.09) * _shakeAmp * 0.7;
  target.style.transform = `translate(${dx.toFixed(2)}px, ${dy.toFixed(2)}px)`;
  _shakeAmp *= 0.78; // exponential decay
}
/* `ctx` is the global drawing context — bound to the main arena canvas
   by default. It's declared with `let` (not `const`) so the biome-preview
   helper can temporarily redirect drawing to a thumbnail canvas, run the
   existing scatter+court rendering routines (which all reference this
   global), and then restore it. The redirect happens synchronously
   within drawBiomePreview() so no other render call can interleave. */
let ctx = arenaCanvas.getContext("2d");
ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;

/* ============================================================
   CAMERA — broadcast tracking shot.

   The arena is a fixed logical 960x540 box; the canvas is the
   render surface. When TV mode is on, we apply a virtual camera
   that frames the action like an NFL/NBA tracking shot — pans
   and zooms so the active players and objectives stay in view
   while padding is dropped from empty parts of the field.

   Each frame:
     1. Compute the AABB of all alive players + objectives
        (drops, power-core, crown, flag, bases) with margin
     2. Translate that AABB into a desired camera (cx, cy, zoom)
     3. Smoothly lerp the live camera toward the target
     4. drawArena applies translate+scale before drawing world
        contents, then restores

   World-space drawing happens *inside* the camera transform.
   HUD/overlays (TV scoreboard, kill feed, vignette) draw
   *outside* it so they stay viewport-locked.
   ============================================================ */
const CAMERA = {
  x: 640,        // current center X in world coords (arenaW=1280 / 2)
  y: 360,        // current center Y in world coords (arenaH=720 / 2)
  zoom: 1.0,     // current zoom (1 = fit field exactly)
  targetX: 640,
  targetY: 360,
  targetZoom: 1.0,
  enabled: false,  // toggled by TV mode + opt-in setting
  // Tunables — v28.13: re-tuned for less aggressive zoom + smoother motion
  // per user feedback ("zoom too aggressive, user never sees the stadium;
  // camera snap too jerky"). The dynamic camera is now cinematic, not
  // nauseating: it tracks the action subtly and prefers wide framing.
  PAD_TV: 90,     // padding around tracked AABB in TV mode
  PAD_NORMAL: 200, // (was 80) much more padding so small alive-player
                   // clusters don't make the AABB tiny → camera no longer
                   // tightens on a 2-player engagement
  MIN_ZOOM: 0.78, // (was 0.85) — allow pulling back further to show
                  // stadium edges when action spreads to corners
  MAX_ZOOM: 1.10, // (was 1.6) — barely zoom in past fit-the-field. The
                  // stadium stays visible at all times. Cinematic, not
                  // claustrophobic.
  LERP: 0.04,     // (was 0.07) per-frame movement toward target — slower
                  // glide eliminates the "snap" feel
  ZOOM_LERP: 0.025, // (was 0.05) zoom changes are now barely perceptible
                    // frame-to-frame; total zoom transitions still complete
                    // in well under a second of real time
};

/* Compute the desired camera target from the current match state.
   Considers: alive players + projectiles' targets + drops + objectives. */
function _computeCameraTarget(m) {
  const W = COMBAT.arenaW || 1280, H = COMBAT.arenaH || 720;
  if (!m) return { cx: W/2, cy: H/2, zoom: 1.0 };

  const pad = CAMERA.PAD_NORMAL;

  let minX = Infinity, minY = Infinity, maxX = -Infinity, maxY = -Infinity;
  let count = 0;

  // Alive players
  const all = [...(m.teamAplayers || []), ...(m.teamBplayers || [])];
  for (const p of all) {
    if (!p.alive) continue;
    if (p.x < minX) minX = p.x;
    if (p.y < minY) minY = p.y;
    if (p.x > maxX) maxX = p.x;
    if (p.y > maxY) maxY = p.y;
    count++;
  }

  // Mode objectives — crown, flag, bases — when present
  if (m.crown) {
    if (m.crown.x < minX) minX = m.crown.x;
    if (m.crown.y < minY) minY = m.crown.y;
    if (m.crown.x > maxX) maxX = m.crown.x;
    if (m.crown.y > maxY) maxY = m.crown.y;
    count++;
  }
  if (m.flag) {
    if (m.flag.x < minX) minX = m.flag.x;
    if (m.flag.y < minY) minY = m.flag.y;
    if (m.flag.x > maxX) maxX = m.flag.x;
    if (m.flag.y > maxY) maxY = m.flag.y;
    count++;
  }

  // Power core (deathmatch focal point)
  if (m.powerCore && m.powerCore.state === "active") {
    if (m.powerCore.x < minX) minX = m.powerCore.x;
    if (m.powerCore.y < minY) minY = m.powerCore.y;
    if (m.powerCore.x > maxX) maxX = m.powerCore.x;
    if (m.powerCore.y > maxY) maxY = m.powerCore.y;
    count++;
  }

  // Dropped items — only consider drops within reach of any alive player
  // so the camera doesn't over-fit on stale far-corner drops
  if (m.drops && count > 0) {
    for (const d of m.drops) {
      // Is any alive player within 200px of this drop?
      let near = false;
      for (const p of all) {
        if (!p.alive) continue;
        const dx = p.x - d.x, dy = p.y - d.y;
        if (dx*dx + dy*dy < 200*200) { near = true; break; }
      }
      if (near) {
        if (d.x < minX) minX = d.x;
        if (d.y < minY) minY = d.y;
        if (d.x > maxX) maxX = d.x;
        if (d.y > maxY) maxY = d.y;
      }
    }
  }

  // Empty match (between rounds) — frame the whole field PLUS the
  // surrounding crowd band so the inter-round shot shows the stadium,
  // not just the empty pitch. zoom 0.92 × canvasFillScale (1.5 in
  // fullscreen) = finalScale 1.38, which makes the visible world
  // ~1391×783 — wider than the 1280×720 world by exactly the
  // CROWD_DEPTH (32) on each side. center-clamp logic below detects
  // halfW_world > W/2 and snaps cx to W/2, so the world stays
  // perfectly centered with crowd visible on all four edges.
  if (count === 0) {
    return { cx: W/2, cy: H/2, zoom: 0.92 };
  }

  // Pad the AABB
  minX = Math.max(0, minX - pad);
  minY = Math.max(0, minY - pad);
  maxX = Math.min(W, maxX + pad);
  maxY = Math.min(H, maxY + pad);

  const bw = maxX - minX;
  const bh = maxY - minY;
  let cx = (minX + maxX) / 2;
  let cy = (minY + maxY) / 2;

  // Zoom = how much we'd need to scale to fill the canvas with this AABB.
  // Take the smaller axis to ensure the entire AABB fits.
  const zx = W / Math.max(1, bw);
  const zy = H / Math.max(1, bh);
  let zoom = Math.min(zx, zy);
  zoom = clamp(zoom, CAMERA.MIN_ZOOM, CAMERA.MAX_ZOOM);

  // === v28.4 fix #1: enforce minimum zoom such that the world fills
  // the canvas in TV mode. The render path multiplies CAMERA.zoom by
  // canvasFillScale = max(canvasW/worldW, canvasH/worldH). For the
  // world to actually FILL the canvas (no black bars from undershoot),
  // we need finalScale = CAMERA.zoom * canvasFillScale ≥ 1.0 in canvas
  // pixel terms — i.e. CAMERA.zoom must be ≥ 1.0 / canvasFillScale.
  //
  // Read canvas dims through arenaCanvas (lives at module scope). In
  // non-TV mode the canvas matches the world, canvasFillScale = 1.0,
  // and this floor evaluates to 1.0 — equal to the world-fits-canvas
  // baseline, so behavior is unchanged. ===
  if (typeof arenaCanvas !== "undefined" && arenaCanvas) {
    const cW = arenaCanvas.width || W;
    const cH = arenaCanvas.height || H;
    // Match the FILL/FIT logic used in _applyCameraTransform so the
    // floor matches what's actually used at draw time. (See v28.7
    // portrait-mismatch comment in _applyCameraTransform.)
    const canvasAspect = cW / cH;
    const worldAspect = W / H;
    const isPortraitMismatch = canvasAspect < worldAspect * 0.85;
    const canvasFillScale = isPortraitMismatch
      ? Math.min(cW / W, cH / H)
      : Math.max(cW / W, cH / H);
    if (canvasFillScale > 0) {
      const minZoomForFill = 1.0 / canvasFillScale;
      if (zoom < minZoomForFill) zoom = minZoomForFill;
    }
  }

  // === v28.4 fix #2: clamp camera center so the visible viewport
  // doesn't extend past the world bounds. Otherwise when a bot is near
  // a field edge, the camera centers on them and the off-field side of
  // the canvas shows black void.
  //
  // Visible viewport in world coords (after canvas-fill scaling):
  //   halfW_world = (canvasW / 2) / (zoom * canvasFillScale)
  //   halfH_world = (canvasH / 2) / (zoom * canvasFillScale)
  // For the camera not to show outside the world:
  //   halfW_world ≤ cx ≤ W - halfW_world
  //   halfH_world ≤ cy ≤ H - halfH_world
  //
  // If the visible half-extent exceeds half the world (which can happen
  // if MIN_ZOOM forces zoom small enough that the world is smaller than
  // the canvas in world units), we just center on the world midpoint. ===
  if (typeof arenaCanvas !== "undefined" && arenaCanvas) {
    const cW = arenaCanvas.width || W;
    const cH = arenaCanvas.height || H;
    const canvasAspect = cW / cH;
    const worldAspect = W / H;
    const isPortraitMismatch = canvasAspect < worldAspect * 0.85;
    const canvasFillScale = isPortraitMismatch
      ? Math.min(cW / W, cH / H)
      : Math.max(cW / W, cH / H);
    const finalScale = zoom * canvasFillScale;
    const halfW_world = (cW / 2) / finalScale;
    const halfH_world = (cH / 2) / finalScale;
    if (halfW_world * 2 >= W) {
      cx = W / 2;
    } else {
      cx = clamp(cx, halfW_world, W - halfW_world);
    }
    if (halfH_world * 2 >= H) {
      cy = H / 2;
    } else {
      cy = clamp(cy, halfH_world, H - halfH_world);
    }
  }

  return { cx, cy, zoom };
}

/* Update camera target + lerp current toward it. Called once per
   frame from drawArena before any world-space drawing. */
function _updateCamera(m) {
  // Camera is always enabled (subtle pan even in standard mode), but uses
  // tighter framing in TV mode for a more cinematic broadcast feel.
  CAMERA.enabled = true;

  const tgt = _computeCameraTarget(m);
  CAMERA.targetX = tgt.cx;
  CAMERA.targetY = tgt.cy;
  CAMERA.targetZoom = tgt.zoom;

  // Smooth lerp — separate factors for position and zoom so zoom
  // changes don't cause motion sickness.
  CAMERA.x = CAMERA.x + (CAMERA.targetX - CAMERA.x) * CAMERA.LERP;
  CAMERA.y = CAMERA.y + (CAMERA.targetY - CAMERA.y) * CAMERA.LERP;
  CAMERA.zoom = CAMERA.zoom + (CAMERA.targetZoom - CAMERA.zoom) * CAMERA.ZOOM_LERP;
}

/* Apply the current camera transform to ctx. Caller must save+restore
   around their world-space drawing block.

   v28.3.3 fullscreen-fill fix: in TV mode, _resizeCanvasForTVMode sets
   the canvas internal resolution to the viewport (e.g. 1920×1080), but
   the world is fixed at COMBAT.arenaW × arenaH (1280×720). With only
   `ctx.scale(CAMERA.zoom, CAMERA.zoom)`, world coordinates map 1:1 to
   canvas pixels — so a 1280-wide world drawn into a 1920-wide canvas
   leaves 320px of black on each side. The world is letterboxed inside
   the canvas.

   Fix: compute a `canvasFillScale` = max(canvasW/worldW, canvasH/worldH)
   and apply it on top of CAMERA.zoom. With matching aspect ratios
   (16:9 fullscreen on 16:9 world), canvasFillScale = 1.5 and the world
   fills the canvas. With mismatched aspect (e.g. 16:10 monitor), the
   larger axis fills and the smaller axis crops slightly — preferable
   to black bars for a "fullscreen broadcast" feel.

   In non-TV mode, the canvas internal resolution matches the world
   (1280×720), so canvasFillScale = 1.0 and behavior is unchanged. */
function _applyCameraTransform() {
  const W = arenaCanvas.width, H = arenaCanvas.height;
  const worldW = COMBAT.arenaW || 1280;
  const worldH = COMBAT.arenaH || 720;
  // === v28.7 mobile portrait support ===
  // The world is 16:9 horizontal (1280×720, ratio 1.78). Most desktop
  // and landscape mobile viewports are similar — ~16:9 to ~16:10 — and
  // benefit from the original FILL behavior (max(scaleX, scaleY)) which
  // crops slightly to eliminate letterbox bars.
  //
  // Phone portrait (~9:19, ratio 0.47) is the opposite — far taller
  // than wide. FILL on portrait gives canvasFillScale = scaleY, which
  // makes the world ~1.1× viewport tall but ~3× viewport wide. Most
  // of the field falls offscreen — the user only sees a narrow vertical
  // slice of action.
  //
  // Detect severe portrait mismatch and switch to FIT (min) instead.
  // FIT lets the entire 16:9 world fit inside the portrait viewport
  // with black bars top/bottom. The user sees ALL the action.
  // The threshold is canvas-aspect < 0.85 × world-aspect, which
  // catches phone portrait while preserving landscape FILL.
  const canvasAspect = W / H;
  const worldAspect = worldW / worldH;
  const isPortraitMismatch = canvasAspect < worldAspect * 0.85;
  const canvasFillScale = isPortraitMismatch
    ? Math.min(W / worldW, H / worldH)   // FIT: world fits inside, black bars
    : Math.max(W / worldW, H / worldH);  // FILL: world covers canvas, slight crop
  const finalScale = CAMERA.zoom * canvasFillScale;
  // Translate canvas center to world camera position, scaled by zoom.
  // World point (x, y) → screen point
  //   ((x - CAMERA.x) * finalScale + W/2, (y - CAMERA.y) * finalScale + H/2)
  ctx.translate(W/2, H/2);
  ctx.scale(finalScale, finalScale);
  ctx.translate(-CAMERA.x, -CAMERA.y);
}


/* Decorative scenery — fixed positions for 16:9 arena (960×540) */
const SCENERY = [
  { type: "pillar", x: 200, y: 130 },
  { type: "pillar", x: 760, y: 130 },
  { type: "pillar", x: 200, y: 410 },
  { type: "pillar", x: 760, y: 410 },
  { type: "banner", x: 480, y:  60 },
  { type: "banner", x: 480, y: 480 },
  { type: "rubble", x: 340, y: 280 },
  { type: "rubble", x: 620, y: 280 },
  { type: "rubble", x: 480, y: 200 },
  { type: "rubble", x: 480, y: 340 },
];

// Convert "#RRGGBB" to "rgba(r,g,b,a)" for compositing
function _hexA(hex, a) {
  const c = (hex || "#888").replace("#", "");
  const r = parseInt(c.substring(0,2), 16);
  const g = parseInt(c.substring(2,4), 16);
  const b = parseInt(c.substring(4,6), 16);
  return `rgba(${r},${g},${b},${a})`;
}

/* Blend two "#RRGGBB" colors at the given ratio (0=a, 1=b). Used to
   produce a smooth midpoint for the floor gradient. */
function _blend(hexA, hexB, t) {
  const ca = (hexA || "#888").replace("#", "");
  const cb = (hexB || "#888").replace("#", "");
  const ar = parseInt(ca.substring(0,2), 16), ag = parseInt(ca.substring(2,4), 16), ab = parseInt(ca.substring(4,6), 16);
  const br = parseInt(cb.substring(0,2), 16), bg = parseInt(cb.substring(2,4), 16), bb = parseInt(cb.substring(4,6), 16);
  const r = Math.round(ar + (br - ar) * t);
  const g = Math.round(ag + (bg - ag) * t);
  const b = Math.round(ab + (bb - ab) * t);
  return `rgb(${r},${g},${b})`;
}

/* ============================================================
   BIOME SCATTER RENDER — draws the per-match decorative sprites
   (grass tufts, dandelions, pebbles, ice cracks, embers, petals)
   directly to the floor canvas. No filtering or culling — the count
   is bounded (<300 sprites typically) so blasting through is fast.
   ============================================================ */
function drawBiomeScatter(scatter) {
  for (const s of scatter) {
    switch (s.type) {
      case "grassTuft": {
        // Three little vertical blades fanning out
        ctx.strokeStyle = s.c1;
        ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(s.x, s.y + 2);
        ctx.lineTo(s.x, s.y - 4 - s.r);
        ctx.moveTo(s.x - 2, s.y + 2);
        ctx.lineTo(s.x - 3, s.y - 2 - s.r);
        ctx.moveTo(s.x + 2, s.y + 2);
        ctx.lineTo(s.x + 3, s.y - 2 - s.r);
        ctx.stroke();
        // Highlight on the center blade
        ctx.strokeStyle = s.c2;
        ctx.lineWidth = 0.8;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(s.x, s.y + 1);
        ctx.lineTo(s.x, s.y - 3 - s.r);
        ctx.stroke();
        break;
      }
      case "dandelion": {
        // Tiny puff: a yellow-ish circle + small white dots around it
        ctx.fillStyle = s.c1;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, 1.6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = s.c2;
        for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
          const a = i * Math.PI / 2 + s.rot;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(s.x + Math.cos(a) * 2.2, s.y + Math.sin(a) * 2.2, 0.6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fill();
        }
        break;
      }
      case "pebble": {
        // Small dark ellipse with highlight
        ctx.fillStyle = s.c1;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(s.x, s.y, 1.5 + s.r * 0.5, 1 + s.r * 0.4, s.rot, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = s.c2;
        ctx.fillRect(s.x - 1, s.y - 0.5, 1, 0.5);
        break;
      }
      case "cactus": {
        // Vertical green oval w/ ridge
        ctx.fillStyle = s.c1;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(s.x, s.y, 2 + s.r, 5 + s.r * 1.5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.strokeStyle = s.c2;
        ctx.lineWidth = 0.8;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(s.x, s.y - 5 - s.r);
        ctx.lineTo(s.x, s.y + 5 + s.r);
        ctx.stroke();
        break;
      }
      case "sandTuft": {
        // Tiny windswept marks
        ctx.strokeStyle = s.c2;
        ctx.lineWidth = 0.8;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(s.x - 2, s.y);
        ctx.lineTo(s.x + 2, s.y - 1);
        ctx.stroke();
        break;
      }
      case "iceCrack": {
        // Jagged crack lines
        ctx.strokeStyle = s.c1;
        ctx.lineWidth = 1;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(s.x - 6, s.y);
        ctx.lineTo(s.x - 1, s.y + 2);
        ctx.lineTo(s.x + 3, s.y - 2);
        ctx.lineTo(s.x + 7, s.y + 1);
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.strokeStyle = s.c2;
        ctx.lineWidth = 0.5;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(s.x - 1, s.y + 2);
        ctx.lineTo(s.x + 1, s.y + 5);
        ctx.stroke();
        break;
      }
      case "snowTuft": {
        // Tiny white dot
        ctx.fillStyle = s.c2;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, 0.8 + s.r * 0.3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        break;
      }
      case "ember": {
        // Glowing dot with halo
        ctx.fillStyle = _hexA(s.c1.replace(/^#/, "#") || "#ff8030", 0.18);
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = s.c2;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, 1.2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        break;
      }
      case "crack": {
        // Glowing volcanic crack
        ctx.strokeStyle = s.c1;
        ctx.lineWidth = 2.2;
        ctx.lineCap = "round";
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(s.x - 8, s.y);
        ctx.lineTo(s.x + 6, s.y + 2);
        ctx.lineTo(s.x + 10, s.y - 1);
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.strokeStyle = s.c2;
        ctx.lineWidth = 0.8;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(s.x - 8, s.y);
        ctx.lineTo(s.x + 6, s.y + 2);
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.lineCap = "butt";
        break;
      }
      case "petal": {
        // Soft pink ellipse
        ctx.save();
        ctx.translate(s.x, s.y);
        ctx.rotate(s.rot);
        ctx.fillStyle = s.c1;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(0, 0, 2.8, 1.5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = s.c2;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(-0.4, -0.4, 1.4, 0.7, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.restore();
        break;
      }
      case "crystal": {
        // Diamond / triangle gem shape — pointy with bright highlight
        ctx.save();
        ctx.translate(s.x, s.y);
        ctx.rotate(s.rot);
        ctx.fillStyle = s.c1;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(0, -3 - s.r);
        ctx.lineTo(2.5, 0);
        ctx.lineTo(0, 3 + s.r * 0.6);
        ctx.lineTo(-2.5, 0);
        ctx.closePath();
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = s.c2;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(0, -3 - s.r);
        ctx.lineTo(1, 0);
        ctx.lineTo(0, 0);
        ctx.closePath();
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.restore();
        break;
      }
      case "stalagmite": {
        // Pointy upward cone
        ctx.fillStyle = s.c1;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(s.x - 4, s.y + 4);
        ctx.lineTo(s.x, s.y - 6 - s.r);
        ctx.lineTo(s.x + 4, s.y + 4);
        ctx.closePath();
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = s.c2;
        ctx.fillRect(s.x - 1, s.y - 5 - s.r, 1, 4);
        break;
      }
      case "seaweed": {
        // Wavy vertical strand
        ctx.strokeStyle = s.c1;
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(s.x, s.y + 6);
        ctx.bezierCurveTo(s.x - 3, s.y + 2, s.x + 3, s.y - 2, s.x, s.y - 8 - s.r * 2);
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.strokeStyle = s.c2;
        ctx.lineWidth = 1;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(s.x, s.y + 4);
        ctx.bezierCurveTo(s.x - 2, s.y + 1, s.x + 2, s.y - 1, s.x, s.y - 6 - s.r * 2);
        ctx.stroke();
        break;
      }
      case "coral": {
        // Tree-branch shape with multiple prongs
        ctx.fillStyle = s.c1;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, 3 + s.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.strokeStyle = s.c1;
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.beginPath();
        for (let a = -Math.PI / 2; a < Math.PI / 2; a += Math.PI / 5) {
          ctx.moveTo(s.x, s.y);
          ctx.lineTo(s.x + Math.cos(a) * 5, s.y + Math.sin(a) * 5);
        }
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.fillStyle = s.c2;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, 1.2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        break;
      }
      case "manhole": {
        // Round dark circle with cross pattern
        ctx.fillStyle = s.c1;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, 9, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.strokeStyle = s.c2;
        ctx.lineWidth = 1;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, 7.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(s.x - 6, s.y); ctx.lineTo(s.x + 6, s.y);
        ctx.moveTo(s.x, s.y - 6); ctx.lineTo(s.x, s.y + 6);
        ctx.stroke();
        break;
      }
      case "oilStain": {
        // Irregular dark blob
        ctx.fillStyle = s.c1;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(s.x, s.y, 5 + s.r, 3 + s.r * 0.6, s.rot, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = s.c2;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(s.x - 1, s.y - 0.5, 2, 1.2, s.rot, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        break;
      }
      case "gum": {
        // Tiny squashed circle
        ctx.fillStyle = s.c1;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(s.x, s.y, 1.8, 1.2, s.rot, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        break;
      }
      case "leaf": {
        // Pointed oval, rotated
        ctx.save();
        ctx.translate(s.x, s.y);
        ctx.rotate(s.rot);
        ctx.fillStyle = s.c1;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(0, 0, 3.5 + s.r * 0.4, 1.6, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.strokeStyle = s.c2;
        ctx.lineWidth = 0.6;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(-3, 0); ctx.lineTo(3, 0);
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.restore();
        break;
      }
      case "vine": {
        // Curving thin line
        ctx.strokeStyle = s.c1;
        ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(s.x - 8, s.y);
        ctx.bezierCurveTo(s.x - 2, s.y - 4, s.x + 2, s.y + 4, s.x + 8, s.y);
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.strokeStyle = s.c2;
        ctx.lineWidth = 0.6;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(s.x, s.y - 1);
        ctx.lineTo(s.x + 3, s.y - 4);
        ctx.stroke();
        break;
      }
      case "gridDot": {
        // Bright glowing dot — neon biomes
        ctx.fillStyle = _hexA(s.c1.startsWith("#") ? s.c1 : "#ff40c8", 0.20);
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = s.c1;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, 1, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, 0.4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        break;
      }
      case "neonStripe": {
        // Short bright horizontal line with glow
        ctx.save();
        ctx.translate(s.x, s.y);
        ctx.rotate(s.rot);
        ctx.strokeStyle = _hexA(s.c1.startsWith("#") ? s.c1 : "#ff40c8", 0.30);
        ctx.lineWidth = 4;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(-10, 0); ctx.lineTo(10, 0);
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.strokeStyle = s.c2;
        ctx.lineWidth = 1;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(-10, 0); ctx.lineTo(10, 0);
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.restore();
        break;
      }
      case "glowMushroom": {
        // Small mushroom with bright cap
        ctx.fillStyle = "#3a3028";
        ctx.fillRect(s.x - 0.7, s.y - 1, 1.4, 4);
        ctx.fillStyle = _hexA(s.c1.startsWith("#") ? s.c1 : "#88e0c8", 0.4);
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(s.x, s.y - 1, 4, Math.PI, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = s.c1;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(s.x, s.y - 1, 2.5, Math.PI, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = s.c2;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(s.x, s.y - 1.5, 0.7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        break;
      }
      case "evergreen": {
        // Triangular pine tree silhouette
        ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.30)";
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(s.x + 2, s.y + 8, 8, 2, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = s.c1;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(s.x - 6, s.y + 6);
        ctx.lineTo(s.x, s.y - 12);
        ctx.lineTo(s.x + 6, s.y + 6);
        ctx.closePath();
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = s.c2;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(s.x - 4, s.y + 2);
        ctx.lineTo(s.x, s.y - 8);
        ctx.lineTo(s.x + 4, s.y + 2);
        ctx.closePath();
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = "#3d2515";
        ctx.fillRect(s.x - 1, s.y + 6, 2, 2);
        break;
      }
      case "flowerPink":
      case "flowerYellow": {
        // 5-petal flower with center
        ctx.fillStyle = s.c1;
        for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
          const a = i * (Math.PI * 2 / 5) + s.rot;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(s.x + Math.cos(a) * 1.8, s.y + Math.sin(a) * 1.8, 1.4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fill();
        }
        ctx.fillStyle = s.c2;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, 1, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        break;
      }
      case "gift": {
        // Wrapped gift box — small square with a ribbon
        ctx.fillStyle = s.c1;
        ctx.fillRect(s.x - 4, s.y - 4, 8, 8);
        ctx.fillStyle = s.c2;
        ctx.fillRect(s.x - 4, s.y - 0.5, 8, 1);
        ctx.fillRect(s.x - 0.5, s.y - 4, 1, 8);
        ctx.fillStyle = s.c2;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, 1.4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        break;
      }
      case "ornament": {
        // Christmas ornament — gold/silver bauble with a tiny cap
        ctx.fillStyle = _hexA(s.c1.startsWith("#") ? s.c1 : "#ffc848", 0.35);
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, 4.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = s.c1;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = s.c2;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(s.x - 0.8, s.y - 0.8, 1, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = "#5a4830";
        ctx.fillRect(s.x - 0.5, s.y - 4, 1, 1.5);
        break;
      }
      case "pumpkin": {
        // Orange ridged pumpkin
        ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.30)";
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(s.x + 1, s.y + 4, 5, 1.5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = s.c1;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(s.x, s.y, 5, 4, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.strokeStyle = s.c2;
        ctx.lineWidth = 0.6;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(s.x - 2, s.y - 3); ctx.lineTo(s.x - 2, s.y + 3);
        ctx.moveTo(s.x, s.y - 4);     ctx.lineTo(s.x, s.y + 4);
        ctx.moveTo(s.x + 2, s.y - 3); ctx.lineTo(s.x + 2, s.y + 3);
        ctx.stroke();
        // Stem
        ctx.fillStyle = "#3a4818";
        ctx.fillRect(s.x - 0.5, s.y - 5, 1, 2);
        break;
      }
      case "gravestone": {
        // Rounded-top tombstone
        ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.40)";
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(s.x + 1, s.y + 7, 6, 1.5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = s.c1;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(s.x - 4, s.y + 6);
        ctx.lineTo(s.x - 4, s.y - 3);
        ctx.arc(s.x, s.y - 3, 4, Math.PI, 0, false);
        ctx.lineTo(s.x + 4, s.y + 6);
        ctx.closePath();
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = s.c2;
        ctx.fillRect(s.x - 2.5, s.y - 1, 5, 0.6);
        ctx.fillRect(s.x - 2,   s.y + 1, 4, 0.6);
        ctx.fillRect(s.x - 2.5, s.y + 3, 5, 0.6);
        break;
      }
      // === v28.10/v28.11: scatter handlers for new effect overlays ===
      case "lavaCrack": {
        // Glowing zigzag in the floor — bright orange under thin dark crust
        ctx.strokeStyle = s.c1;
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(s.x - 5, s.y - 1);
        ctx.lineTo(s.x - 1, s.y + 2);
        ctx.lineTo(s.x + 2, s.y - 1);
        ctx.lineTo(s.x + 5, s.y + 2);
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.strokeStyle = s.c2;
        ctx.lineWidth = 0.7;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(s.x - 4, s.y);
        ctx.lineTo(s.x, s.y + 1);
        ctx.lineTo(s.x + 4, s.y);
        ctx.stroke();
        break;
      }
      case "ash": {
        // Small grey smudge — soft puff
        ctx.fillStyle = s.c1;
        ctx.globalAlpha = 0.55;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(s.x, s.y, 2 + s.r * 0.6, 1, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
        ctx.fillStyle = s.c2;
        ctx.fillRect(s.x - 0.5, s.y - 0.5, 1, 1);
        break;
      }
      case "mushroom": {
        // Cap + stem — cap colored, stem off-white
        ctx.fillStyle = s.c2;  // stem
        ctx.fillRect(s.x - 1, s.y, 2, 3);
        ctx.fillStyle = s.c1;  // cap
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, 2.5 + s.r * 0.4, Math.PI, 0, false);
        ctx.fill();
        // Spots
        ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.8)";
        ctx.fillRect(s.x - 1, s.y - 1, 0.7, 0.7);
        ctx.fillRect(s.x + 0.5, s.y - 1.4, 0.6, 0.6);
        break;
      }
      case "pinecone": {
        // Brown teardrop with hatched scales
        ctx.fillStyle = s.c1;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(s.x, s.y, 2, 3, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.strokeStyle = s.c2;
        ctx.lineWidth = 0.5;
        for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(s.x - 1.5, s.y - 1.5 + i * 1.2);
          ctx.lineTo(s.x + 1.5, s.y - 1.5 + i * 1.2);
          ctx.stroke();
        }
        break;
      }
      case "cherryLeaf": {
        // Pointed oval leaf, slight stem
        ctx.fillStyle = s.c1;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(s.x, s.y, 1.8, 3, Math.PI / 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.strokeStyle = s.c2;
        ctx.lineWidth = 0.6;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(s.x - 1.5, s.y + 1.5);
        ctx.lineTo(s.x + 1.5, s.y - 1.5);
        ctx.stroke();
        break;
      }
      case "wheatStalk": {
        // Vertical stem with bristled head
        ctx.strokeStyle = s.c1;
        ctx.lineWidth = 1;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(s.x, s.y + 4);
        ctx.lineTo(s.x, s.y - 4);
        ctx.stroke();
        // Bristles
        ctx.strokeStyle = s.c2;
        ctx.lineWidth = 0.6;
        for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(s.x, s.y - 2 - i);
          ctx.lineTo(s.x - 2, s.y - 3 - i);
          ctx.moveTo(s.x, s.y - 2 - i);
          ctx.lineTo(s.x + 2, s.y - 3 - i);
          ctx.stroke();
        }
        break;
      }
      case "auroraWisp": {
        // Soft glowing curve — blurred trail
        const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(s.x - 6, s.y, s.x + 6, s.y);
        grad.addColorStop(0,    "rgba(0,0,0,0)");
        grad.addColorStop(0.4,  s.c1);
        grad.addColorStop(0.6,  s.c2);
        grad.addColorStop(1,    "rgba(0,0,0,0)");
        ctx.strokeStyle = grad;
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.globalAlpha = 0.55;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(s.x - 6, s.y);
        ctx.quadraticCurveTo(s.x, s.y - 4, s.x + 6, s.y);
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
        break;
      }
      case "circuitArc": {
        // Tiny zig-zag in bright neon — like a printed-circuit trace
        ctx.strokeStyle = s.c1;
        ctx.lineWidth = 1;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(s.x - 4, s.y);
        ctx.lineTo(s.x - 2, s.y);
        ctx.lineTo(s.x - 2, s.y - 2);
        ctx.lineTo(s.x + 2, s.y - 2);
        ctx.lineTo(s.x + 2, s.y);
        ctx.lineTo(s.x + 4, s.y);
        ctx.stroke();
        // Glow dot at one end
        ctx.fillStyle = s.c2;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(s.x + 4, s.y, 1, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        break;
      }
    }
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   COURT-SPECIFIC FIELD MARKINGS — for tennis/badminton/basketball/
   volleyball biomes. Drawn in place of the generic grid + center
   circle when biome.courtType is set.

   The court runs the full arena, scaled to the available space.
   Lines color comes from biome.accents.lineColor (typically white).
   ============================================================ */
function drawCourtMarkings(W, H, courtType, lineColor) {
  // === v28.16: proportional court markings ===
  // The court markings were originally sized for a 960×540 field; the
  // field is now 1280×720, so the absolute pixel sizes (penalty boxes,
  // free-throw circles, face-off rings, etc.) read as too small relative
  // to the field. We compute a scale factor from H/540 and apply it to
  // every hardcoded dimension that should grow with the field.
  // The 40px broadcast margin around the outer boundary stays absolute —
  // it's a uniform UI-style inset, not part of the sport's geometry.
  const S = H / 540;             // scale factor (1.0 at original dims, ≈1.33 at 1280×720)
  const s = (n) => n * S;        // inline scaler for one-off uses

  ctx.strokeStyle = lineColor;
  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  // Outer boundary — common to all courts. 40px broadcast margin.
  ctx.strokeRect(40, 40, W - 80, H - 80);
  // Center net line (vertical)
  ctx.lineWidth = 4;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(W / 2, 30); ctx.lineTo(W / 2, H - 30);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;

  if (courtType === "tennis") {
    // Service boxes — half-court width × half-court height
    const sx = W / 2 - s(200), ex = W / 2 + s(200);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(sx, 40);   ctx.lineTo(sx, H - 40);
    ctx.moveTo(ex, 40);   ctx.lineTo(ex, H - 40);
    ctx.moveTo(W / 2, H / 2 - 0); ctx.lineTo(W / 2, H / 2 - 0);
    ctx.moveTo(sx, H / 2);  ctx.lineTo(ex, H / 2);
    ctx.stroke();
    // Singles sidelines
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(s(80), 40);    ctx.lineTo(s(80), H - 40);
    ctx.moveTo(W - s(80), 40); ctx.lineTo(W - s(80), H - 40);
    ctx.stroke();
  } else if (courtType === "basketball") {
    // Three-point arc on each side + key (free-throw rectangle)
    const arcR = Math.min(W, H) * 0.32;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(40, H / 2, arcR, -Math.PI / 2.6, Math.PI / 2.6);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(W - 40, H / 2, arcR, Math.PI - Math.PI / 2.6, Math.PI + Math.PI / 2.6);
    ctx.stroke();
    // Key boxes
    const keyW = s(200), keyH = s(160);
    ctx.strokeRect(40, H / 2 - keyH/2, keyW, keyH);
    ctx.strokeRect(W - 40 - keyW, H / 2 - keyH/2, keyW, keyH);
    // Free throw circles
    const ftR = s(60);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(40 + keyW, H / 2, ftR, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(W - 40 - keyW, H / 2, ftR, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.stroke();
    // Center circle
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(W / 2, H / 2, s(60), 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.stroke();
  } else if (courtType === "volleyball") {
    // Attack lines 3m from net
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(W / 2 - s(180), 40);   ctx.lineTo(W / 2 - s(180), H - 40);
    ctx.moveTo(W / 2 + s(180), 40);   ctx.lineTo(W / 2 + s(180), H - 40);
    ctx.stroke();
    // Net dotted line down center
    ctx.setLineDash([10, 6]);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(W / 2, 30); ctx.lineTo(W / 2, H - 30);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.setLineDash([]);
  } else if (courtType === "badminton") {
    // Singles sidelines + service lines
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(s(70), 40);    ctx.lineTo(s(70), H - 40);
    ctx.moveTo(W - s(70), 40); ctx.lineTo(W - s(70), H - 40);
    ctx.stroke();
    // Short service lines (close to net)
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(W / 2 - s(100), 40);   ctx.lineTo(W / 2 - s(100), H - 40);
    ctx.moveTo(W / 2 + s(100), 40);   ctx.lineTo(W / 2 + s(100), H - 40);
    ctx.stroke();
    // Center service line
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(W / 2 - s(100), H / 2); ctx.lineTo(W / 2 + s(100), H / 2);
    ctx.stroke();
  } else if (courtType === "football") {
    // === v28.8: American football gridiron ===
    const yardSpacing = s(80);
    const endZoneW = s(120);
    // End zones — slight tint to differentiate
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.04)";
    ctx.fillRect(40, 40, endZoneW, H - 80);
    ctx.fillRect(W - 40 - endZoneW, 40, endZoneW, H - 80);
    // Goal lines (boundary of end zones)
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(40 + endZoneW, 40); ctx.lineTo(40 + endZoneW, H - 40);
    ctx.moveTo(W - 40 - endZoneW, 40); ctx.lineTo(W - 40 - endZoneW, H - 40);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    // Yard lines across the playing field
    for (let x = 40 + endZoneW + yardSpacing; x < W - 40 - endZoneW; x += yardSpacing) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x, 40); ctx.lineTo(x, H - 40);
      ctx.stroke();
      // Hash marks at top/bottom thirds (NFL style)
      const hashY1 = 40 + (H - 80) / 3;
      const hashY2 = 40 + 2 * (H - 80) / 3;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x - 10, hashY1); ctx.lineTo(x + 10, hashY1);
      ctx.moveTo(x - 10, hashY2); ctx.lineTo(x + 10, hashY2);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  } else if (courtType === "soccer") {
    // === v28.8: Soccer pitch ===
    const pBoxW = s(180), pBoxH = s(380);
    const gBoxW = s(60),  gBoxH = s(200);
    const pBoxYTop = (H - pBoxH) / 2;
    const gBoxYTop = (H - gBoxH) / 2;
    // Penalty boxes
    ctx.strokeRect(40, pBoxYTop, pBoxW, pBoxH);
    ctx.strokeRect(W - 40 - pBoxW, pBoxYTop, pBoxW, pBoxH);
    // Goal boxes
    ctx.strokeRect(40, gBoxYTop, gBoxW, gBoxH);
    ctx.strokeRect(W - 40 - gBoxW, gBoxYTop, gBoxW, gBoxH);
    // Penalty arcs — partial circle on the field-side of each penalty box
    const arcR = s(50);
    const penSpotOffset = s(130);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(40 + penSpotOffset, H / 2, arcR, -Math.PI / 3, Math.PI / 3);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(W - 40 - penSpotOffset, H / 2, arcR, Math.PI - Math.PI / 3, Math.PI + Math.PI / 3);
    ctx.stroke();
    // Center circle
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(W / 2, H / 2, s(80), 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(W / 2, H / 2, s(4), 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    // Corner arcs
    [[40, 40], [W - 40, 40], [40, H - 40], [W - 40, H - 40]].forEach(([cx, cy]) => {
      const dx = cx === 40 ? 1 : -1;
      const dy = cy === 40 ? 1 : -1;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(cx, cy, s(14), dx > 0 ? (dy > 0 ? 0 : 1.5 * Math.PI) : (dy > 0 ? 0.5 * Math.PI : Math.PI), dx > 0 ? (dy > 0 ? 0.5 * Math.PI : 0) : (dy > 0 ? Math.PI : 1.5 * Math.PI));
      ctx.stroke();
    });
  } else if (courtType === "hockey") {
    // === v28.8: Ice hockey rink ===
    // Center red line with dotted pattern
    ctx.setLineDash([10, 6]);
    ctx.lineWidth = 4;
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(220, 70, 70, 0.85)";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(W / 2, 40); ctx.lineTo(W / 2, H - 40);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.setLineDash([]);
    ctx.strokeStyle = lineColor;
    // Blue lines (1/3 from each end) — already proportional
    ctx.lineWidth = 4;
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(80, 130, 220, 0.75)";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(W / 3, 40); ctx.lineTo(W / 3, H - 40);
    ctx.moveTo(2 * W / 3, 40); ctx.lineTo(2 * W / 3, H - 40);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.strokeStyle = lineColor;
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    // Center face-off circle
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(W / 2, H / 2, s(50), 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.stroke();
    // Four end-zone face-off circles
    const faceoffOffset = s(180);
    [[faceoffOffset, H * 0.3], [faceoffOffset, H * 0.7], [W - faceoffOffset, H * 0.3], [W - faceoffOffset, H * 0.7]].forEach(([cx, cy]) => {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(cx, cy, s(50), 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(cx, cy, s(4), 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    });
    // Goalie creases — half-circles at each end
    const creaseR = s(40);
    const creaseOffset = s(70);
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(80, 130, 220, 0.20)";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(creaseOffset, H / 2, creaseR, -Math.PI / 2, Math.PI / 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(W - creaseOffset, H / 2, creaseR, Math.PI / 2, 1.5 * Math.PI);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.stroke();
  } else if (courtType === "curling") {
    // === v28.8: Curling sheet ===
    // Center line
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(W / 2, 40); ctx.lineTo(W / 2, H - 40);
    ctx.stroke();
    // House at each end — 4 concentric rings
    const houseRadii = [s(60), s(45), s(28), s(12)];
    const houseColors = ["rgba(220, 70, 70, 0.40)", "rgba(255,255,255,0.10)", "rgba(80, 130, 220, 0.40)", "rgba(255,255,255,0.20)"];
    const houseOffset = s(180);
    [houseOffset, W - houseOffset].forEach((hx) => {
      for (let i = 0; i < houseRadii.length; i++) {
        ctx.fillStyle = houseColors[i];
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(hx, H / 2, houseRadii[i], 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
      }
      // Tee line through center of each house
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(hx, 40); ctx.lineTo(hx, H - 40);
      ctx.stroke();
    });
    // Hog lines (where stones must cross)
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    const hogOffset = s(280);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(W / 2 - hogOffset, 40); ctx.lineTo(W / 2 - hogOffset, H - 40);
    ctx.moveTo(W / 2 + hogOffset, 40); ctx.lineTo(W / 2 + hogOffset, H - 40);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   CLOUD SHADOWS — soft semi-transparent dark patches that drift
   diagonally across the field. Drawn beneath the vignette so they
   read as actual cloud cover rather than a UI element.
   ============================================================ */
function drawCloudShadows(clouds) {
  for (const c of clouds) {
    const grd = ctx.createRadialGradient(
      c.x + c.w / 2, c.y + c.h / 2, 0,
      c.x + c.w / 2, c.y + c.h / 2, Math.max(c.w, c.h) / 2
    );
    grd.addColorStop(0, `rgba(0,0,0,${c.alpha})`);
    grd.addColorStop(0.7, `rgba(0,0,0,${c.alpha * 0.5})`);
    grd.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");
    ctx.fillStyle = grd;
    ctx.fillRect(c.x, c.y, c.w, c.h);
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   STADIUM PITCH LIGHTS — soft warm flares in the four corners.
   Sells the broadcast-stadium fiction. Drawn AFTER the vignette
   so the lights cut through the dark corners. Each flare is a
   radial gradient from warm white at the corner edge to fully
   transparent at ~25% of the diagonal. Subtle but present.
   ============================================================ */
function drawPitchLights(W, H) {
  const flareR = Math.min(W, H) * 0.42;
  const corners = [
    [0,     0    ],   // top-left
    [W,     0    ],   // top-right
    [0,     H    ],   // bottom-left
    [W,     H    ],   // bottom-right
  ];
  for (const [cx, cy] of corners) {
    const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, 0, cx, cy, flareR);
    g.addColorStop(0,   "rgba(255,240,210,0.18)");
    g.addColorStop(0.4, "rgba(255,235,200,0.06)");
    g.addColorStop(1,   "rgba(255,235,200,0)");
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  }
  // Tiny "lamp" pips in each corner so the lights have a visible source
  for (const [cx, cy] of corners) {
    const px = cx === 0 ? 8 : W - 8;
    const py = cy === 0 ? 8 : H - 8;
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,250,230,0.6)";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(px, py, 2.2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,1)";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(px, py, 1.0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   AMBIENT PARTICLES — biome-driven atmospheric layer drawn
   between cloud shadows and the vignette so they read as airborne
   particles in front of the field but behind the broadcast lighting.

   - snow: tiny white dot with soft halo
   - ember: glowing orange pip with halo + life-fade
   - petal: rotated soft pink ellipse (with highlight)
   - shimmer: vertical wobble line, very faint (heat distortion)
   ============================================================ */
function drawAmbientParticles(particles) {
  for (const p of particles) {
