    if (p.type === "snow") {
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.18)";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r * 1.6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.95)";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    } else if (p.type === "ember") {
      // Life-fade — particle dims as it rises
      const a = clamp(p.life / 80, 0.05, 0.85);
      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,140,40,${a * 0.30})`;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r * 2.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,200,80,${a})`;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    } else if (p.type === "petal") {
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(p.x, p.y);
      ctx.rotate(p.rot);
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,176,200,0.85)";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(0, 0, p.r * 1.6, p.r * 0.7, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,210,225,0.95)";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(-p.r * 0.3, -p.r * 0.2, p.r * 0.7, p.r * 0.3, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.restore();
    } else if (p.type === "shimmer") {
      // Heat shimmer — short vertical wobble line, very faint
      const sway = Math.sin(p.phase) * 1.5;
      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,220,180,0.10)";
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(p.x + sway, p.y);
      ctx.lineTo(p.x - sway, p.y + 5);
      ctx.stroke();
    } else if (p.type === "bubble") {
      // Underwater bubble — circle outline with a highlight pip
      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(220,240,255,0.55)";
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.65)";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x - p.r * 0.4, p.y - p.r * 0.4, p.r * 0.3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    } else if (p.type === "leaf") {
      // Larger drifting leaf — different from the static scatter leaves
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(p.x, p.y);
      ctx.rotate(p.rot);
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(216,96,40,0.85)";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(0, 0, p.r * 1.8, p.r * 0.9, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(120,52,18,0.6)";
      ctx.lineWidth = 0.5;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(-p.r * 1.8, 0); ctx.lineTo(p.r * 1.8, 0);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.restore();
    } else if (p.type === "firefly") {
      // Pulsing yellow-green dot with halo
      const pulse = 0.5 + Math.sin(p.phase) * 0.5;
      const a = clamp(p.life / 200, 0.3, 1);
      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(180,255,120,${pulse * 0.30 * a})`;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(220,255,140,${pulse * 0.95 * a})`;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, 1.4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    } else if (p.type === "spark") {
      // Bright neon trail — short streak with glow
      const a = clamp(p.life / 30, 0, 1);
      const isMagenta = p.hue === "magenta";
      const c1 = isMagenta ? "255,80,200" : "80,224,255";
      ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(${c1},${0.30 * a})`;
      ctx.lineWidth = 3;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(p.x - p.vx * 3, p.y - p.vy * 3);
      ctx.lineTo(p.x, p.y);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${0.95 * a})`;
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(p.x - p.vx * 2, p.y - p.vy * 2);
      ctx.lineTo(p.x, p.y);
      ctx.stroke();
    } else if (p.type === "bat") {
      // Bat silhouette — wing flap via phase
      const wingY = Math.sin(p.phase) * 2;
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(20,15,25,0.85)";
      ctx.beginPath();
      // Body
      ctx.ellipse(p.x, p.y, 2, 1.5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      // Wings — left + right with flap
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(p.x, p.y);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(p.x - 4, p.y + wingY, p.x - 7, p.y + wingY * 0.5);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(p.x - 5, p.y + 1, p.x, p.y);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(p.x, p.y);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(p.x + 4, p.y + wingY, p.x + 7, p.y + wingY * 0.5);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(p.x + 5, p.y + 1, p.x, p.y);
      ctx.fill();
    } else if (p.type === "drip") {
      // Cave water drip — small teardrop, brightens as it falls
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(120,200,255,0.35)";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(p.x, p.y, 0.8, 1.6, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.7)";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y - 0.3, 0.4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }
}

/* === v28.4: Stadium spectators ===
   Decorative crowd border drawn JUST OUTSIDE the playable field
   (negative coordinates for top, beyond arenaW for right, etc.) so
   the camera-fill scaling brings them into view as part of the scene.

   Each fan is a 3-color dot (head + body + occasional accent) at a
   fixed position with a small per-fan phase offset so the bobbing
   isn't synchronized. When m._crowdCheer is active (set on a kill),
   fans within crowdCheer.radius of crowdCheer.x bounce more vigorously.

   Honors LEAGUE_CONFIG.disableCrowd (settings toggle in v28.4). */
const CROWD_DEPTH = 32;        // how far back from the field edge fans extend
const CROWD_STRIDE = 11;       // spacing between fans
const CROWD_ROWS = 3;          // number of rows of seating
const CROWD_PALETTE = [
  // Pre-baked muted fan colors. Random pick per fan, deterministic via index.
  ["#7d4f3d", "#4a3625", "#a86d4d"],
  ["#4d5a8a", "#34406b", "#6f7eb5"],
  ["#6a8c5a", "#48663d", "#8baf78"],
  ["#8c5a6a", "#664050", "#b07c8c"],
  ["#5a7a8c", "#3d5b6a", "#7ca0b5"],
  ["#8c8a5a", "#666340", "#b0ad7c"],
  ["#6a4d8c", "#4d3866", "#8b6db0"],
];
let _crowdCache = null;  // cache of fan positions, recomputed if arena dims change

function _buildCrowdCache() {
  const W = COMBAT.arenaW || 1280;
  const H = COMBAT.arenaH || 720;
  const fans = [];
  // Top edge — fans facing down toward field
  for (let row = 0; row < CROWD_ROWS; row++) {
    const y = -CROWD_DEPTH + row * 9;
    const offset = (row % 2) * (CROWD_STRIDE / 2);
    for (let x = -16 + offset; x < W + 16; x += CROWD_STRIDE) {
      fans.push({ x, y, palette: CROWD_PALETTE[(x + row * 7) | 0 & 7 % CROWD_PALETTE.length || 0], side: "top" });
    }
  }
  // Bottom edge
  for (let row = 0; row < CROWD_ROWS; row++) {
    const y = H + 6 + row * 9;
    const offset = (row % 2) * (CROWD_STRIDE / 2);
    for (let x = -16 + offset; x < W + 16; x += CROWD_STRIDE) {
      fans.push({ x, y, palette: CROWD_PALETTE[((x * 3 + row * 11) | 0) & 7 % CROWD_PALETTE.length || 0], side: "bottom" });
    }
  }
  // Left edge — narrower because the canvas extends only a bit past the field
  for (let row = 0; row < CROWD_ROWS; row++) {
    const x = -CROWD_DEPTH + row * 9;
    const offset = (row % 2) * (CROWD_STRIDE / 2);
    for (let y = -16 + offset; y < H + 16; y += CROWD_STRIDE) {
      fans.push({ x, y, palette: CROWD_PALETTE[((y + row * 5) | 0) & 7 % CROWD_PALETTE.length || 0], side: "left" });
    }
  }
  // Right edge
  for (let row = 0; row < CROWD_ROWS; row++) {
    const x = W + 6 + row * 9;
    const offset = (row % 2) * (CROWD_STRIDE / 2);
    for (let y = -16 + offset; y < H + 16; y += CROWD_STRIDE) {
      fans.push({ x, y, palette: CROWD_PALETTE[((y * 3 + row * 13) | 0) & 7 % CROWD_PALETTE.length || 0], side: "right" });
    }
  }
  // Add stable per-fan random phase for bobbing
  for (let i = 0; i < fans.length; i++) {
    fans[i].phase = (i * 0.731) % (Math.PI * 2);
  }
  // Pre-resolve palette lookups (the % calc above can produce 0/undefined
  // due to JS bitwise edge cases — fall back to first palette).
  for (const f of fans) {
    if (!f.palette || !Array.isArray(f.palette)) f.palette = CROWD_PALETTE[0];
  }
  _crowdCache = { W, H, fans };
}

function drawCrowd(m) {
  if (LEAGUE_CONFIG && LEAGUE_CONFIG.disableCrowd) return;
  // Build cache lazily / on resize
  const W = COMBAT.arenaW || 1280;
  const H = COMBAT.arenaH || 720;
  if (!_crowdCache || _crowdCache.W !== W || _crowdCache.H !== H) {
    _buildCrowdCache();
  }
  const fans = _crowdCache.fans;
  const t = (m && m.frame !== undefined) ? m.frame : 0;
  const cheer = m && m._crowdCheer;
  const cheerActive = cheer && (t - cheer.frame) < 30;

  // Draw stadium-back band (concrete tiers) behind the fans for depth
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(20, 22, 28, 0.7)";
  ctx.fillRect(-CROWD_DEPTH - 6, -CROWD_DEPTH - 6, W + 2*CROWD_DEPTH + 12, CROWD_DEPTH + 6);
  ctx.fillRect(-CROWD_DEPTH - 6, H, W + 2*CROWD_DEPTH + 12, CROWD_DEPTH + 6);
  ctx.fillRect(-CROWD_DEPTH - 6, -CROWD_DEPTH - 6, CROWD_DEPTH + 6, H + 2*CROWD_DEPTH + 12);
  ctx.fillRect(W, -CROWD_DEPTH - 6, CROWD_DEPTH + 6, H + 2*CROWD_DEPTH + 12);

  for (const f of fans) {
    // Bobbing — gentle sine wave
    let bob = Math.sin(t * 0.07 + f.phase) * 1.2;
    // Cheer boost: fans within cheer radius bounce harder for ~30 frames
    if (cheerActive) {
      const dx = f.x - cheer.x, dy = f.y - cheer.y;
      const d2 = dx * dx + dy * dy;
      if (d2 < cheer.radius * cheer.radius) {
        const cheerProgress = (t - cheer.frame) / 30;
        const cheerStrength = (1 - cheerProgress) * 4;
        bob -= Math.abs(Math.sin(t * 0.5 + f.phase * 3)) * cheerStrength;
      }
    }
    const fy = f.y + bob;
    // Body — 2px wide rectangle
    ctx.fillStyle = f.palette[0];
    ctx.fillRect(f.x - 1, fy + 1, 2, 4);
    // Head — 2x2 dot
    ctx.fillStyle = f.palette[1];
    ctx.fillRect(f.x - 1, fy - 2, 2, 2);
  }
}

function drawScenery() {
  for (const s of SCENERY) {
    if (s.type === "pillar") {
      // Stone pillar with shadow
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.35)";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(s.x + 2, s.y + 14, 8, 3, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = "#3a4555";
      ctx.fillRect(s.x - 6, s.y - 12, 12, 24);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#4d5a6c";
      ctx.fillRect(s.x - 6, s.y - 12, 12, 3);
      ctx.fillRect(s.x - 6, s.y + 9,  12, 3);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#2a323d";
      ctx.fillRect(s.x - 7, s.y - 14, 14, 2);
      ctx.fillRect(s.x - 7, s.y + 12, 14, 2);
    } else if (s.type === "banner") {
      ctx.fillStyle = "#2a323d";
      ctx.fillRect(s.x - 1, s.y - 14, 2, 28);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#7a2828";
      ctx.fillRect(s.x - 8, s.y - 8, 16, 12);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#f7c948";
      ctx.fillRect(s.x - 2, s.y - 4, 4, 4);
    } else if (s.type === "rubble") {
      ctx.fillStyle = "#2a323d";
      ctx.fillRect(s.x - 4, s.y, 8, 4);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#3a4555";
      ctx.fillRect(s.x - 6, s.y + 2, 4, 3);
      ctx.fillRect(s.x + 2, s.y + 1, 4, 3);
    }
  }
}

function drawDrops(m) {
  for (const d of m.drops) {
    const bob = Math.sin((m.frame + d.x) * 0.12) * 1.5;
    const legendary = (d.gear.scavengedCount || 0) >= 3;

    if (d.slot === "health") {
      // Pulsing red cross — visually distinct from gear drops
      const pulse = 0.7 + 0.3 * Math.sin(m.frame * 0.18 + d.x);
      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(239,77,77,${0.25 * pulse})`;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(d.x, d.y + bob, 11, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      // White cross plate
      ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
      ctx.fillRect(d.x - 6, d.y - 6 + bob, 12, 12);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#ef4d4d";
      ctx.fillRect(d.x - 5, d.y - 1 + bob, 10, 2); // horizontal bar
      ctx.fillRect(d.x - 1, d.y - 5 + bob, 2, 10); // vertical bar
      continue;
    }

    // Gear drops (weapon/armor/item)
    ctx.fillStyle = legendary ? "rgba(180,109,240,0.35)" : "rgba(247,201,72,0.2)";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(d.x, d.y + bob, legendary ? 11 : 9, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    const bgColor =
      d.slot === "weapon" ? "#5a3030" :
      d.slot === "armor"  ? "#304a5a" : "#3a5a30";
    ctx.fillStyle = bgColor;
    ctx.fillRect(d.x - 5, d.y - 5 + bob, 10, 10);
    if (legendary) {
      ctx.strokeStyle = "#b46df0";
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      ctx.strokeRect(d.x - 6, d.y - 6 + bob, 12, 12);
    }
    ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
    ctx.font = "9px ui-sans-serif, system-ui";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    ctx.fillText(d.gear.ico || "?", d.x, d.y + bob);
    ctx.textBaseline = "alphabetic";
  }
}

function drawProjectiles(m) {
  if (!m.projectiles) return;
  // v28.16: gate trail-style flair (railgun streaks, laser fading trails,
  // grenade smoke) behind opt-in toggles. The bullet/grenade bodies always
  // draw so the user can still see what's flying around.
  const trailsOff = LEAGUE_CONFIG && LEAGUE_CONFIG.disableProjectileTrails;
  const grenadeSmokeOff = LEAGUE_CONFIG && LEAGUE_CONFIG.disableGrenadeSmoke;
  for (const pr of m.projectiles) {
    const team = TEAM_BY_ID[pr.teamId];
    // === v28.5 grenade-in-flight — tumbling dark sphere + smoke trail ===
    if (pr.isGrenade) {
      const f = m.frame || 0;
      // Smoke trail — three fading puffs behind the grenade
      if (!grenadeSmokeOff) {
        for (let i = 1; i <= 3; i++) {
          const tx = pr.x - pr.vx * i * 1.5;
          const ty = pr.y - pr.vy * i * 1.5;
          const alpha = (4 - i) / 8;
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(160,160,160,${alpha})`;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(tx, ty, 2 + i * 0.3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fill();
        }
      }
      // Grenade body — small tumbling oval with team-color fuse spark
      ctx.fillStyle = "#1a1a1a";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(pr.x, pr.y, 3.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = "#3a3a3a";
      ctx.fillRect(pr.x - 2, pr.y - 2, 4, 4);
      // Fuse spark — pulses with team color
      const sparkOn = (f % 4) < 2;
      if (sparkOn) {
        ctx.fillStyle = team.color;
        ctx.fillRect(pr.x - 1, pr.y - 5, 2, 2);
        ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
        ctx.fillRect(pr.x, pr.y - 4, 1, 1);
      }
      continue;
    }
    const isRailgun = pr.wpn?.id === "railgun";
    if (isRailgun) {
      // Long bright railgun streak — multi-segment trail with team color
      // v28.16: when projectile trails are disabled, just draw the bright head.
      if (!trailsOff) {
        ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,0.65)`;
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(pr.x - pr.vx * 4.0, pr.y - pr.vy * 4.0);
        ctx.lineTo(pr.x, pr.y);
        ctx.stroke();
        // Team-colored outer glow
        ctx.strokeStyle = team.color;
        ctx.lineWidth = 1;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(pr.x - pr.vx * 3.0, pr.y - pr.vy * 3.0);
        ctx.lineTo(pr.x, pr.y);
        ctx.stroke();
      }
      // Bright head (always drawn — this is the projectile's "body")
      ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
      ctx.fillRect(pr.x - 1, pr.y - 1, 3, 3);
    } else {
      // Laser pistol — fading 4-segment trail
      // v28.16: when trails are disabled, just draw the bright body + core.
      const tx = pr.vx, ty = pr.vy;
      if (!trailsOff) {
        // Outer dim halo
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(239,77,77,0.18)`;
        ctx.fillRect(pr.x - tx * 2.4 - 2, pr.y - ty * 2.4 - 2, 4, 4);
        // Mid trail
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(239,77,77,0.45)`;
        ctx.fillRect(pr.x - tx * 1.4 - 1, pr.y - ty * 1.4 - 1, 3, 3);
      }
      // Bright body
      ctx.fillStyle = "#ef4d4d";
      ctx.fillRect(pr.x - tx * 0.6 - 1, pr.y - ty * 0.6 - 1, 3, 3);
      // White-hot core
      ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
      ctx.fillRect(pr.x - 1, pr.y - 1, 2, 2);
    }
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   v28.16: HITBOX WIREFRAMES — debug overlay
   Draws bounding circles, attack ranges, sight cones, terrain
   AABBs, and projectile hitboxes for the active match. All in
   translucent strokes layered on top of normal rendering, so the
   user can see exactly what the AI is using for hit detection,
   targeting, and pathing.

   Colors (one per concept, kept consistent across categories):
     CYAN     player hit-radius (14px collision circle)
     YELLOW   weapon attack range (per-knight, varies by weapon)
     RED      target line — knight to current target
     GREEN    terrain AABB
     ORANGE   grenade-in-flight explosion radius preview
     GOLD     power-core radius
     MAGENTA  drop pickup radius
     WHITE    projectile hit envelope (HIT_RADIUS+8)

   Gated entirely by LEAGUE_CONFIG.showHitboxes — when off, this
   function does nothing and adds no per-frame overhead beyond a
   single-bool check from the caller.
   ============================================================ */
function drawHitboxes(m) {
  if (!LEAGUE_CONFIG || !LEAGUE_CONFIG.showHitboxes) return;
  if (!m) return;

  const HIT_RADIUS = 14;          // matches sim's projectile-collision radius
  const PROJECTILE_ENVELOPE = 22; // HIT_RADIUS+8 detection envelope

  ctx.save();
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.setLineDash([]);

  // Player hitboxes + attack ranges + target lines
  for (const list of [m.teamAplayers || [], m.teamBplayers || []]) {
    for (const p of list) {
      if (!p.alive) continue;
      // Hit-radius (cyan)
      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(0, 230, 255, 0.55)";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, HIT_RADIUS, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.stroke();

      // Weapon attack range (yellow). For melee (range ≤ 30) draw small
      // tight circle; for ranged draw a larger circle showing engagement
      // distance. Always uses the live weapon.range so the visualization
      // matches what the AI actually uses.
      const wpn = p.weapon || {};
      const range = wpn.range || 0;
      if (range > 0) {
        ctx.strokeStyle = range > 30
          ? "rgba(247, 201, 72, 0.20)"  // ranged — fainter, larger
          : "rgba(247, 201, 72, 0.55)"; // melee — solid, tighter
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, range, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.stroke();
      }

      // Facing arrow (magenta) — short stub showing current facing direction
      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(220, 80, 220, 0.85)";
      ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(p.x, p.y);
      ctx.lineTo(p.x + (p.facing || 1) * 18, p.y);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;

      // Target line (red dashed) — current AI target, if any
      if (p.target && p.target.alive) {
        ctx.setLineDash([4, 4]);
        ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(239, 77, 77, 0.50)";
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(p.x, p.y);
        ctx.lineTo(p.target.x, p.target.y);
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.setLineDash([]);
      }

      // Player ID + position label — useful for tracing AI behavior
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85)";
      ctx.font = "9px ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace";
      ctx.fillText(`${p.position}#${p.id}`, p.x + 8, p.y - 12);
      // AI state label below
      if (p.aiState) {
        ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(160, 220, 255, 0.85)";
        ctx.fillText(p.aiState, p.x + 8, p.y - 2);
      }
    }
  }

  // Projectile hitboxes (white) — show the engagement envelope
  if (m.projectiles) {
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.40)";
    for (const pr of m.projectiles) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(pr.x, pr.y, PROJECTILE_ENVELOPE, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.stroke();
      // Velocity vector (white solid line)
      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85)";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(pr.x, pr.y);
      ctx.lineTo(pr.x + (pr.vx || 0) * 6, pr.y + (pr.vy || 0) * 6);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.40)";
    }
  }

  // Terrain AABBs (green) — show what the sim treats as walls / cover
  if (m.terrain && m.terrain.length) {
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(80, 220, 120, 0.65)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    for (const t of m.terrain) {
      // Terrain shapes can be circles or rects; cover both.
      if (t.r != null) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(t.x, t.y, t.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.stroke();
      } else if (t.w != null && t.h != null) {
        ctx.strokeRect(t.x, t.y, t.w, t.h);
      }
    }
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  }

  // Drops (magenta) — pickup radius
  if (m.drops && m.drops.length) {
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(220, 80, 220, 0.55)";
    for (const d of m.drops) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(d.x, d.y, 22, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  }

  // Power Core (gold) — interaction radius if present
  if (m.powerCore && m.powerCore.state === "active") {
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(247, 201, 72, 0.85)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(m.powerCore.x, m.powerCore.y, m.powerCore.r || 30, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  }

  // Mode-specific zones — KOTH hill, CTF flag spawns, etc.
  if (m.koth && m.koth.x != null) {
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255, 200, 60, 0.65)";
    ctx.setLineDash([6, 4]);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(m.koth.x, m.koth.y, m.koth.r || 80, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.setLineDash([]);
  }
  if (m.ctf) {
    for (const flagKey of ["flagA", "flagB"]) {
      const flag = m.ctf[flagKey];
      if (flag && flag.x != null) {
        ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(120, 200, 255, 0.65)";
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(flag.x, flag.y, 24, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.stroke();
      }
    }
  }

  ctx.restore();
}

/* === v28.5: lasting explosion effect ===
   Animates expanding shockwave + smoke billows for grenade detonations.
   Each explosion has frame (when it spawned) and maxFrames (~28). The
   normalized t = (now-frame)/maxFrames runs 0→1 across the lifetime.
   Renders three layered passes:
     1. Bright orange core shrinking + fading
     2. Outer shockwave ring expanding to full blast radius
     3. Smoke puffs at random angles, drifting outward */
function drawExplosions(m) {
  if (!m.explosions || !m.explosions.length) return;
  const now = m.frame || 0;
  for (let i = m.explosions.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const ex = m.explosions[i];
    const age = now - ex.frame;
    if (age > ex.maxFrames) {
      m.explosions.splice(i, 1);
      continue;
    }
    const t = age / ex.maxFrames;  // 0..1

    // Bright orange-red core (shrinks + fades)
    const coreR = ex.radius * 0.35 * (1 - t * 0.6);
    const coreAlpha = 0.85 * (1 - t);
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 180, 60, ${coreAlpha})`;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(ex.x, ex.y, coreR, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 240, 200, ${coreAlpha * 0.7})`;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(ex.x, ex.y, coreR * 0.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Outer shockwave ring (expands to full radius)
    const ringR = ex.radius * (0.4 + 0.6 * t);
    const ringAlpha = 0.65 * (1 - t);
    ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255, 120, 40, ${ringAlpha})`;
    ctx.lineWidth = 3 * (1 - t * 0.5);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(ex.x, ex.y, ringR, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.stroke();

    // Smoke puffs — 6 fixed-angle puffs drifting outward
    if (!ex._smokeSeed) ex._smokeSeed = (ex.x * 31 + ex.y * 17) | 0;
    const numPuffs = 6;
    for (let k = 0; k < numPuffs; k++) {
      const ang = (k / numPuffs) * Math.PI * 2 + (ex._smokeSeed * 0.001);
      const drift = ex.radius * 0.6 * t;
      const px = ex.x + Math.cos(ang) * drift;
      const py = ex.y + Math.sin(ang) * drift - t * 4;  // slight rise
      const pR = ex.radius * 0.18 * (0.5 + t * 0.7);
      const pAlpha = 0.5 * (1 - t * 0.85);
      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(110, 100, 95, ${pAlpha})`;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(px, py, pR, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }
}

function drawTerrain(m) {
  if (!m.terrain) return;
  for (const t of m.terrain) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.5)";
    ctx.fillRect(t.x + 2, t.y + 2, t.size, t.size);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#3a4555";
    ctx.fillRect(t.x, t.y, t.size, t.size);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#5a6678";
    ctx.fillRect(t.x, t.y, t.size, 4);
    ctx.fillRect(t.x, t.y, 4, t.size);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#2a323d";
    ctx.fillRect(t.x + t.size - 4, t.y, 4, t.size);
    ctx.fillRect(t.x, t.y + t.size - 4, t.size, 4);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#1f2630";
    ctx.fillRect(t.x + t.size / 2 - 1, t.y + 4, 2, t.size - 8);
    ctx.fillRect(t.x + 4, t.y + t.size / 2 - 1, t.size - 8, 2);
  }
}

function drawPowerCore(m) {
  if (!m.powerCore || m.powerCore.state !== "active") return;
  const pc = m.powerCore;
  const t = m.frame;
  const pulse = 0.7 + 0.3 * Math.sin(t * 0.15);
  const grd = ctx.createRadialGradient(pc.x, pc.y, 4, pc.x, pc.y, 30);
  grd.addColorStop(0, `rgba(247,201,72,${0.55 * pulse})`);
  grd.addColorStop(1, "rgba(247,201,72,0)");
  ctx.fillStyle = grd;
  ctx.fillRect(pc.x - 30, pc.y - 30, 60, 60);
  for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
    const ang = (t * 0.05) + (i * Math.PI / 2);
    const x1 = pc.x + Math.cos(ang) * 8, y1 = pc.y + Math.sin(ang) * 8;
    const x2 = pc.x + Math.cos(ang) * 14, y2 = pc.y + Math.sin(ang) * 14;
    ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(247,201,72,${pulse})`;
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x1, y1);
    ctx.lineTo(x2, y2);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(pc.x, pc.y, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(247,201,72,${pulse})`;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(pc.x, pc.y, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(247,201,72,0.9)";
  ctx.font = "bold 9px ui-sans-serif, system-ui";
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
  ctx.fillText("⚡POWER", pc.x, pc.y - 22);
  ctx.textBaseline = "alphabetic";
}

/* ============================================================
   GAME MODE ENTITIES — crown (KOTH), flag + bases (CTF), tag It
   indicator. Drawn between drops and players in drawArena, so a
   carrier's player avatar appears on top of their crown/flag.
   ============================================================ */
function drawModeEntities(m) {
  if (!m) return;
  const mode = m.gameMode || "deathmatch";
  const t = m.frame;

  // ----- KOTH crown -----
  if (mode === "koth" && m.crown) {
    const c = m.crown;
    const pulse = 0.75 + 0.25 * Math.sin(t * 0.12);
    // Glow halo
    const grd = ctx.createRadialGradient(c.x, c.y, 4, c.x, c.y, 28);
    grd.addColorStop(0, `rgba(247,201,72,${0.55 * pulse})`);
    grd.addColorStop(1, "rgba(247,201,72,0)");
    ctx.fillStyle = grd;
    ctx.fillRect(c.x - 28, c.y - 28, 56, 56);
    // Crown silhouette — simple pixel-art crown
    const cx = Math.floor(c.x), cy = Math.floor(c.y);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#f7c948";
    // Base band
    ctx.fillRect(cx - 8, cy + 2, 16, 4);
    // Three points
    ctx.fillRect(cx - 8, cy - 3, 4, 5);
    ctx.fillRect(cx - 2, cy - 5, 4, 7);
    ctx.fillRect(cx + 4, cy - 3, 4, 5);
    // Jewels
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ef4d4d";
    ctx.fillRect(cx - 1, cy - 3, 2, 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#88c0d0";
    ctx.fillRect(cx - 7, cy - 1, 2, 2);
    ctx.fillRect(cx + 5, cy - 1, 2, 2);
    // "👑" label if no carrier
    if (!c.carrierId) {
      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(247,201,72,${pulse})`;
      ctx.font = "bold 9px ui-sans-serif, system-ui";
      ctx.textAlign = "center";
      ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
      ctx.fillText("CROWN", c.x, c.y - 18);
      ctx.textBaseline = "alphabetic";
    }
  }

  // ----- CTF flag -----
  if (mode === "ctf" && m.flag) {
    const f = m.flag;
    const fx = Math.floor(f.x), fy = Math.floor(f.y);
    // Pole
    ctx.fillStyle = "#3a2a1a";
    ctx.fillRect(fx, fy - 16, 2, 20);
    // Flag (color matches carrier team if held, otherwise white)
    let flagColor = "#ffffff";
    if (f.carrierTeamId) {
      flagColor = (TEAM_BY_ID[f.carrierTeamId] && TEAM_BY_ID[f.carrierTeamId].color) || "#ffffff";
    }
    ctx.fillStyle = flagColor;
    // Triangular flag waving
    const wave = Math.sin(t * 0.18) * 1.5;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(fx + 2, fy - 16);
    ctx.lineTo(fx + 14 + wave, fy - 13);
    ctx.lineTo(fx + 2, fy - 10);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
    // Soft glow
    if (!f.carrierId) {
      const grd = ctx.createRadialGradient(fx + 2, fy - 4, 4, fx + 2, fy - 4, 24);
      grd.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,255,255,0.30)");
      grd.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,255,255,0)");
      ctx.fillStyle = grd;
      ctx.fillRect(fx - 22, fy - 26, 48, 32);
    }
  }

  // ----- CTF bases -----
  if (mode === "ctf" && m.basesById) {
    for (const teamId in m.basesById) {
      const b = m.basesById[teamId];
      const team = TEAM_BY_ID[teamId];
      const color = (team && team.color) || "#888";
      // Base pad — colored ring on the floor
      const pulse2 = 0.6 + 0.2 * Math.sin(t * 0.08 + (teamId === m.teamAId ? 0 : Math.PI));
      ctx.strokeStyle = color;
      ctx.globalAlpha = pulse2;
      ctx.lineWidth = 3;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, 24, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      // Inner cross-hatch
      ctx.fillStyle = color;
      ctx.globalAlpha = 0.20;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, 22, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      // Team logo overlay
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.85)";
      ctx.font = "bold 14px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, 'Apple Color Emoji'";
      ctx.textAlign = "center";
      ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
      ctx.fillText(team ? team.emoji : "?", b.x, b.y);
      ctx.textBaseline = "alphabetic";
    }
  }

  // ----- TAG "It" indicator -----
  if (mode === "tag" && m.tag && m.tag.itId) {
    const it = [...m.teamAplayers, ...m.teamBplayers].find(p => p.id === m.tag.itId && p.alive);
    if (it) {
      // Halo on the It bot
      const pulse3 = 0.55 + 0.45 * Math.sin(t * 0.18);
      ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(239,77,77,${pulse3})`;
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(it.x, it.y, 30, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.stroke();
      // "IT" label above
      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(239,77,77,${pulse3})`;
      ctx.font = "bold 10px ui-sans-serif, system-ui";
      ctx.textAlign = "center";
      ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
      ctx.fillText("⚡ IT", it.x, it.y - 56);
      ctx.textBaseline = "alphabetic";
    }
    // Frozen indicators on tagged bots
    for (const id in m.tag.tagFreezes) {
      const target = [...m.teamAplayers, ...m.teamBplayers].find(p => p.id === Number(id) && p.alive);
      if (!target) continue;
      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(136,192,208,0.9)";
      ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(target.x, target.y, 24, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.stroke();
      // Snowflake symbol above
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(136,192,208,0.9)";
      ctx.font = "bold 12px ui-sans-serif, system-ui";
      ctx.textAlign = "center";
      ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
      ctx.fillText("❄", target.x, target.y - 40);
      ctx.textBaseline = "alphabetic";
    }
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   CANVAS RENDERER
   Pixel-art arena: turf, scenery, players (team-colored knights
   with balloon HP), blood, corpses, drops, floating dmg numbers.
   ============================================================ */
function drawArena() {
  const W = arenaCanvas.width, H = arenaCanvas.height;
  const m = LEAGUE.match;
  const biome = m && m.biome ? m.biome : null;

  // Update camera target + lerp toward it. Camera tracks all alive
  // players + objectives so the broadcast view stays focused on action.
  _updateCamera(m);

  // Clear & paint background (letterbox bars when zoom > 1)
  ctx.save();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#000";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.restore();

  // World-space drawing happens inside the camera transform. We save,
  // apply translate+scale, draw everything, then restore. HUD/overlays
  // (TV bug, kill feed, vignette) draw outside this block so they stay
  // viewport-locked.
  ctx.save();
  _applyCameraTransform();

  // === FLOOR === Biome-driven base + secondary gradient
  const topColor = biome ? biome.floorTop : "#0d1018";
  const botColor = biome ? biome.floorBot : "#1a232b";
  const floorGrd = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
  floorGrd.addColorStop(0, topColor);
  floorGrd.addColorStop(0.4, _blend(topColor, botColor, 0.5));
  floorGrd.addColorStop(1, botColor);
  ctx.fillStyle = floorGrd;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // Mowing stripes — alternating bands across the field, classic stadium
  // pitch look. The stripeHue color is layered on top so it works against
  // any base. 60px-wide stripes feel right for the 1600x720 arena.
  // v28.16: gated by disableMowingStripes for users who want a clean floor.
  if (biome && !LEAGUE_CONFIG.disableMowingStripes) {
    const stripeW = 60;
    ctx.fillStyle = biome.stripeHue;
    for (let x = 0; x < W; x += stripeW * 2) {
      ctx.fillRect(x, 0, stripeW, H);
    }
  }

  // Team-colored end zones — left third tinted teamA color, right third teamB
  if (m && m.teamAId && m.teamBId) {
    const ta = TEAM_BY_ID[m.teamAId], tb = TEAM_BY_ID[m.teamBId];
    if (ta) {
      const lg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, W * 0.3, 0);
      lg.addColorStop(0, _hexA(ta.color, 0.18));
      lg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");
      ctx.fillStyle = lg;
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W * 0.3, H);
    }
    if (tb) {
      const rg = ctx.createLinearGradient(W * 0.7, 0, W, 0);
      rg.addColorStop(0, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");
      rg.addColorStop(1, _hexA(tb.color, 0.18));
      ctx.fillStyle = rg;
      ctx.fillRect(W * 0.7, 0, W * 0.3, H);
    }
  }

  // === DECORATIVE SCATTER === drawn on top of the floor, beneath everything
  // else. Each sprite is a tiny shape using the biome's palette.
  // v28.16: gated by disableScatterDecor for users who want a clean field.
  if (m && m.scatter && !LEAGUE_CONFIG.disableScatterDecor) {
    drawBiomeScatter(m.scatter);
  }

  // Field lines — biome-aware accent color
  const lineColor = biome ? biome.accents.lineColor : "rgba(247,201,72,0.06)";
  const brandColor = biome ? biome.accents.brandColor : "rgba(247,201,72,0.12)";

  // === FIELD MARKINGS ===
  // For sport-court biomes (tennis, basketball, etc), draw court-specific
  // line geometry via drawCourtMarkings. Otherwise draw the generic
  // mowing-stripe grid + center circle + penalty arcs.
  if (biome && biome.courtType) {
    drawCourtMarkings(W, H, biome.courtType, lineColor);
    // Brand mark + team mottos still go on top
    if (m && m.teamAId && m.teamBId) {
      const ta = TEAM_BY_ID[m.teamAId], tb = TEAM_BY_ID[m.teamBId];
      if (ta) {
        ctx.save();
        ctx.fillStyle = _hexA(ta.color, 0.22);
        ctx.font = "bold 18px ui-sans-serif, system-ui";
        ctx.textAlign = "center";
        ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
        ctx.translate(110, H/2);
        ctx.rotate(-Math.PI/2);
        ctx.fillText((ta.short || "").toUpperCase(), 0, 0);
        ctx.restore();
      }
      if (tb) {
        ctx.save();
        ctx.fillStyle = _hexA(tb.color, 0.22);
        ctx.font = "bold 18px ui-sans-serif, system-ui";
        ctx.textAlign = "center";
        ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
        ctx.translate(W - 110, H/2);
        ctx.rotate(Math.PI/2);
        ctx.fillText((tb.short || "").toUpperCase(), 0, 0);
        ctx.restore();
      }
    }
    ctx.fillStyle = brandColor;
    ctx.font = "bold 38px ui-sans-serif, system-ui";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    ctx.fillText("FK", W/2, H/2);
    ctx.textBaseline = "alphabetic";
    ctx.textAlign = "left";
  } else {
    // Standard arena field markings (the v21 layout)
    // Subtle grid (much fainter when biome has decorations)
    ctx.strokeStyle = biome ? "rgba(255,255,255,0.04)" : "rgba(247,201,72,0.06)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    for (let i = 0; i < W; i += 60) {
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(i, 0); ctx.lineTo(i, H); ctx.stroke();
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < H; i += 60) {
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, i); ctx.lineTo(W, i); ctx.stroke();
    }

    ctx.strokeStyle = lineColor;
    ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(W/2, 0); ctx.lineTo(W/2, H); ctx.stroke();

    ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(W/2, H/2, 70, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.strokeStyle = brandColor;
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(W/2, H/2, 55, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();

    ctx.strokeStyle = lineColor;
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, H/2, 90, -Math.PI/2, Math.PI/2);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(W, H/2, 90, Math.PI/2, -Math.PI/2);
    ctx.stroke();

    if (m && m.teamAId && m.teamBId) {
      const ta = TEAM_BY_ID[m.teamAId], tb = TEAM_BY_ID[m.teamBId];
      if (ta) {
        ctx.save();
        ctx.fillStyle = _hexA(ta.color, 0.22);
        ctx.font = "bold 18px ui-sans-serif, system-ui";
        ctx.textAlign = "center";
        ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
        ctx.translate(110, H/2);
        ctx.rotate(-Math.PI/2);
        ctx.fillText((ta.short || "").toUpperCase(), 0, 0);
        ctx.restore();
      }
      if (tb) {
        ctx.save();
        ctx.fillStyle = _hexA(tb.color, 0.22);
        ctx.font = "bold 18px ui-sans-serif, system-ui";
        ctx.textAlign = "center";
        ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
        ctx.translate(W - 110, H/2);
        ctx.rotate(Math.PI/2);
        ctx.fillText((tb.short || "").toUpperCase(), 0, 0);
        ctx.restore();
      }
    }

    ctx.fillStyle = brandColor;
    ctx.font = "bold 38px ui-sans-serif, system-ui";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    ctx.fillText("FK", W/2, H/2);
    ctx.textBaseline = "alphabetic";
    ctx.textAlign = "left";
  }

  // === CLOUD SHADOWS === drift across the floor, beneath players. Subtle
  // soft-edged dark patches that move slowly. Drawn before the vignette so
  // they don't interfere with the broadcast lighting feel.
  // v28.16: respects either the umbrella disableFieldFx OR the specific
  // disableCloudShadows toggle.
  const fxOff = LEAGUE_CONFIG.disableFieldFx;
  const lightOff = LEAGUE_CONFIG.disableLighting;
  const cloudsOff    = fxOff    || LEAGUE_CONFIG.disableCloudShadows;
  const particlesOff = fxOff    || LEAGUE_CONFIG.disableAmbientParticles;
  const vignetteOff  = lightOff || LEAGUE_CONFIG.disableVignette;
  const pitchLightsOff = lightOff || LEAGUE_CONFIG.disablePitchLights;
  if (m && m.clouds && !cloudsOff) {
    drawCloudShadows(m.clouds);
  }

  // === AMBIENT PARTICLES === biome-specific airborne effect (snow, embers,
  // petals, shimmer). Drawn after clouds so they appear in front of the
  // shadows, before the vignette so the broadcast lighting still rims them.
  if (m && m.ambient && m.ambient.length && !particlesOff) {
    drawAmbientParticles(m.ambient);
  }

  // Sky tint vignette around edges (broadcast lighting). Biome controls
  // the warmth of the corners — orange for desert, blue for ice, etc.
  // v28.16: respects either disableLighting OR specific disableVignette.
  if (!vignetteOff) {
    const vignetteColor = biome ? biome.skyTint : "rgba(0,0,0,0.4)";
    const vg = ctx.createRadialGradient(W/2, H/2, Math.min(W,H) * 0.4, W/2, H/2, Math.max(W,H) * 0.7);
    vg.addColorStop(0, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");
    vg.addColorStop(1, vignetteColor);
    ctx.fillStyle = vg;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  }

  // === STADIUM PITCH LIGHTS ===
  // Soft warm flares in each corner — sells the broadcast-stadium fiction.
  // Drawn AFTER the vignette so the lights cut through the dark corners.
  // Each is a radial gradient from warm white at the corner to transparent.
  // v28.16: respects either disableLighting OR specific disablePitchLights.
  if (!pitchLightsOff) {
    drawPitchLights(W, H);
  }

  // === v28.4: stadium spectators ===
  // Drawn AFTER the floor + lights but BEFORE the in-field scenery so
  // the crowd sits "outside" the playable area visually. The crowd
  // uses world-space coords (negative for top, beyond W for right) so
  // they're brought into view by the camera-fill scaling in TV mode.
  if (typeof drawCrowd === "function") drawCrowd(LEAGUE.match);

  drawScenery();

  if (!LEAGUE.match) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "#5a6675";
    ctx.font = "16px ui-sans-serif, system-ui";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillText("Awaiting next match…", W/2, H/2 - 100);
    ctx.textAlign = "left";
    ctx.restore();  // close camera transform on early return
    return;
  }

  // Blood spatter (under players)
  for (const b of m.blood) {
    ctx.fillStyle = b.color;
    ctx.fillRect(Math.floor(b.x), Math.floor(b.y), 2, 2);
  }
  // Corpse markers
  for (const c of m.corpses) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "#2a2a2a";
    ctx.fillRect(c.x - 5, c.y - 2, 10, 4);
    ctx.fillStyle = c.color;
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.4;
    ctx.fillRect(c.x - 6, c.y - 6, 12, 12);
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#000";
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(c.x - 4, c.y - 4); ctx.lineTo(c.x + 4, c.y + 4);
    ctx.moveTo(c.x + 4, c.y - 4); ctx.lineTo(c.x - 4, c.y + 4);
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  // Terrain obstacles (drawn over corpses but under drops/players;
  // mascots float OVER them via balloons but bodies clip on the side)
  drawTerrain(m);

  // Power Core (centerpiece objective)
  drawPowerCore(m);

  // Drops (gear lying on the field)
  drawDrops(m);

  // Mode-specific entities (crown for KOTH, flag + bases for CTF, etc.)
  // Drawn before players so a carrier's avatar appears on top.
  drawModeEntities(m);

  // Players — pixel-art mascot knights
  for (const list of [m.teamAplayers, m.teamBplayers]) {
    for (const p of list) {
      if (!p.alive) continue;
      drawMascot(p);
    }
  }

  // Projectiles (drawn over players so they're visible)
  drawProjectiles(m);

  // === v28.5 explosion rendering ===
  // Iterate m.explosions, animate expanding ring + smoke, prune expired.
  if (m.explosions && m.explosions.length) {
    const f = m.frame || 0;
    for (let i = m.explosions.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const ex = m.explosions[i];
      const age = f - ex.frame;
      if (age >= ex.maxFrames) { m.explosions.splice(i, 1); continue; }
      const t = age / ex.maxFrames;  // 0 -> 1
      const r = ex.radius * (0.3 + 0.7 * t);
      // Outer shockwave ring
      ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255, 180, 60, ${1 - t})`;
      ctx.lineWidth = 3;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(ex.x, ex.y, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.stroke();
      // Inner bright disk fades faster
      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 230, 130, ${Math.max(0, 0.7 - t * 1.5)})`;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(ex.x, ex.y, r * 0.55, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      // Smoke puffs — three around the blast, each lagging the ring slightly
      for (let s = 0; s < 5; s++) {
        const pAng = (s / 5) * Math.PI * 2 + age * 0.04;
        const pR = r * 0.85;
        const px = ex.x + Math.cos(pAng) * pR;
        const py = ex.y + Math.sin(pAng) * pR;
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(80, 80, 80, ${Math.max(0, 0.5 - t * 0.6)})`;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(px, py, 5 + t * 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
      }
    }
  }

  // Floating damage numbers / status pings
  for (const f of m.floats) {
    ctx.fillStyle = f.color;
    ctx.font = "bold 11px 'Courier New', monospace";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.globalAlpha = clamp(f.life / 22, 0, 1);
    ctx.fillText(f.text, f.x, f.y);
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  // === v28.16: hitbox-wireframe debug overlay ===
  // Drawn LAST in the world-space block so it overlays players, projectiles,
  // and terrain. No-op when LEAGUE_CONFIG.showHitboxes is false (the function
  // returns immediately on the first line). Stays in world coords so the
  // camera transform applies cleanly to the wireframes.
  drawHitboxes(m);

  // End of world-space drawing — restore so HUD/overlays draw in
  // unscaled screen coordinates.
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawMascot(p) {
  const team = TEAM_BY_ID[p.teamId];
  const pos = POS_BY_ID[p.position];
  // Float bob — gentle vertical motion to sell the balloons-on-back fiction
  const t = (LEAGUE.match?.frame || 0);
  const bob = Math.sin((t + p.id * 7) * 0.08) * 1.5;
  const x = Math.floor(p.x);
  const y = Math.floor(p.y + bob);

  // Determine sprite state — driven by the player's current condition.
  // We cache a separate avatar variant per state so transitions look
  // distinct (closed eyes when stunned, wide pupils when on last balloon).
  let state = "alive";
  if (p.stunned > 0) state = "stunned";
  else if ((p.balloonsPopped || 0) >= 2) state = "critical";

  // ----- Drop shadow (on the ground, doesn't bob, soft edged) -----
  // Two-layer: a wider soft halo + tighter inner shadow gives the impression
  // the mascot is genuinely floating above the field. Scaled up to match
  // the ~2x larger sprite footprint.
  if (!LEAGUE_CONFIG.disableLighting) {
    const shadowY = Math.floor(p.y) + 22;
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.18)";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(x + 1, shadowY, 22, 7, 0, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.45)";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(x, shadowY, 16, 5, 0, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  // ----- Balloons (HP) attached to the helmet, popping at 2/3 and 1/3 -----
  // Larger and positioned higher to clear the bigger sprite. Same physics
  // as before — three balloons, popped[i] hides the i-th one.
  const popped = p.balloonsPopped || 0;
  const balloonY = y - 48;
  const balloonOffsets = [-9, 0, 9];
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(220,220,220,0.6)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
    if (i < popped) continue;
    const bx = x + balloonOffsets[i];
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x, y - 28);
    ctx.lineTo(bx, balloonY + 5);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
    if (i < popped) continue;
    const bx = x + balloonOffsets[i];
    ctx.fillStyle = team.color;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(bx, balloonY, 5, 6.5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.45)";
    ctx.fillRect(bx - 1, balloonY - 3, 2, 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = team.color;
    ctx.fillRect(bx, balloonY + 6, 1, 1);
  }

  // ----- Team-color halo behind the avatar -----
  ctx.fillStyle = team.color;
  ctx.globalAlpha = 0.28;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(x, y, 22, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  // ----- Avatar sprite (cached) — drawn centered on the player's anchor.
  // The sprite canvas is AVATAR_W × AVATAR_H; the anchor (where the
  // player's logical position lines up) is at (AVATAR_W/2, AVATAR_ANCHOR_Y).
  const sprite = (typeof AVATAR !== "undefined") ? AVATAR.get(p, state) : null;
  if (sprite) {
    // Mirror horizontally based on facing — use save/restore + scale(-1, 1)
    if (p.facing < 0) {
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(x, 0);
      ctx.scale(-1, 1);
      ctx.drawImage(sprite, -AVATAR_W / 2, y - AVATAR_ANCHOR_Y);
      ctx.restore();
    } else {
      ctx.drawImage(sprite, x - AVATAR_W / 2, y - AVATAR_ANCHOR_Y);
    }
  } else {
    // Fallback (shouldn't happen in a real browser): emoji rendering, kept
    // here so the function still draws SOMETHING if the avatar canvas fails.
    ctx.font = "16px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, 'Apple Color Emoji', 'Segoe UI Emoji'";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    ctx.fillText("🤖", x, y + 3);
    ctx.font = "14px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, 'Apple Color Emoji', 'Segoe UI Emoji'";
    ctx.fillText(team.emoji, x, y - 9);
  }

  // ----- Weapon icon (held in hand, follows facing) -----
  const wxSign = p.facing >= 0 ? 1 : -1;
  const wpnIco = p.weapon?.ico;
  if (wpnIco) {
    ctx.font = "14px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, 'Apple Color Emoji', 'Segoe UI Emoji'";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    ctx.fillText(wpnIco, x + 18 * wxSign, y + 4);
  }

  // ----- AI state badge (subtle, only for non-default states) -----
  if (p.aiState && p.aiState !== "ENGAGE") {
    const badge =
      p.aiState === "FLEE"       ? "🏃" :
      p.aiState === "SEEK_ITEM"  ? "🎒" :
      p.aiState === "FINISH_OFF" ? "🎯" : "";
    if (badge) {
      ctx.font = "11px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, 'Apple Color Emoji', 'Segoe UI Emoji'";
      ctx.textAlign = "center";
      ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
      ctx.fillText(badge, x + 18, y - 22);
    }
  }

  // ----- Stunned spark (top-of-head pulse) -----
  if (p.stunned > 0) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "#88c0d0";
    ctx.font = "bold 14px 'Courier New', monospace";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    ctx.fillText("⚡", x, y - 38);
  }

  // ----- Boost glow ring -----
  if (p.boostMods) {
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(247,201,72,0.7)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x, y, 26, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  // ----- Attack flicker (white outline pulse just after firing) -----
  if (p.attackCooldown > 12) {
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.5)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.strokeRect(x - 16, y - 18, 32, 36);
  }

  ctx.textBaseline = "alphabetic";
  ctx.textAlign = "left";
}


function lighten(hex, amt) {
  const c = hex.replace("#", "");
  const r = parseInt(c.substr(0,2), 16);
  const g = parseInt(c.substr(2,2), 16);
  const b = parseInt(c.substr(4,2), 16);
  const f = (v) => clamp(Math.round(v + (255 - v) * amt), 0, 255);
  return `rgb(${f(r)}, ${f(g)}, ${f(b)})`;
}

function darken(hex, amt) {
  const c = hex.replace("#", "");
  const r = parseInt(c.substr(0,2), 16);
  const g = parseInt(c.substr(2,2), 16);
  const b = parseInt(c.substr(4,2), 16);
  const f = (v) => clamp(Math.round(v * (1 - amt)), 0, 255);
  return `rgb(${f(r)}, ${f(g)}, ${f(b)})`;
}

/* ============================================================
   AVATAR SYSTEM — flat-avatar-plugin-style layered mascots.

   The Pablo Stanley flat-avatar approach: compose a character from
   stacked layers (body / face / hair / accessories). For Float
   Knights the equivalent layering is:

       shadow → body+armor → cape (sniper only) → head+ears →
       face markings → eyes → mouth/beak → helmet → number badge

   Implementation:
   - Each (teamId, positionId, state) tuple produces one cached
     offscreen canvas via _renderAvatarTo(). The cache key is a
     simple pipe-delimited string. State ∈ {alive, stunned, critical}.
   - Players within the same team+position share the cached sprite.
     This keeps the cache small (~84 base avatars × 3 states ≈ 252
     canvases worst case) while still letting individuals look
     correct for their archetype.
   - During the live render (drawMascot), we compute the right
     state, look up or lazy-build the sprite, and drawImage it
     centered at (x, y). The previous balloons/halo/state-badges/
     position-color treatments still wrap the sprite, just rescaled
     to the new larger footprint.

   Avatar canvas dimensions: 56x64 logical pixels, drawn 1:1 onto
   the arena (so a player occupies ~56x64 of the 1280x720 logical
   field — about 3x the previous ~16x18 footprint, dramatically
   improving in-game readability).
   ============================================================ */

const AVATAR_W = 56;
const AVATAR_H = 64;
// Center of the rendered head/body — the sprite is anchored at its
// horizontal middle and at the body's vertical center (so the player
// position (p.x, p.y) lines up with the chest).
const AVATAR_ANCHOR_Y = 38; // y within the canvas that the player's (x, y) maps to

const AVATAR = {
  _cache: Object.create(null),

  /**
   * Get a sprite canvas for this player+state, lazily rendering on
   * first request. Returns the offscreen HTMLCanvasElement.
   * Returns null if the environment doesn't support full canvas
   * drawing (e.g. node smoke harness with mock contexts).
   */
  get(player, state) {
    const teamId = player.teamId;
    const posId = player.position;
    const key = teamId + "|" + posId + "|" + state;
    let cached = this._cache[key];
    if (cached !== undefined) return cached;  // cache miss returns null too
    if (typeof document === "undefined") {
      this._cache[key] = null; return null;
    }
    const can = document.createElement("canvas");
    can.width = AVATAR_W;
    can.height = AVATAR_H;
    const cx = (typeof can.getContext === "function") ? can.getContext("2d") : null;
    // Verify all methods we use exist before drawing — some test
    // environments stub createElement to return mocks with partial APIs.
    if (!cx ||
        typeof cx.fillRect          !== "function" ||
        typeof cx.beginPath         !== "function" ||
        typeof cx.ellipse           !== "function" ||
        typeof cx.arc               !== "function" ||
        typeof cx.fill              !== "function" ||
        typeof cx.stroke            !== "function" ||
        typeof cx.moveTo            !== "function" ||
        typeof cx.lineTo            !== "function" ||
        typeof cx.quadraticCurveTo  !== "function" ||
        typeof cx.closePath         !== "function" ||
        typeof cx.clearRect         !== "function") {
      this._cache[key] = null; return null;
    }
    _renderAvatarTo(cx, teamId, posId, state);
    this._cache[key] = can;
    return can;
  },

  clearCache() { this._cache = Object.create(null); },
};

/* ============================================================
   COMPOSITION — assemble layers onto the offscreen canvas.
   ============================================================ */
function _renderAvatarTo(cx, teamId, posId, state) {
  const team = (typeof TEAM_BY_ID !== "undefined") ? TEAM_BY_ID[teamId] : null;
  const pal = ANIMAL_PALETTE[teamId] || ANIMAL_PALETTE.fox;
  const teamColor = (team && team.color) || "#888888";

  // Body geometry — torso roughly centered, head sits above
  const bx = AVATAR_W / 2;       // body center x
  const by = AVATAR_ANCHOR_Y;    // body center y (= player anchor)
  const hx = bx;                 // head center x
  const hy = by - 16;            // head center y

  cx.clearRect(0, 0, AVATAR_W, AVATAR_H);
  cx.lineJoin = "round";
  cx.lineCap = "round";

  // 1. Soft drop shadow under the body (very subtle; main shadow is
  //    drawn by drawMascot at the world level).
  cx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.18)";
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.ellipse(bx, by + 18, 14, 3, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  cx.fill();

  // 2. Cape (sniper only) — drawn behind the body so it hangs back
  if (posId === "sniper") {
    _drawCape(cx, bx, by, teamColor, pal);
  }

  // 3. Body silhouette + armor — varies by position
  _drawBodyArmor(cx, bx, by, teamColor, pal, posId);

  // 4. Head — animal-specific silhouette, ears, fur
  _drawAnimalHead(cx, hx, hy, teamId, pal);

  // 5. Face — eyes + mouth + accents, varies with state
  _drawAnimalFace(cx, hx, hy, teamId, pal, state);

  // 6. Helmet/hood — overlay drawn on top of head for tank/sniper/speed
  if (posId === "tank") {
    _drawTankHelmet(cx, hx, hy, teamColor);
  } else if (posId === "sniper") {
    _drawSniperHood(cx, hx, hy, teamColor, pal);
  } else if (posId === "speed") {
    _drawSpeedHood(cx, hx, hy, teamColor);
  }

  // 7. Position emblem on the chest (a tiny role glyph)
  _drawChestEmblem(cx, bx, by + 2, posId, teamColor);
}

/* ============================================================
   BODY + ARMOR per position. All bodies use a rounded torso
   silhouette with team-color armor; position-specific accents
   differentiate the seven classes.
   ============================================================ */
function _drawBodyArmor(cx, bx, by, teamColor, pal, posId) {
  const armor = teamColor;
  const armorDark = darken(teamColor, 0.30);
  const armorLite = lighten(teamColor, 0.25);

  // Position-driven width adjustments
  const isHeavy = posId === "tank" || posId === "brawl";
  const isLight = posId === "speed";
  const torsoW = isHeavy ? 18 : isLight ? 13 : 15;
  const torsoH = 14;

  // Main torso plate
  cx.fillStyle = armor;
  cx.beginPath();
  // rounded-rectangle torso
  const tx = bx - torsoW, ty = by - torsoH/2;
  const r = 4;
  cx.moveTo(tx + r, ty);
  cx.lineTo(tx + 2*torsoW - r, ty);
  cx.quadraticCurveTo(tx + 2*torsoW, ty, tx + 2*torsoW, ty + r);
  cx.lineTo(tx + 2*torsoW, ty + torsoH - r);
  cx.quadraticCurveTo(tx + 2*torsoW, ty + torsoH, tx + 2*torsoW - r, ty + torsoH);
  cx.lineTo(tx + r, ty + torsoH);
  cx.quadraticCurveTo(tx, ty + torsoH, tx, ty + torsoH - r);
  cx.lineTo(tx, ty + r);
  cx.quadraticCurveTo(tx, ty, tx + r, ty);
  cx.closePath();
  cx.fill();

  // Lower plate trim (darker accent strip)
  cx.fillStyle = armorDark;
  cx.fillRect(tx, ty + torsoH - 3, torsoW * 2, 3);

  // Position-specific overlays
  if (posId === "tank") {
    // Heavy shoulder pads — rounded cubes either side
    cx.fillStyle = armorDark;
    cx.beginPath();
    cx.arc(bx - torsoW + 1, ty + 2, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    cx.arc(bx + torsoW - 1, ty + 2, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    cx.fill();
    // Center plate band
    cx.fillStyle = armorLite;
    cx.fillRect(bx - 6, ty + 2, 12, 2);
  } else if (posId === "striker") {
    // Sharp pauldron spikes
    cx.fillStyle = armorDark;
    cx.beginPath();
    cx.moveTo(bx - torsoW, ty + 1);
    cx.lineTo(bx - torsoW - 3, ty + 6);
    cx.lineTo(bx - torsoW + 1, ty + 5);
    cx.closePath();
    cx.moveTo(bx + torsoW, ty + 1);
    cx.lineTo(bx + torsoW + 3, ty + 6);
    cx.lineTo(bx + torsoW - 1, ty + 5);
    cx.closePath();
    cx.fill();
  } else if (posId === "speed") {
    // Slim shoulder seams + chevron
    cx.strokeStyle = armorLite;
    cx.lineWidth = 1;
    cx.beginPath();
    cx.moveTo(bx - 5, ty + 8);
    cx.lineTo(bx, ty + 5);
    cx.lineTo(bx + 5, ty + 8);
    cx.stroke();
  } else if (posId === "brawl") {
    // Heavy bracers/gauntlets at sides (flanking the torso)
    cx.fillStyle = armorDark;
    cx.fillRect(tx - 3, ty + 2, 3, 10);
    cx.fillRect(tx + 2*torsoW, ty + 2, 3, 10);
    cx.fillStyle = armorLite;
    cx.fillRect(tx - 3, ty + 4, 3, 1);
    cx.fillRect(tx + 2*torsoW, ty + 4, 3, 1);
  } else if (posId === "healer") {
    // White cross on the chest — universal medic emblem
    cx.fillStyle = "#fefcf0";
    cx.fillRect(bx - 1, ty + 3, 2, 8);
    cx.fillRect(bx - 4, ty + 6, 8, 2);
  } else if (posId === "grenadier") {
    // Bandolier diagonal across chest with grenade beads
    cx.strokeStyle = armorDark;
    cx.lineWidth = 2.5;
    cx.beginPath();
    cx.moveTo(bx - torsoW + 2, ty + 1);
    cx.lineTo(bx + torsoW - 2, ty + torsoH - 4);
    cx.stroke();
    // Three small grenade beads
    cx.fillStyle = "#3a3c40";
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
      const t = (i + 1) / 4;
      cx.beginPath();
      cx.arc(bx - torsoW + 2 + (2*torsoW - 4) * t, ty + 1 + (torsoH - 5) * t, 1.4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      cx.fill();
    }
  }
  // sniper has its own cape drawn earlier; no extra body overlay needed
}

/* ============================================================
   CAPE — drawn behind the body for snipers.
   ============================================================ */
function _drawCape(cx, bx, by, teamColor, pal) {
  const cape = darken(teamColor, 0.45);
  const trim = darken(teamColor, 0.6);
  cx.fillStyle = cape;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.moveTo(bx - 14, by - 8);
  cx.lineTo(bx - 18, by + 14);
  cx.lineTo(bx, by + 18);
  cx.lineTo(bx + 18, by + 14);
  cx.lineTo(bx + 14, by - 8);
  cx.closePath();
  cx.fill();
  // Cape inner shadow center fold
  cx.fillStyle = trim;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.moveTo(bx, by - 6);
  cx.lineTo(bx - 1, by + 16);
  cx.lineTo(bx + 1, by + 16);
  cx.closePath();
  cx.fill();
}

/* ============================================================
   ANIMAL HEAD — silhouette + ears + species markings.
   Dispatches by teamId; each species draws its distinctive shape.
   ============================================================ */
function _drawAnimalHead(cx, hx, hy, teamId, pal) {
  switch (teamId) {
    case "fox": _headFox(cx, hx, hy, pal); break;
    case "bvr": _headBeaver(cx, hx, hy, pal); break;
    case "owl": _headOwl(cx, hx, hy, pal); break;
    case "shk": _headShark(cx, hx, hy, pal); break;
    case "pnd": _headPanda(cx, hx, hy, pal); break;
    case "rcc": _headRaccoon(cx, hx, hy, pal); break;
    case "frg": _headFrog(cx, hx, hy, pal); break;
    case "hed": _headHedgehog(cx, hx, hy, pal); break;
    case "kit": _headKit(cx, hx, hy, pal); break;
    case "wlf": _headWolf(cx, hx, hy, pal); break;
    case "bdg": _headBadger(cx, hx, hy, pal); break;
    case "otr": _headOtter(cx, hx, hy, pal); break;
    case "tgr": _headTiger(cx, hx, hy, pal); break;
    case "plr": _headPolarBear(cx, hx, hy, pal); break;
    case "bsn": _headBison(cx, hx, hy, pal); break;
    case "rvn": _headRaven(cx, hx, hy, pal); break;
    case "lyx": _headLynx(cx, hx, hy, pal); break;
    case "mos": _headMoose(cx, hx, hy, pal); break;
    case "cyt": _headCoyote(cx, hx, hy, pal); break;
    case "qtz": _headQuetzal(cx, hx, hy, pal); break;
    default:    _headFox(cx, hx, hy, pal); break;
  }
}

// Fox — pointed ears, narrow tapered snout, white chin
function _headFox(cx, hx, hy, pal) {
  // Ears — triangular, tipped darker, pink interior
  cx.fillStyle = pal.accent;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.moveTo(hx - 8, hy - 4);
  cx.lineTo(hx - 11, hy - 12);
  cx.lineTo(hx - 5, hy - 8);
  cx.closePath();
  cx.moveTo(hx + 8, hy - 4);
  cx.lineTo(hx + 11, hy - 12);
  cx.lineTo(hx + 5, hy - 8);
  cx.closePath();
  cx.fill();
  cx.fillStyle = pal.inner;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.moveTo(hx - 8, hy - 5);
  cx.lineTo(hx - 9, hy - 9);
  cx.lineTo(hx - 6, hy - 8);
  cx.closePath();
  cx.moveTo(hx + 8, hy - 5);
  cx.lineTo(hx + 9, hy - 9);
  cx.lineTo(hx + 6, hy - 8);
  cx.closePath();
  cx.fill();
  // Head — oval, slightly tapered to chin
  cx.fillStyle = pal.fur;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.ellipse(hx, hy, 9, 8.5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  cx.fill();
  // White snout/chin patch
  cx.fillStyle = pal.belly;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.ellipse(hx, hy + 3, 5, 4, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  cx.fill();
}

// Beaver — round head, small rounded ears, big teeth
function _headBeaver(cx, hx, hy, pal) {
  // Round small ears
  cx.fillStyle = pal.accent;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.arc(hx - 8, hy - 7, 2.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  cx.arc(hx + 8, hy - 7, 2.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  cx.fill();
  cx.fillStyle = pal.inner;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.arc(hx - 8, hy - 7, 1.2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  cx.arc(hx + 8, hy - 7, 1.2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  cx.fill();
  // Round head
  cx.fillStyle = pal.fur;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.arc(hx, hy, 9, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  cx.fill();
  // Lighter muzzle area
  cx.fillStyle = pal.belly;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.ellipse(hx, hy + 3, 5, 3.5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  cx.fill();
}

// Owl — very round, big yellow-ringed eyes, small ear tufts, beak
function _headOwl(cx, hx, hy, pal) {
  // Tiny ear tufts (peaked)
  cx.fillStyle = pal.accent;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.moveTo(hx - 7, hy - 6);
  cx.lineTo(hx - 8, hy - 11);
  cx.lineTo(hx - 5, hy - 7);
  cx.closePath();
  cx.moveTo(hx + 7, hy - 6);
  cx.lineTo(hx + 8, hy - 11);
  cx.lineTo(hx + 5, hy - 7);
  cx.closePath();
  cx.fill();
  // Round head
  cx.fillStyle = pal.fur;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.arc(hx, hy, 10, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  cx.fill();
  // Feather mottling — three darker dots
  cx.fillStyle = pal.accent;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.arc(hx - 4, hy + 5, 1, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  cx.arc(hx + 4, hy + 5, 1, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  cx.arc(hx, hy + 7, 1, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  cx.fill();
}

// Shark — pointed snout, dorsal fin, white belly underside
function _headShark(cx, hx, hy, pal) {
  // Dorsal fin on top of head
  cx.fillStyle = pal.accent;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.moveTo(hx - 2, hy - 9);
  cx.lineTo(hx, hy - 14);
  cx.lineTo(hx + 4, hy - 8);
  cx.closePath();
  cx.fill();
  // Head — pointed-snout oval
  cx.fillStyle = pal.fur;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.ellipse(hx, hy, 10, 7.5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  cx.fill();
  // White belly underside
  cx.fillStyle = pal.belly;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.ellipse(hx, hy + 4, 9, 3, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  cx.fill();
  // Pointed snout tip
  cx.fillStyle = pal.fur;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.moveTo(hx + 8, hy + 1);
  cx.lineTo(hx + 12, hy + 3);
  cx.lineTo(hx + 8, hy + 4);
  cx.closePath();
  cx.fill();
}

// Panda — white face, black eye patches, black ears
function _headPanda(cx, hx, hy, pal) {
  // Black ears
  cx.fillStyle = pal.accent;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.arc(hx - 8, hy - 8, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  cx.arc(hx + 8, hy - 8, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  cx.fill();
  // Round white head
  cx.fillStyle = pal.fur;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.arc(hx, hy, 9.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  cx.fill();
  // Black eye patches (oval, tilted slightly)
  cx.fillStyle = pal.accent;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.ellipse(hx - 4, hy - 1, 3, 4, -0.3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  cx.ellipse(hx + 4, hy - 1, 3, 4, 0.3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  cx.fill();
}

// Raccoon — black mask stripe across eyes, pointed ears
function _headRaccoon(cx, hx, hy, pal) {
  // Pointed ears with black tips
  cx.fillStyle = pal.fur;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.moveTo(hx - 8, hy - 5);
  cx.lineTo(hx - 10, hy - 11);
  cx.lineTo(hx - 4, hy - 8);
  cx.closePath();
  cx.moveTo(hx + 8, hy - 5);
  cx.lineTo(hx + 10, hy - 11);
  cx.lineTo(hx + 4, hy - 8);
  cx.closePath();
  cx.fill();
  cx.fillStyle = pal.accent;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.arc(hx - 9, hy - 10, 1.4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  cx.arc(hx + 9, hy - 10, 1.4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  cx.fill();
  // Head — slightly triangular
  cx.fillStyle = pal.fur;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.ellipse(hx, hy + 1, 9, 8, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  cx.fill();
  // Black mask stripe across eyes
  cx.fillStyle = pal.mask;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.ellipse(hx, hy - 1, 8, 2.5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  cx.fill();
  // Light snout
  cx.fillStyle = pal.belly;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.ellipse(hx, hy + 4, 4, 2.5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  cx.fill();
}

// Frog — bulging eyes ON TOP of head, wide mouth, smooth green
function _headFrog(cx, hx, hy, pal) {
  // Two big bulging eye DOMES on top of head — drawn before head so
  // the head silhouette overlaps slightly at the base.
  cx.fillStyle = pal.fur;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.arc(hx - 5, hy - 7, 4.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  cx.arc(hx + 5, hy - 7, 4.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  cx.fill();
  // Head — wide blob, low forehead
  cx.fillStyle = pal.fur;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.ellipse(hx, hy + 2, 10, 7, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  cx.fill();
  // Lighter belly/chin underside
  cx.fillStyle = pal.belly;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.ellipse(hx, hy + 5, 8, 3, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  cx.fill();
}

// Hedgehog — short spikes radiating from top, pointed snout, pink nose
function _headHedgehog(cx, hx, hy, pal) {
  // Spike crown — multiple short triangles around upper hemisphere
  cx.fillStyle = pal.spike;
  for (let i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
    const ang = -Math.PI + (i / 8) * Math.PI; // top hemisphere
    const r1 = 8.5, r2 = 12;
    const sx = hx + Math.cos(ang) * r1;
    const sy = hy + Math.sin(ang) * r1;
    const tx = hx + Math.cos(ang) * r2;
    const ty = hy + Math.sin(ang) * r2;
    cx.beginPath();
    cx.moveTo(sx - 1.5, sy + 1);
    cx.lineTo(tx, ty);
    cx.lineTo(sx + 1.5, sy + 1);
    cx.closePath();
    cx.fill();
  }
  // Round head with pointed snout
  cx.fillStyle = pal.fur;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.ellipse(hx, hy + 1, 8.5, 7.5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  cx.fill();
  // Light snout
  cx.fillStyle = pal.belly;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.ellipse(hx, hy + 4, 4.5, 3, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  cx.fill();
}

// Kit — triangular ears, pink nose, whiskers
function _headKit(cx, hx, hy, pal) {
  // Triangular ears with pink interior
  cx.fillStyle = pal.accent;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.moveTo(hx - 7, hy - 6);
  cx.lineTo(hx - 9, hy - 13);
  cx.lineTo(hx - 3, hy - 8);
  cx.closePath();
  cx.moveTo(hx + 7, hy - 6);
  cx.lineTo(hx + 9, hy - 13);
  cx.lineTo(hx + 3, hy - 8);
  cx.closePath();
  cx.fill();
  cx.fillStyle = pal.nose;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.moveTo(hx - 7, hy - 7);
  cx.lineTo(hx - 8, hy - 11);
  cx.lineTo(hx - 5, hy - 8);
  cx.closePath();
  cx.moveTo(hx + 7, hy - 7);
  cx.lineTo(hx + 8, hy - 11);
  cx.lineTo(hx + 5, hy - 8);
  cx.closePath();
  cx.fill();
  // Round head
  cx.fillStyle = pal.fur;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.arc(hx, hy, 9, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  cx.fill();
  // Whiskers (3 lines per side)
  cx.strokeStyle = pal.whisker;
  cx.lineWidth = 0.6;
  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
    const yo = hy + 2 + i * 1.5;
    cx.beginPath();
    cx.moveTo(hx - 4, yo);
    cx.lineTo(hx - 10, yo + (i - 1) * 0.8);
    cx.moveTo(hx + 4, yo);
    cx.lineTo(hx + 10, yo + (i - 1) * 0.8);
    cx.stroke();
  }
}

// Wolf — pointed ears, sharp snout, yellow eyes
function _headWolf(cx, hx, hy, pal) {
  // Pointed ears
  cx.fillStyle = pal.accent;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.moveTo(hx - 7, hy - 5);
  cx.lineTo(hx - 10, hy - 13);
  cx.lineTo(hx - 4, hy - 9);
  cx.closePath();
  cx.moveTo(hx + 7, hy - 5);
  cx.lineTo(hx + 10, hy - 13);
  cx.lineTo(hx + 4, hy - 9);
  cx.closePath();
  cx.fill();
  cx.fillStyle = pal.inner;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.moveTo(hx - 7, hy - 6);
  cx.lineTo(hx - 9, hy - 11);
  cx.lineTo(hx - 5, hy - 8);
  cx.closePath();
  cx.moveTo(hx + 7, hy - 6);
  cx.lineTo(hx + 9, hy - 11);
  cx.lineTo(hx + 5, hy - 8);
  cx.closePath();
  cx.fill();
  // Head — somewhat angular
  cx.fillStyle = pal.fur;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.ellipse(hx, hy, 9, 8, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  cx.fill();
  // Light underside
  cx.fillStyle = pal.belly;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.ellipse(hx, hy + 4, 6, 3, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  cx.fill();
  // Sharp snout extension
  cx.fillStyle = pal.fur;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.moveTo(hx - 3, hy + 4);
  cx.lineTo(hx, hy + 9);
  cx.lineTo(hx + 3, hy + 4);
  cx.closePath();
  cx.fill();
}

// Badger — black with white stripe down center of face
function _headBadger(cx, hx, hy, pal) {
  // Small rounded ears
  cx.fillStyle = pal.fur;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.arc(hx - 8, hy - 7, 2.2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  cx.arc(hx + 8, hy - 7, 2.2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  cx.fill();
  // Wide low head
  cx.fillStyle = pal.fur;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.ellipse(hx, hy + 1, 9.5, 8, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  cx.fill();
  // White stripe down center of face (forehead to nose)
  cx.fillStyle = pal.stripe;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.moveTo(hx - 1.5, hy - 7);
  cx.lineTo(hx + 1.5, hy - 7);
  cx.lineTo(hx + 2, hy + 6);
  cx.lineTo(hx - 2, hy + 6);
  cx.closePath();
  cx.fill();
}

// Otter — rounded head, light belly, whiskers
function _headOtter(cx, hx, hy, pal) {
  // Tiny ears
  cx.fillStyle = pal.accent;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.arc(hx - 7, hy - 7, 1.8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  cx.arc(hx + 7, hy - 7, 1.8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  cx.fill();
  // Rounded head
  cx.fillStyle = pal.fur;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.ellipse(hx, hy, 9, 8, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  cx.fill();
  // Light belly/chin
  cx.fillStyle = pal.belly;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.ellipse(hx, hy + 4, 6, 3, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  cx.fill();
  // Whiskers
  cx.strokeStyle = pal.whisker;
  cx.lineWidth = 0.5;
  for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
    cx.beginPath();
    cx.moveTo(hx - 3, hy + 3 + i);
    cx.lineTo(hx - 8, hy + 3 + i + (i - 0.5) * 0.5);
    cx.moveTo(hx + 3, hy + 3 + i);
    cx.lineTo(hx + 8, hy + 3 + i + (i - 0.5) * 0.5);
    cx.stroke();
  }
}

// === v28.12: New species head functions ===

// Tiger — rounded orange head with black stripes, prominent ears, white chin
function _headTiger(cx, hx, hy, pal) {
  // Triangular ears with darker tips
  cx.fillStyle = pal.fur;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.moveTo(hx - 9, hy - 6);
  cx.lineTo(hx - 11, hy - 12);
  cx.lineTo(hx - 5, hy - 8);
  cx.closePath();
  cx.moveTo(hx + 9, hy - 6);
  cx.lineTo(hx + 11, hy - 12);
  cx.lineTo(hx + 5, hy - 8);
  cx.closePath();
  cx.fill();
  // Black ear interiors
  cx.fillStyle = pal.stripe;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.arc(hx - 9, hy - 9, 1.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  cx.arc(hx + 9, hy - 9, 1.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  cx.fill();
  // Round head, slightly broader than fox
  cx.fillStyle = pal.fur;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.arc(hx, hy + 1, 9.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  cx.fill();
  // Black stripes — characteristic tiger pattern
  cx.fillStyle = pal.stripe;
  cx.beginPath();
  // Top-of-head stripe pair
  cx.fillRect(hx - 5, hy - 7, 1.4, 3);
  cx.fillRect(hx + 3.5, hy - 7, 1.4, 3);
  // Cheek stripes (curved)
  cx.fillRect(hx - 8, hy - 1, 1.2, 4);
  cx.fillRect(hx + 6.5, hy - 1, 1.2, 4);
  // Forehead stripe
  cx.fillRect(hx - 0.7, hy - 7, 1.4, 4);
  cx.fill();
  // White muzzle/chin patch
  cx.fillStyle = pal.belly;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.ellipse(hx, hy + 5, 5, 3.5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  cx.fill();
}

// Polar Bear — big round white head, very small dark eyes + nose, no visible ears
function _headPolarBear(cx, hx, hy, pal) {
  // Subtle ears — small rounded humps on top of head, mostly hidden by head shape
  cx.fillStyle = pal.fur;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.arc(hx - 7, hy - 7, 2.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  cx.arc(hx + 7, hy - 7, 2.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  cx.fill();
  // Pink ear interiors
  cx.fillStyle = "#f8c8c8";
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.arc(hx - 7, hy - 7, 1, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  cx.arc(hx + 7, hy - 7, 1, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  cx.fill();
  // Large round white head — the biggest head silhouette in the league
  cx.fillStyle = pal.fur;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.arc(hx, hy + 1, 10.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  cx.fill();
  // Faint shadow under chin to give the head dimension against white
  cx.fillStyle = pal.accent;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.ellipse(hx, hy + 7, 7, 2, 0, 0, Math.PI);
  cx.fill();
  // Long muzzle — slightly cream-colored
  cx.fillStyle = pal.belly;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.ellipse(hx, hy + 4, 5.5, 4, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  cx.fill();
}

// Bison — massive low-slung head with curved horns and chin mane
function _headBison(cx, hx, hy, pal) {
  // Chin mane (drawn first, behind head) — long shaggy fur under jaw
  cx.fillStyle = pal.mane;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.moveTo(hx - 7, hy + 4);
  cx.lineTo(hx - 9, hy + 12);
  cx.lineTo(hx - 4, hy + 10);
  cx.lineTo(hx, hy + 13);
  cx.lineTo(hx + 4, hy + 10);
  cx.lineTo(hx + 9, hy + 12);
  cx.lineTo(hx + 7, hy + 4);
  cx.closePath();
  cx.fill();
  // Horns — curved upward+outward, dark
  cx.fillStyle = pal.horn;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.moveTo(hx - 10, hy - 7);
  cx.quadraticCurveTo(hx - 13, hy - 9, hx - 12, hy - 12);
  cx.quadraticCurveTo(hx - 9, hy - 10, hx - 8, hy - 7);
  cx.closePath();
  cx.moveTo(hx + 10, hy - 7);
  cx.quadraticCurveTo(hx + 13, hy - 9, hx + 12, hy - 12);
  cx.quadraticCurveTo(hx + 9, hy - 10, hx + 8, hy - 7);
  cx.closePath();
  cx.fill();
  // Massive head — bulkier than other species
  cx.fillStyle = pal.fur;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.ellipse(hx, hy + 1, 10, 9, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  cx.fill();
  // Top-of-head shaggy tuft (between horns)
  cx.fillStyle = pal.mane;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.arc(hx - 3, hy - 6, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  cx.arc(hx + 3, hy - 6, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  cx.arc(hx, hy - 7, 2.4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  cx.fill();
  // Lighter snout
  cx.fillStyle = pal.inner;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.ellipse(hx, hy + 5, 4.5, 3, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  cx.fill();
}

// Raven — sleek black head, sharp triangular beak, alert posture
function _headRaven(cx, hx, hy, pal) {
  // Head — slightly elongated forward, sleek
  cx.fillStyle = pal.fur;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.ellipse(hx, hy + 1, 9, 8, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  cx.fill();
  // Sharp triangular beak — projects forward
  cx.fillStyle = pal.beak;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.moveTo(hx - 1, hy + 3);
  cx.lineTo(hx + 7, hy + 4);
  cx.lineTo(hx - 1, hy + 6);
  cx.closePath();
  cx.fill();
  // Beak split (bottom mandible faint line)
  cx.strokeStyle = pal.accent;
  cx.lineWidth = 0.5;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.moveTo(hx - 1, hy + 5);
  cx.lineTo(hx + 7, hy + 4.5);
  cx.stroke();
  // Crown feather — small ruffle on top of head
  cx.fillStyle = pal.accent;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.moveTo(hx - 4, hy - 7);
  cx.lineTo(hx - 6, hy - 9);
  cx.lineTo(hx - 2, hy - 8);
  cx.closePath();
  cx.moveTo(hx + 4, hy - 7);
  cx.lineTo(hx + 6, hy - 9);
  cx.lineTo(hx + 2, hy - 8);
  cx.closePath();
  cx.fill();
  // Slight neck-feather ruffle (collar at base of head)
  cx.fillStyle = pal.accent;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.moveTo(hx - 8, hy + 7);
  cx.lineTo(hx - 6, hy + 9);
  cx.lineTo(hx - 4, hy + 7);
  cx.lineTo(hx - 2, hy + 9);
  cx.lineTo(hx, hy + 7);
  cx.lineTo(hx + 2, hy + 9);
  cx.lineTo(hx + 4, hy + 7);
  cx.lineTo(hx + 6, hy + 9);
  cx.lineTo(hx + 8, hy + 7);
  cx.closePath();
  cx.fill();
}

// === v28.13: Continental expansion — Lynx, Moose, Coyote, Quetzal ===

// Lynx — silver-grey with very long tufted ears (the diagnostic feature),
// alert green eyes (set in face fn), white chin ruff
function _headLynx(cx, hx, hy, pal) {
  // Long pointed tufted ears (black tufts on top)
  cx.fillStyle = pal.fur;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.moveTo(hx - 8, hy - 4);
  cx.lineTo(hx - 11, hy - 14);
  cx.lineTo(hx - 4, hy - 7);
  cx.closePath();
  cx.moveTo(hx + 8, hy - 4);
  cx.lineTo(hx + 11, hy - 14);
  cx.lineTo(hx + 4, hy - 7);
  cx.closePath();
  cx.fill();
  // Black tufts on ear tips — Lynx diagnostic
  cx.fillStyle = pal.tuft;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.moveTo(hx - 11, hy - 14);
  cx.lineTo(hx - 12, hy - 17);
  cx.lineTo(hx - 9, hy - 13);
  cx.closePath();
  cx.moveTo(hx + 11, hy - 14);
  cx.lineTo(hx + 12, hy - 17);
  cx.lineTo(hx + 9, hy - 13);
  cx.closePath();
  cx.fill();
  // Head — slightly broader than fox, more triangular
  cx.fillStyle = pal.fur;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.ellipse(hx, hy + 1, 9, 8, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  cx.fill();
  // White chin ruff (the Lynx's distinctive cheek-fluff)
  cx.fillStyle = pal.belly;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.moveTo(hx - 9, hy + 4);
  cx.lineTo(hx - 11, hy + 9);
  cx.lineTo(hx - 5, hy + 7);
  cx.lineTo(hx, hy + 9);
  cx.lineTo(hx + 5, hy + 7);
  cx.lineTo(hx + 11, hy + 9);
  cx.lineTo(hx + 9, hy + 4);
  cx.closePath();
  cx.fill();
  // White muzzle
  cx.fillStyle = pal.belly;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.ellipse(hx, hy + 4, 4, 2.5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  cx.fill();
}

// Moose — oversized head with huge palmate antler rack, long droopy snout,
// dewlap below jaw. The biggest head silhouette in the league after the Polar Bears.
function _headMoose(cx, hx, hy, pal) {
  // Antler rack — big palmate (paddle-shaped), drawn behind head
  cx.fillStyle = pal.horn;
  // Left antler
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.moveTo(hx - 7, hy - 5);
  cx.lineTo(hx - 14, hy - 11);
  cx.lineTo(hx - 16, hy - 8);
  cx.lineTo(hx - 14, hy - 5);
  cx.lineTo(hx - 11, hy - 7);
  cx.lineTo(hx - 13, hy - 4);
  cx.lineTo(hx - 9, hy - 4);
  cx.closePath();
  cx.fill();
  // Right antler
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.moveTo(hx + 7, hy - 5);
  cx.lineTo(hx + 14, hy - 11);
  cx.lineTo(hx + 16, hy - 8);
  cx.lineTo(hx + 14, hy - 5);
  cx.lineTo(hx + 11, hy - 7);
  cx.lineTo(hx + 13, hy - 4);
  cx.lineTo(hx + 9, hy - 4);
  cx.closePath();
  cx.fill();
  // Antler tine highlights
  cx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.18)";
  cx.fillRect(hx - 13, hy - 10, 1, 4);
  cx.fillRect(hx + 12, hy - 10, 1, 4);
  // Head — long oval shape
  cx.fillStyle = pal.fur;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.ellipse(hx, hy + 1, 8.5, 9.5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  cx.fill();
  // Long droopy snout — extends down past head
  cx.fillStyle = pal.fur;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.ellipse(hx, hy + 8, 5, 4, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  cx.fill();
  // Dewlap (the dangling skin under the chin) — Moose-specific
  cx.fillStyle = pal.dewlap;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.ellipse(hx, hy + 12, 3, 2, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  cx.fill();
  // Lighter snout patch
  cx.fillStyle = pal.belly;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.ellipse(hx, hy + 8, 3.5, 2.5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  cx.fill();
  // Small inner ears (mostly hidden by antlers)
  cx.fillStyle = pal.accent;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.arc(hx - 6, hy - 6, 1.2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  cx.arc(hx + 6, hy - 6, 1.2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  cx.fill();
}

// Coyote — triangular sandy head with very pointed ears, lean elongated snout,
// alert ears (more upright than Wolf, more pointed). Tan/sandy fur.
function _headCoyote(cx, hx, hy, pal) {
  // Very pointed upright ears — distinctive sharp triangle, more pointed than Wolf
  cx.fillStyle = pal.fur;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.moveTo(hx - 7, hy - 5);
  cx.lineTo(hx - 9, hy - 13);
  cx.lineTo(hx - 3, hy - 7);
  cx.closePath();
  cx.moveTo(hx + 7, hy - 5);
  cx.lineTo(hx + 9, hy - 13);
  cx.lineTo(hx + 3, hy - 7);
  cx.closePath();
  cx.fill();
  // Pink ear interiors
  cx.fillStyle = "#d8a890";
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.moveTo(hx - 7, hy - 5);
  cx.lineTo(hx - 8, hy - 11);
