  cx.lineTo(hx - 4, hy - 7);
  cx.closePath();
  cx.moveTo(hx + 7, hy - 5);
  cx.lineTo(hx + 8, hy - 11);
  cx.lineTo(hx + 4, hy - 7);
  cx.closePath();
  cx.fill();
  // Head — narrower than Wolf, more triangular shape
  cx.fillStyle = pal.fur;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.ellipse(hx, hy + 1, 8, 7.5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  cx.fill();
  // Long lean snout (extends forward, sandy)
  cx.fillStyle = pal.fur;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.moveTo(hx - 3, hy + 3);
  cx.lineTo(hx, hy + 8);
  cx.lineTo(hx + 3, hy + 3);
  cx.closePath();
  cx.fill();
  // Light cheek/chin patches
  cx.fillStyle = pal.belly;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.ellipse(hx - 4, hy + 3, 2.5, 2, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  cx.ellipse(hx + 4, hy + 3, 2.5, 2, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  cx.fill();
  // Light muzzle
  cx.fillStyle = pal.belly;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.ellipse(hx, hy + 6, 2, 1.5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  cx.fill();
}

// Quetzal — bright emerald head with crimson breast/belly, golden beak,
// distinctive long flowing tail-feathers (drape behind body).
function _headQuetzal(cx, hx, hy, pal) {
  // Long flowing tail feathers behind body — drape down past torso
  cx.fillStyle = pal.tail;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.moveTo(hx - 4, hy + 4);
  cx.quadraticCurveTo(hx - 8, hy + 14, hx - 4, hy + 22);
  cx.quadraticCurveTo(hx - 1, hy + 14, hx, hy + 4);
  cx.closePath();
  cx.moveTo(hx + 4, hy + 4);
  cx.quadraticCurveTo(hx + 8, hy + 14, hx + 4, hy + 22);
  cx.quadraticCurveTo(hx + 1, hy + 14, hx, hy + 4);
  cx.closePath();
  cx.fill();
  // Tail-feather highlights
  cx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.25)";
  cx.lineWidth = 0.8;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.moveTo(hx - 5, hy + 8);
  cx.quadraticCurveTo(hx - 6, hy + 15, hx - 5, hy + 20);
  cx.moveTo(hx + 5, hy + 8);
  cx.quadraticCurveTo(hx + 6, hy + 15, hx + 5, hy + 20);
  cx.stroke();
  // Crest — tuft of bright green feathers on top of head
  cx.fillStyle = pal.inner;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.moveTo(hx - 4, hy - 6);
  cx.lineTo(hx - 5, hy - 11);
  cx.lineTo(hx - 1, hy - 8);
  cx.lineTo(hx, hy - 12);
  cx.lineTo(hx + 1, hy - 8);
  cx.lineTo(hx + 5, hy - 11);
  cx.lineTo(hx + 4, hy - 6);
  cx.closePath();
  cx.fill();
  // Head — emerald round
  cx.fillStyle = pal.fur;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.arc(hx, hy, 8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  cx.fill();
  // Crimson breast/throat patch
  cx.fillStyle = pal.belly;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.ellipse(hx, hy + 5, 6, 4, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  cx.fill();
  // Golden beak — short triangular
  cx.fillStyle = pal.beak;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.moveTo(hx - 1, hy + 1);
  cx.lineTo(hx + 5, hy + 3);
  cx.lineTo(hx - 1, hy + 5);
  cx.closePath();
  cx.fill();
  // Beak split
  cx.strokeStyle = pal.accent;
  cx.lineWidth = 0.4;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.moveTo(hx - 1, hy + 3);
  cx.lineTo(hx + 5, hy + 3);
  cx.stroke();
}

/* ============================================================
   FACE — eyes + mouth + nose, varies with state.
   Same eye/mouth treatment for all species since they're already
   distinguished by head silhouette; this saves 12*3 = 36 face
   variations and keeps the state distinction crisp.
   ============================================================ */
function _drawAnimalFace(cx, hx, hy, teamId, pal, state) {
  // Eye positions — owl/frog get wider-set eyes; everyone else uses default
  let eyeOffsetX = 3;
  let eyeOffsetY = -1;
  let eyeR = 1.4;
  let useIris = false;
  if (teamId === "owl") {
    eyeOffsetX = 3.5; eyeOffsetY = -1; eyeR = 2.4; useIris = true;
  } else if (teamId === "frg") {
    // Eyes on top of head (drawn within the bulging domes)
    eyeOffsetX = 5; eyeOffsetY = -7; eyeR = 1.8;
  } else if (teamId === "shk") {
    eyeOffsetX = 4; eyeOffsetY = -2; eyeR = 1;
  } else if (teamId === "wlf") {
    useIris = true;
  } else if (teamId === "bdg") {
    // Badger eyes flank the white stripe
    eyeOffsetX = 4; eyeOffsetY = -1;
  } else if (teamId === "rvn") {
    // Raven gets corvid yellow iris like Wolves; eyes set slightly forward
    useIris = true;
    eyeOffsetX = 3.5; eyeOffsetY = -1.5;
  } else if (teamId === "bsn") {
    // Bison head is bulkier — set eyes wider
    eyeOffsetX = 4.5; eyeOffsetY = -1;
  } else if (teamId === "plr") {
    // Polar bear's massive head — small dark eyes spaced wider
    eyeOffsetX = 3.5; eyeOffsetY = -1; eyeR = 1.2;
  } else if (teamId === "lyx") {
    // Lynx has alert pale-green iris (boreal cat eyes catch low light)
    useIris = true;
    eyeOffsetX = 3.2; eyeOffsetY = -1.5; eyeR = 1.5;
  } else if (teamId === "cyt") {
    // Coyote has yellow iris like Wolves but smaller, set forward
    useIris = true;
    eyeOffsetX = 3; eyeOffsetY = -2; eyeR = 1.2;
  } else if (teamId === "qtz") {
    // Quetzal — tiny bird eyes, set high above the beak
    eyeOffsetX = 2.8; eyeOffsetY = -2.5; eyeR = 1.0;
  } else if (teamId === "mos") {
    // Moose eyes are recessed and set below the antler line
    eyeOffsetX = 4; eyeOffsetY = -1; eyeR = 1.2;
  }

  if (state === "stunned") {
    // X-shaped closed eyes — universal "knocked silly"
    cx.strokeStyle = "#1a1a1a";
    cx.lineWidth = 1.3;
    for (const sign of [-1, 1]) {
      const ex = hx + eyeOffsetX * sign;
      const ey = hy + eyeOffsetY;
      cx.beginPath();
      cx.moveTo(ex - 1.5, ey - 1.5);
      cx.lineTo(ex + 1.5, ey + 1.5);
      cx.moveTo(ex + 1.5, ey - 1.5);
      cx.lineTo(ex - 1.5, ey + 1.5);
      cx.stroke();
    }
  } else if (state === "critical") {
    // Wide intense eyes — bigger pupils, slight squint
    cx.fillStyle = "#fefcf0";
    cx.beginPath();
    cx.arc(hx - eyeOffsetX, hy + eyeOffsetY, eyeR + 0.6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    cx.arc(hx + eyeOffsetX, hy + eyeOffsetY, eyeR + 0.6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    cx.fill();
    cx.fillStyle = "#1a1a1a";
    cx.beginPath();
    cx.arc(hx - eyeOffsetX, hy + eyeOffsetY, eyeR + 0.2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    cx.arc(hx + eyeOffsetX, hy + eyeOffsetY, eyeR + 0.2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    cx.fill();
  } else {
    // Default alive — small focused eyes
    if (useIris) {
      // Owl/wolf: yellow ring + black pupil
      cx.fillStyle = pal.iris || "#f4c542";
      cx.beginPath();
      cx.arc(hx - eyeOffsetX, hy + eyeOffsetY, eyeR + 0.7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      cx.arc(hx + eyeOffsetX, hy + eyeOffsetY, eyeR + 0.7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      cx.fill();
      cx.fillStyle = "#1a1a1a";
      cx.beginPath();
      cx.arc(hx - eyeOffsetX, hy + eyeOffsetY, eyeR * 0.65, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      cx.arc(hx + eyeOffsetX, hy + eyeOffsetY, eyeR * 0.65, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      cx.fill();
    } else if (teamId === "frg") {
      // Frog: white sclera in dome, black pupil
      cx.fillStyle = "#fefcf0";
      cx.beginPath();
      cx.arc(hx - eyeOffsetX, hy + eyeOffsetY, eyeR + 1, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      cx.arc(hx + eyeOffsetX, hy + eyeOffsetY, eyeR + 1, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      cx.fill();
      cx.fillStyle = "#1a1a1a";
      cx.beginPath();
      cx.arc(hx - eyeOffsetX, hy + eyeOffsetY, eyeR, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      cx.arc(hx + eyeOffsetX, hy + eyeOffsetY, eyeR, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      cx.fill();
    } else {
      cx.fillStyle = pal.eye;
      cx.beginPath();
      cx.arc(hx - eyeOffsetX, hy + eyeOffsetY, eyeR, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      cx.arc(hx + eyeOffsetX, hy + eyeOffsetY, eyeR, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      cx.fill();
    }
  }

  // Mouth/nose — varies by team. Keep simple for readability.
  if (teamId === "bvr") {
    // Beaver: two big visible front teeth
    cx.fillStyle = pal.tooth;
    cx.fillRect(hx - 1.6, hy + 4, 1.4, 3);
    cx.fillRect(hx + 0.2, hy + 4, 1.4, 3);
    cx.strokeStyle = pal.accent;
    cx.lineWidth = 0.4;
    cx.strokeRect(hx - 1.6, hy + 4, 1.4, 3);
    cx.strokeRect(hx + 0.2, hy + 4, 1.4, 3);
  } else if (teamId === "shk") {
    // Shark: visible teeth row
    cx.fillStyle = pal.tooth;
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
      cx.beginPath();
      cx.moveTo(hx + 4 + i * 1.5, hy + 1);
      cx.lineTo(hx + 4.5 + i * 1.5, hy + 3);
      cx.lineTo(hx + 5 + i * 1.5, hy + 1);
      cx.closePath();
      cx.fill();
    }
  } else if (teamId === "wlf") {
    // Wolf: small visible canines + black nose tip
    cx.fillStyle = pal.nose;
    cx.beginPath();
    cx.arc(hx, hy + 7, 1.2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    cx.fill();
    cx.fillStyle = pal.tooth;
    cx.fillRect(hx - 1.4, hy + 7.5, 0.7, 1.5);
    cx.fillRect(hx + 0.7, hy + 7.5, 0.7, 1.5);
  } else if (teamId === "frg") {
    // Frog: wide thin mouth across the bottom
    cx.strokeStyle = pal.accent;
    cx.lineWidth = 1;
    cx.beginPath();
    cx.moveTo(hx - 5, hy + 5);
    cx.quadraticCurveTo(hx, hy + 7, hx + 5, hy + 5);
    cx.stroke();
  } else if (teamId === "owl") {
    // Owl: tiny downward beak triangle
    cx.fillStyle = pal.iris || "#f4c542";
    cx.beginPath();
    cx.moveTo(hx - 1.5, hy + 4);
    cx.lineTo(hx + 1.5, hy + 4);
    cx.lineTo(hx, hy + 7);
    cx.closePath();
    cx.fill();
  } else {
    // Default: small black nose dot + faint mouth line
    cx.fillStyle = pal.nose;
    cx.beginPath();
    cx.arc(hx, hy + 4, 1, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    cx.fill();
    if (state !== "stunned") {
      cx.strokeStyle = pal.accent;
      cx.lineWidth = 0.6;
      cx.beginPath();
      cx.moveTo(hx - 1, hy + 6);
      cx.lineTo(hx + 1, hy + 6);
      cx.stroke();
    }
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   HELMETS / HOODS — drawn over head for tank/sniper/speed.
   ============================================================ */
function _drawTankHelmet(cx, hx, hy, teamColor) {
  const h = darken(teamColor, 0.5);
  const trim = lighten(teamColor, 0.2);
  // Helmet dome covers the top of the head
  cx.fillStyle = h;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.arc(hx, hy - 1, 11, Math.PI, Math.PI * 2);
  cx.lineTo(hx + 11, hy + 1);
  cx.lineTo(hx - 11, hy + 1);
  cx.closePath();
  cx.fill();
  // Visor slit
  cx.fillStyle = "#1a1a1a";
  cx.fillRect(hx - 7, hy - 2, 14, 2);
  // Trim band
  cx.fillStyle = trim;
  cx.fillRect(hx - 11, hy + 1, 22, 1);
  // Top crest spike
  cx.fillStyle = trim;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.moveTo(hx - 1.5, hy - 11);
  cx.lineTo(hx, hy - 14);
  cx.lineTo(hx + 1.5, hy - 11);
  cx.closePath();
  cx.fill();
}

function _drawSniperHood(cx, hx, hy, teamColor, pal) {
  const h = darken(teamColor, 0.45);
  // Hood arc draped over head, leaving face visible
  cx.fillStyle = h;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.arc(hx, hy - 2, 12, Math.PI + 0.2, -0.2);
  cx.lineTo(hx + 11, hy + 6);
  cx.lineTo(hx - 11, hy + 6);
  cx.closePath();
  cx.fill();
  // Hood front opening curve (lighter inset)
  cx.fillStyle = darken(teamColor, 0.6);
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.arc(hx, hy + 1, 8, Math.PI + 0.4, -0.4);
  cx.closePath();
  cx.fill();
}

function _drawSpeedHood(cx, hx, hy, teamColor) {
  const h = darken(teamColor, 0.3);
  // Slim band across the forehead — like a goggle strap or headband
  cx.fillStyle = h;
  cx.fillRect(hx - 9, hy - 6, 18, 3);
  // Lens dot in center
  cx.fillStyle = "#fefcf0";
  cx.fillRect(hx - 1, hy - 5, 2, 1);
}

/* ============================================================
   CHEST EMBLEM — small colored glyph indicating role.
   ============================================================ */
function _drawChestEmblem(cx, bx, by, posId, teamColor) {
  const colors = {
    tank: "#88c0d0",
    striker: "#ef6e6e",
    speed: "#f7c948",
    brawl: "#d8b070",
    sniper: "#b46df0",
    healer: "#7fd989",
    grenadier: "#f49056",
  };
  const color = colors[posId] || "#aaaaaa";
  cx.fillStyle = color;
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.arc(bx, by, 1.7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  cx.fill();
  cx.strokeStyle = darken(color, 0.4);
  cx.lineWidth = 0.5;
  cx.stroke();
}

/* ============================================================
   DOM RENDERERS
   ============================================================ */
function renderHeader() {
  $("#bitsAmt").textContent = LEAGUE.bits;
  $("#seasonNum").textContent = LEAGUE.season;
  $("#leagueBadge").textContent = "S" + LEAGUE.season;
  // Ticker shows current matchup or next-up cue
  const am = activeMatchTeams();
  if (LEAGUE.match && LEAGUE.match.phase === "round") {
    $("#ticker").textContent = `LIVE · R${LEAGUE.match.currentRoundIndex}/${LEAGUE.match.bestOf} · ${TEAM_BY_ID[LEAGUE.match.teamAId].name} ${LEAGUE.match.roundsWonA}–${LEAGUE.match.roundsWonB} ${TEAM_BY_ID[LEAGUE.match.teamBId].name}`;
  } else if (LEAGUE.match && LEAGUE.match.phase === "betweenRounds") {
    $("#ticker").textContent = `INTERMISSION · ${LEAGUE.match.roundsWonA}–${LEAGUE.match.roundsWonB} · place bets between rounds →`;
  } else if (am) {
    $("#ticker").textContent = `NEXT: ${am.slot.toUpperCase()} · ${TEAM_BY_ID[am.teamA]?.name || "?"} vs ${TEAM_BY_ID[am.teamB]?.name || "?"}`;
  } else {
    $("#ticker").textContent = `Season ${LEAGUE.season} complete. Begin next season →`;
  }
}

function renderTeamPanel(side) {
  const am = activeMatchTeams();
  if (!am) return;
  const teamId = side === "A" ? am.teamA : am.teamB;
  const team = TEAM_BY_ID[teamId];
  const players = LEAGUE.rosters[teamId];

  $("#team" + side + "emoji").textContent = team.emoji;
  $("#team" + side + "name").textContent = team.name;
  const rec = LEAGUE.records[teamId];
  $("#team" + side + "record").textContent =
    `${rec.wins}–${rec.losses} · ${rec.championships} 🏆`;

  // === v28.16: this season's AI playbook ===
  // Show the team's style assignment as a small label under the record.
  // The label updates each season as rollSeasonAiStyles re-rolls.
  const styleEl = $("#team" + side + "style");
  if (styleEl) {
    const styleId = LEAGUE.aiStyles && LEAGUE.aiStyles[teamId];
    const style = styleId && AI_PATHING_STYLES[styleId];
    if (style) {
      styleEl.textContent = "Playbook: " + style.label;
      styleEl.title = style.desc;
    } else {
      styleEl.textContent = "";
    }
  }

  // Alive count (active match only; otherwise show roster size)
  let alive = 0;
  if (LEAGUE.match && (LEAGUE.match.teamAId === teamId || LEAGUE.match.teamBId === teamId)) {
    const list = LEAGUE.match.teamAId === teamId ? LEAGUE.match.teamAplayers : LEAGUE.match.teamBplayers;
    alive = list.filter(p => p.alive).length;
  } else {
    alive = players.filter(p => !p.deceased).length;
  }
  const aliveEl = $("#team" + side + "alive");
  aliveEl.textContent = alive;
  aliveEl.className = "alive-count " + (alive >= 4 ? "green" : alive >= 2 ? "amber" : "red");

  // Player chips
  const list = $("#team" + side + "list");
  list.innerHTML = "";
  for (const p of players) {
    const pos = POS_BY_ID[p.position];
    const chip = document.createElement("div");
    chip.className = "player-chip" + (p.deceased ? " deceased" : "");
    const liveP = LEAGUE.match
      ? (LEAGUE.match.teamAplayers.concat(LEAGUE.match.teamBplayers)).find(x => x.id === p.id)
      : null;
    // KO'd this round but still has lives → "dead" class (faded, not deceased)
    if (liveP && !liveP.alive && !p.deceased) chip.classList.add("dead");
    const hpFrac = liveP ? clamp(liveP.hp / liveP.stats.hp, 0, 1) : 1;
    const hpCls = hpFrac > 0.6 ? "" : hpFrac > 0.3 ? "med" : "low";

    // Lives pips (only show when in an active match)
    let livesHTML = "";
    if (liveP && !p.deceased && LEAGUE.match) {
      const totalLives = MATCH.startingLives;
      const remaining = liveP.lives;
      let pips = "";
      for (let i = 0; i < totalLives; i++) {
        pips += `<div class="pip${i >= remaining ? " spent" : ""}"></div>`;
      }
      livesHTML = `<div class="lives" title="${remaining}/${totalLives} lives">${pips}</div>`;
    }

    // === v28.1: Streak badge — shown when current streak ≥ 3 ===
    // Career-long currentStreak resets on KO. Yellow flame at 3-9, orange
    // at 10-19, red at 20+. Hot-streak signal at a glance from team panel.
    const streak = p.career.currentStreak || 0;
    let streakHTML = "";
    if (streak >= 3 && !p.deceased && (!liveP || liveP.alive)) {
      const cls = streak >= 20 ? "streak-red" : streak >= 10 ? "streak-orange" : "streak-yellow";
      streakHTML = `<span class="chip-streak ${cls}" title="${streak}-kill streak">🔥${streak}</span>`;
    }

    // === v28.1: Armor badge — restores per-armor visual identity ===
    // Small icon in chip's bottom-right corner showing what armor they wear.
    // Hidden if no armor.
    let armorHTML = "";
    if (p.armor && p.armor.ico) {
      armorHTML = `<span class="chip-armor" title="${escapeHTML(p.armor.name || p.armor.ico)}">${p.armor.ico}</span>`;
    }

    chip.innerHTML = `
      <div class="pos-icon ${pos.cls}" title="${pos.label}">${pos.icon}</div>
      <div class="name-block">
        <div class="pname">${escapeHTML(p.name)}${streakHTML}</div>
        <div class="psub">${pos.label} · K:${p.career.kills}${livesHTML ? "" : ""}</div>
      </div>
      ${livesHTML || `<div class="hpbar ${hpCls}"><div style="width:${Math.round(hpFrac * 100)}%"></div></div>`}
      ${armorHTML}
    `;
    chip.addEventListener("click", () => showPlayerProfile(p));
    list.appendChild(chip);
  }
}

function renderBracketStrip() {
  const strip = $("#bracketStrip");
  if (!strip || !LEAGUE.bracket) return;
  const order = LEAGUE.bracket._order || ["semi1", "semi2", "final"];
  // Build labels dynamically based on slot prefix
  const labelFor = (slot) => {
    if (slot.startsWith("ql")) return "Qualifier " + slot.slice(2);
    if (slot.startsWith("qf")) return "Quarterfinal " + slot.slice(2);
    if (slot.startsWith("sf")) return "Semifinal " + slot.slice(2);
    if (slot === "semi1") return "Semifinal 1";
    if (slot === "semi2") return "Semifinal 2";
    if (slot === "final") return "Final";
    return slot;
  };

  // Re-render the strip with the right number of cards
  strip.innerHTML = "";
  for (const slot of order) {
    const m = LEAGUE.bracket[slot];
    const el = document.createElement("div");
    el.className = "bracket-match";
    el.dataset.slot = slot;
    if (LEAGUE.currentSlot === slot) el.classList.add("current");
    if (m.winner) el.classList.add("done");

    const aId = m.teamA, bId = m.teamB;
    const aTeam = aId ? TEAM_BY_ID[aId] : null;
    const bTeam = bId ? TEAM_BY_ID[bId] : null;
    const aClass = m.winner === aId ? "winner" : (m.winner && m.winner !== aId ? "loser" : "");
    const bClass = m.winner === bId ? "winner" : (m.winner && m.winner !== bId ? "loser" : "");

    let aScore = "—", bScore = "—";
    if (m.winner && LEAGUE.match && LEAGUE.match.slot === slot) {
      aScore = LEAGUE.match.killsByTeam[aId] || 0;
      bScore = LEAGUE.match.killsByTeam[bId] || 0;
    }

    el.innerHTML = `
      <div class="label">${labelFor(slot)}</div>
      <div class="team-row ${aClass}">
        <span class="em">${aTeam?.emoji || "❓"}</span>
        <span class="nm">${aTeam?.short || "TBD"}</span>
        <span class="sc">${aScore}</span>
      </div>
      <div class="vs-divider">VS</div>
      <div class="team-row ${bClass}">
        <span class="em">${bTeam?.emoji || "❓"}</span>
        <span class="nm">${bTeam?.short || "TBD"}</span>
        <span class="sc">${bScore}</span>
      </div>
    `;
    strip.appendChild(el);
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   v28.28: renderLadder — full-bracket display in the Ladder tab.

   Replaces the old bracket-strip's role of showing tournament progress.
   The strip lived on the Game tab in a 3-column grid that, on mobile
   with 12 teams, expanded vertically into 4+ rows of cards, eating
   screen real estate.

   The new display is a horizontal row of round-columns (Qualifiers,
   Quarterfinals, Semifinals, Final), with each column showing its
   matches stacked vertically and evenly spaced. On mobile, the whole
   thing scrolls horizontally rather than stacking.

   Live-updates as matches resolve: the current match gets a gold
   highlight, resolved matches show the winner in gold + loser
   strikethrough, pending matches (winners not yet known) show TBD.
   ============================================================ */
function renderLadder() {
  const display = $("#ladderDisplay");
  if (!display || !LEAGUE.bracket) return;
  const order = LEAGUE.bracket._order || ["semi1", "semi2", "final"];

  // Group matches by round prefix
  const rounds = {
    qualifier: { label: "Qualifiers",   matches: [], slotPrefix: "ql" },
    quarter:   { label: "Quarterfinals", matches: [], slotPrefix: "qf" },
    semi:      { label: "Semifinals",    matches: [], slotPrefix: "sf" },
    final:     { label: "Final",         matches: [], slotPrefix: "final" },
  };
  for (const slot of order) {
    if (slot.startsWith("ql"))      rounds.qualifier.matches.push(slot);
    else if (slot.startsWith("qf")) rounds.quarter.matches.push(slot);
    else if (slot.startsWith("sf") || slot.startsWith("semi")) rounds.semi.matches.push(slot);
    else if (slot === "final")      rounds.final.matches.push(slot);
  }

  // Build the round columns — drop empty rounds (e.g., 4-team brackets have no QFs)
  const activeRounds = ["qualifier", "quarter", "semi", "final"]
    .filter(r => rounds[r].matches.length > 0);

  // Slot label helper
  const slotLabel = (slot) => {
    if (slot.startsWith("ql")) return "QL " + slot.slice(2);
    if (slot.startsWith("qf")) return "QF " + slot.slice(2);
    if (slot.startsWith("sf")) return "SF " + slot.slice(2);
    if (slot.startsWith("semi")) return "SF " + slot.slice(4);
    if (slot === "final") return "FINAL";
    return slot.toUpperCase();
  };

  display.innerHTML = "";
  for (const roundKey of activeRounds) {
    const round = rounds[roundKey];
    const col = document.createElement("div");
    col.className = "ladder-round" + (roundKey === "final" ? " is-final" : "");

    const lbl = document.createElement("div");
    lbl.className = "ladder-round-label";
    lbl.textContent = round.label;
    col.appendChild(lbl);

    const matchList = document.createElement("div");
    matchList.className = "ladder-round-matches";

    for (const slot of round.matches) {
      const m = LEAGUE.bracket[slot];
      if (!m) continue;
      const card = document.createElement("div");
      card.className = "ladder-match";
      card.dataset.slot = slot;
      const isCurrent = (LEAGUE.currentSlot === slot);
      const isDone = !!m.winner;
      const isPending = !isDone && !isCurrent && (!m.teamA || !m.teamB);
      if (isCurrent) card.classList.add("current");
      else if (isDone) card.classList.add("done");
      else if (isPending) card.classList.add("pending");

      const aTeam = m.teamA ? TEAM_BY_ID[m.teamA] : null;
      const bTeam = m.teamB ? TEAM_BY_ID[m.teamB] : null;
      const aClass = m.winner === m.teamA ? "winner" : (m.winner && m.winner !== m.teamA ? "loser" : "");
      const bClass = m.winner === m.teamB ? "winner" : (m.winner && m.winner !== m.teamB ? "loser" : "");

      // Score: prefer the recorded round score on the match object; for the
      // currently-active match, fall back to live round-wins.
      let aScore = "—", bScore = "—";
      if (isDone && m.scoreA != null && m.scoreB != null) {
        aScore = m.scoreA;
        bScore = m.scoreB;
      } else if (isCurrent && LEAGUE.match && LEAGUE.match.slot === slot) {
        aScore = LEAGUE.match.roundsWonA || 0;
        bScore = LEAGUE.match.roundsWonB || 0;
      }

      card.innerHTML = `
        <div class="match-label">${slotLabel(slot)}</div>
        <div class="match-team-row ${aClass}">
          <span class="em">${aTeam?.emoji || "❓"}</span>
          <span class="nm">${aTeam?.short || "TBD"}</span>
          <span class="sc">${aScore}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="match-vs">VS</div>
        <div class="match-team-row ${bClass}">
          <span class="em">${bTeam?.emoji || "❓"}</span>
          <span class="nm">${bTeam?.short || "TBD"}</span>
          <span class="sc">${bScore}</span>
        </div>
      `;
      matchList.appendChild(card);
    }
    col.appendChild(matchList);
    display.appendChild(col);
  }

  // Champion banner (only shown when final is resolved)
  const finalMatch = LEAGUE.bracket.final;
  if (finalMatch && finalMatch.winner) {
    const champTeam = TEAM_BY_ID[finalMatch.winner];
    if (champTeam) {
      const banner = document.createElement("div");
      banner.className = "ladder-champion";
      banner.innerHTML = `<span class="em">${champTeam.emoji}</span><b>${champTeam.name}</b> — Season ${LEAGUE.season} Champions`;
      // Append AFTER the display, not inside it (so it spans full width below the columns)
      const wrapParent = display.parentNode;
      // Remove any prior banner first
      const prior = wrapParent.querySelector(".ladder-champion");
      if (prior) prior.remove();
      // Insert after the display element
      display.insertAdjacentElement("afterend", banner);
    }
  } else {
    // Remove any stale champion banner
    const prior = display.parentNode?.querySelector(".ladder-champion");
    if (prior) prior.remove();
  }
}
window.renderLadder = renderLadder;

/* === ROADMAP 2.6: Ladder ranking with weighted formula ===
   Real-world references: most pro sports use a weighted formula.
   F1 uses points; NBA combines W/L with strength-of-schedule; NFL
   uses W-L-T with tiebreakers. We use a simple weighted score:
     championships×100 + wins×3 + draws×1 - losses×1
   (Championships dominate; wins are the next big driver; losses
   only break ties.)

   Returns a sorted array of { team, record, score, rank, prevRank, delta }.
   The prevRank/delta come from LEAGUE.previousLadder (set at season-end). */
function computeLadderRanking() {
  const teams = TEAMS.slice().map(t => {
    const r = LEAGUE.records[t.id];
    const score = (r.championships || 0) * 100
                + (r.wins || 0) * 3
                + (r.draws || 0)
                - (r.losses || 0);
    return { team: t, record: r, score };
  });
  teams.sort((a, b) => {
    if (b.score !== a.score) return b.score - a.score;
    // Tiebreakers: more wins wins, then fewer losses, then alphabetical
    if (b.record.wins !== a.record.wins) return b.record.wins - a.record.wins;
    if (a.record.losses !== b.record.losses) return a.record.losses - b.record.losses;
    return a.team.short.localeCompare(b.team.short);
  });
  // Annotate with current rank + delta vs previous ladder snapshot
  const prev = (LEAGUE && LEAGUE.previousLadder) || {};
  for (let i = 0; i < teams.length; i++) {
    teams[i].rank = i + 1;
    teams[i].prevRank = prev[teams[i].team.id] || null;
    teams[i].delta = teams[i].prevRank ? (teams[i].prevRank - teams[i].rank) : 0;
  }
  return teams;
}
window.computeLadderRanking = computeLadderRanking;

function renderStandings() {
  const list = $("#standingsList");
  list.innerHTML = "";
  const sorted = computeLadderRanking();
  for (let i = 0; i < sorted.length; i++) {
    const { team: t, record: r, rank, delta } = sorted[i];
    const row = document.createElement("div");
    row.style.cssText = "display:grid;grid-template-columns:18px 12px 1fr auto;gap:6px;padding:5px 10px;font-size:11px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--bg-2);";
    // Rank-change indicator: ▲ green if up, ▼ red if down, · gray if unchanged
    let deltaIcon = `<span style="color:var(--mute);font-size:9px;">·</span>`;
    if (delta > 0) {
      deltaIcon = `<span style="color:var(--grn);font-size:9px;" title="up ${delta} from last season">▲</span>`;
    } else if (delta < 0) {
      deltaIcon = `<span style="color:var(--red);font-size:9px;" title="down ${-delta} from last season">▼</span>`;
    }
    row.innerHTML = `
      <span style="color:var(--mute);">${rank}</span>
      ${deltaIcon}
      <span>${t.emoji} ${escapeHTML(t.short)}</span>
      <span style="font-family:'Courier New',monospace;color:var(--dim);">${r.wins}-${r.losses} · ${r.championships}🏆</span>
    `;
    list.appendChild(row);
  }
}

function renderArenaHeader() {
  // Smoke-test guard — DOM may be absent
  if (typeof document === "undefined" || !document.getElementById) return;
  const matchupEl = document.getElementById("matchupLabel");
  const clockEl = document.getElementById("matchClock");
  if (!matchupEl || !clockEl) return;

  if (!LEAGUE.match) {
    matchupEl.textContent = LEAGUE.currentSlot
      ? `${TEAM_BY_ID[LEAGUE.bracket[LEAGUE.currentSlot]?.teamA]?.short || "?"} vs ${TEAM_BY_ID[LEAGUE.bracket[LEAGUE.currentSlot]?.teamB]?.short || "?"}`
      : "— vs —";
    clockEl.textContent = "00:00";
    renderPhasePill();
    return;
  }
  const m = LEAGUE.match;
  const biomeBadge = m.biome ? ` · ${m.biome.emoji} ${m.biome.name}` : "";
  // === v28.11: Surface formation names in the matchup label ===
  // _formations is stamped by layoutTeam at round start. Show only during
  // an active round (not pre-round / between-rounds / post). The formations
  // get badged inline next to each team's short code so the user can see
  // who's running what this round.
  const fA = (m._formations && m._formations[m.teamAId]) ? m._formations[m.teamAId].toUpperCase() : "";
  const fB = (m._formations && m._formations[m.teamBId]) ? m._formations[m.teamBId].toUpperCase() : "";
  const showFormations = (m.phase === "round" || m.phase === "preRound") && fA && fB;
  const fmtA = showFormations ? ` (${fA})` : "";
  const fmtB = showFormations ? ` (${fB})` : "";
  matchupEl.textContent =
    `${TEAM_BY_ID[m.teamAId].emoji} ${TEAM_BY_ID[m.teamAId].short}${fmtA} vs${fmtB} ${TEAM_BY_ID[m.teamBId].short} ${TEAM_BY_ID[m.teamBId].emoji}${biomeBadge}`;
  const seconds = Math.floor((m.roundFrame || 0) * COMBAT.frameMs / 1000);
  clockEl.textContent = `R${m.currentRoundIndex}/${m.bestOf} ${String(Math.floor(seconds/60)).padStart(2,"0")}:${String(seconds%60).padStart(2,"0")}`;
  renderPhasePill();
}

/* ============================================================
   v28.17: Broadcast Scorebug
   Sports-broadcast-style score display docked at the bottom of
   the canvas. Visible only when body.broadcast-view is set.
   Pulls live values from LEAGUE.match and renders into the
   pre-built DOM nodes from _part1_shell.html.

   Layout (left → right):
     [TEAM-A pill]  [TEAM-B pill]  [period chip]  [clock chip]  [status chip]

   The status chip's gradient runs from teamA color to teamB color,
   giving the bug its broadcast-style "rivalry" look. Content varies
   by phase: pre-round shows "BO5", in-round shows "ROUND N", post
   shows "FINAL".
   ============================================================ */
function renderScorebug() {
  if (typeof document === "undefined" || !document.getElementById) return;
  const scorebug = document.getElementById("broadcastScorebug");
  if (!scorebug) return;
  // v28.24: skip the rebuild entirely when broadcast view is OFF.
  // The scorebug is invisible — no point rebuilding 30+ times/sec.
  // Also makes the call cheap enough to put in the per-frame draw loop
  // (where it now lives so the clock ticks live).
  if (!window._broadcastState) {
    scorebug.style.cssText = "display:none";
    return;
  }
  const m = LEAGUE.match;

  // Determine team data and labels
  let ta = null, tb = null, codeA = "—", codeB = "—";
  let roundsA = 0, roundsB = 0;
  let periodText = "—", clockText = "00:00";
  let statusText = "OFF", seasonText = "S?";
  let rankA = "", rankB = "";

  if (m) {
    ta = TEAM_BY_ID[m.teamAId];
    tb = TEAM_BY_ID[m.teamBId];
    codeA = ta ? ta.short : "—";
    codeB = tb ? tb.short : "—";
    roundsA = m.roundsWonA || 0;
    roundsB = m.roundsWonB || 0;
    periodText = `R${m.currentRoundIndex || 1}`;
    const seconds = Math.floor((m.roundFrame || 0) * COMBAT.frameMs / 1000);
    clockText = `${String(Math.floor(seconds/60)).padStart(2,"0")}:${String(seconds%60).padStart(2,"0")}`;
    switch (m.phase) {
      case "preRound":      statusText = `BO${m.bestOf || 5} · PRE`; break;
      case "round":         statusText = `BO${m.bestOf || 5} · LIVE`; break;
      case "betweenRounds": statusText = `BO${m.bestOf || 5} · BREAK`; break;
      case "post":          statusText = `BO${m.bestOf || 5} · FINAL`; break;
      default:              statusText = `BO${m.bestOf || 5}`;
    }
  } else if (LEAGUE.currentSlot && LEAGUE.bracket && LEAGUE.bracket[LEAGUE.currentSlot]) {
    const b = LEAGUE.bracket[LEAGUE.currentSlot];
    ta = b.teamA && TEAM_BY_ID[b.teamA];
    tb = b.teamB && TEAM_BY_ID[b.teamB];
    codeA = ta ? ta.short : "—";
    codeB = tb ? tb.short : "—";
    periodText = "PRE";
    statusText = `BO${(typeof MATCH !== "undefined" && MATCH.bestOf) || 5} · PRE`;
  }

  seasonText = `S${LEAGUE.season || 1}`;

  // Team rank in standings (1-indexed). Use cached standings if available;
  // otherwise compute from records on the fly.
  function rankFor(teamId) {
    if (!teamId || !LEAGUE.records) return "";
    const ids = Object.keys(LEAGUE.records);
    const ranked = ids
      .map(id => ({
        id,
        wins: (LEAGUE.records[id].wins || 0),
        losses: (LEAGUE.records[id].losses || 0),
        diff: (LEAGUE.records[id].wins || 0) - (LEAGUE.records[id].losses || 0),
      }))
      .sort((x, y) => y.wins - x.wins || y.diff - x.diff);
    const idx = ranked.findIndex(r => r.id === teamId);
    return idx >= 0 ? `#${idx + 1}` : "";
  }
  rankA = rankFor(m ? m.teamAId : (LEAGUE.bracket?.[LEAGUE.currentSlot]?.teamA));
  rankB = rankFor(m ? m.teamBId : (LEAGUE.bracket?.[LEAGUE.currentSlot]?.teamB));

  const colorA = (ta && ta.color) || "#888";
  const colorB = (tb && tb.color) || "#888";

  // Determine which team is leading (for score-color highlight)
  const aLead = roundsA > roundsB;
  const bLead = roundsB > roundsA;

  // Build the scorebug HTML with all styles inline. No CSS class dependencies —
  // works even if external stylesheets somehow fail to apply. Layout is the
  // NFL-broadcast pattern: [team A pill] [team B pill] [round chip] [clock chip] [status chip].
  // Pill internals: colored band on left, team code, then score in monospace bold.

  const styles = {
    bug: [
      "display:flex","align-items:stretch","gap:0","font-family:'Inter','Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif",
      "user-select:none","pointer-events:none","box-shadow:0 6px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.55),0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.06)",
      "border-radius:0","overflow:hidden",
    ].join(";"),
    team: [
      "display:flex","align-items:center","gap:0","background:rgba(28,32,42,0.97)",
      "border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.6)","border-right:none","height:56px",
    ].join(";"),
    teamLast: "border-right:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.6)",  // appended for last team pill
    band: (color) => `width:5px;height:100%;background:${color}`,
    code: [
      "font-size:22px","font-weight:800","letter-spacing:1.5px","color:#f4f5f8",
      "padding:0 14px 0 12px","text-shadow:0 1px 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.6)",
      "display:flex","align-items:center","gap:6px",
    ].join(";"),
    rank: "font-size:11px;color:#9aa1ac;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:0.5px",
    score: (lead) => [
      "font-size:30px","font-weight:900",
      `color:${lead ? "#ffd54a" : "#d8dee8"}`,
      "padding:0 22px 0 4px","min-width:32px","text-align:center",
      "font-family:'Courier New','Roboto Mono',monospace",
      "text-shadow:0 2px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.7)",
    ].join(";"),
    chip: [
      "display:flex","align-items:center","justify-content:center",
      "background:#1a1d24","border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.6)","border-left:none",
      "color:#f4f5f8","font-weight:700","letter-spacing:0.5px","padding:0 14px","height:56px",
      "text-shadow:0 1px 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.6)",
    ].join(";"),
    period: "font-size:14px;min-width:50px",
    clock:  "font-size:18px;min-width:64px;font-family:'Courier New','Roboto Mono',monospace",
    season: "font-size:12px;min-width:42px;color:#7ce0ff;letter-spacing:1px",
    status: (cA, cB) => [
      "display:flex","align-items:center","justify-content:center",
      `background:linear-gradient(90deg,${cA} 0%,${cB} 100%)`,
      "border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.6)","border-left:none",
      "color:#fff","font-size:14px","font-weight:800","letter-spacing:1px",
      "padding:0 16px","height:56px","min-width:120px",
      "text-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.85)",
    ].join(";"),
  };

  scorebug.innerHTML =
    `<div style="${styles.team}">` +
      `<div style="${styles.band(colorA)}"></div>` +
      `<div style="${styles.code}">${codeA}${rankA ? `<span style="${styles.rank}">${rankA}</span>` : ""}</div>` +
      `<div style="${styles.score(aLead)}">${roundsA}</div>` +
    `</div>` +
    `<div style="${styles.team}">` +
      `<div style="${styles.band(colorB)}"></div>` +
      `<div style="${styles.code}">${codeB}${rankB ? `<span style="${styles.rank}">${rankB}</span>` : ""}</div>` +
      `<div style="${styles.score(bLead)}">${roundsB}</div>` +
    `</div>` +
    `<div style="${styles.chip};${styles.period}">${periodText}</div>` +
    `<div style="${styles.chip};${styles.clock}">${clockText}</div>` +
    `<div style="${styles.chip};${styles.season}">${seasonText}</div>` +
    `<div style="${styles.status(colorA, colorB)}">${statusText}</div>`;

  // v28.24: at this point we know we're in broadcast view (early-returned
  // otherwise). Apply the scorebug-level styles WITHOUT clobbering position
  // (the overlay's positioning is set in enterBroadcastView and must
  // survive the per-frame rebuild).
  scorebug.style.display = "flex";
  scorebug.style.alignItems = "stretch";
  scorebug.style.gap = "0";
  scorebug.style.fontFamily = "'Inter','Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif";
  scorebug.style.userSelect = "none";
  scorebug.style.pointerEvents = "none";
  scorebug.style.boxShadow = "0 6px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.55),0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.06)";
  scorebug.style.borderRadius = "0";
  scorebug.style.overflow = "hidden";
}
window.renderScorebug = renderScorebug;



function renderPhasePill() {
  if (typeof document === "undefined" || !document.getElementById) return;
  const phaseEl = document.getElementById("matchPhase");
  if (!phaseEl) return;
  const m = LEAGUE.match;
  const baseLabel = m
    ? ({"preRound":"Pre-round", "round":"LIVE", "betweenRounds":"INTERMISSION", "post":"POST"}[m.phase] || m.phase)
    : "Pre-match";
  phaseEl.textContent = baseLabel;

  // Big centered countdown overlay — drawn over the arena (NOT in the header
  // pill anymore). The overlay has its own DOM element that gets shown/hidden
  // and updated each frame.
  renderCountdownOverlay();
}

function renderCountdownOverlay() {
  if (typeof document === "undefined") return;
  // v28.23: in broadcast view, the canvas was re-parented into the
  // broadcast overlay div. The countdown overlay needs to live next to
  // the canvas (so it appears OVER the live arena pixels). Detect and
  // pick the right host container.
  const broadcastOverlay = (typeof window !== "undefined" && window._broadcastState && window._broadcastState.overlay)
    ? window._broadcastState.overlay
    : null;
  const arenaWrap = document.querySelector ? document.querySelector(".arena-wrap") : null;
  const host = broadcastOverlay || arenaWrap;
  if (!host) return;
  let overlay = document.getElementById("countdownOverlay");
  if (!overlay) {
    overlay = document.createElement("div");
    overlay.id = "countdownOverlay";
    overlay.className = "countdown-overlay";
    overlay.innerHTML = `
      <div class="countdown-inner">
        <div class="countdown-label" id="countdownLabel">Next Round</div>
        <div class="countdown-time" id="countdownTime">60</div>
        <div class="countdown-sub" id="countdownSub">Place bets &middot; visit the store</div>
      </div>`;
    host.appendChild(overlay);
  } else if (overlay.parentNode !== host) {
    // Re-parent if broadcast view turned on/off
    host.appendChild(overlay);
  }
  const canvasEl = document.getElementById("arena");
  if (typeof AUTOPLAY_PENDING !== "undefined" && AUTOPLAY_PENDING) {
    const ms = Math.max(0, AUTOPLAY_PENDING.remainingMs);
    const sec = Math.ceil(ms / 1000);
    const labelMap = { round: "Next Round", match: "Next Match", season: "Next Season" };
    document.getElementById("countdownLabel").textContent = labelMap[AUTOPLAY_PENDING.kind] || "Next";
    document.getElementById("countdownTime").textContent = (typeof AUTOPLAY !== "undefined" && !AUTOPLAY.enabled)
      ? "⏸"
      : sec;
    const subMap = {
      round:  "Place bets &middot; visit the store",
      match:  "Match break &middot; place bets &middot; check standings",
      season: "Off-season call-ups in progress &middot; new bracket forming",
    };
    document.getElementById("countdownSub").innerHTML = subMap[AUTOPLAY_PENDING.kind] || "";
    overlay.classList.add("visible");
    if (sec <= 5) overlay.classList.add("urgent");
    else overlay.classList.remove("urgent");
    if (canvasEl) canvasEl.classList.add("countdown-blur");
  } else {
    overlay.classList.remove("visible", "urgent");
    if (canvasEl) canvasEl.classList.remove("countdown-blur");
  }
}

function renderRoundStrip() {
  const stripEl = $("#roundStrip");
  if (!stripEl) return;
  const m = LEAGUE.match;
  if (!m) {
    stripEl.style.display = "none";
    return;
  }
  stripEl.style.display = "";
  const pipsEl = $("#roundPips");
  pipsEl.innerHTML = "";
  // Build pips for each round in best-of-N
  // Pip filled with team color if won by that team; current round pulses gold.
  for (let i = 1; i <= m.bestOf; i++) {
    const pip = document.createElement("div");
    pip.className = "pip";
    const round = m.rounds.find(r => r.index === i);
    if (round) {
      if (round.isDraw || round.winner === null) {
        pip.classList.add("draw");
        pip.style.backgroundColor = "var(--mute, #666)";
        pip.style.borderColor = "var(--mute, #666)";
      } else {
        pip.classList.add(round.winner === m.teamAId ? "won-a" : "won-b");
        const t = TEAM_BY_ID[round.winner];
        if (t) {
          pip.style.backgroundColor = t.color;
          pip.style.borderColor = t.color;
        }
      }
    }
    if (m.phase === "round" && i === m.currentRoundIndex) {
      pip.classList.add("current");
    }
    pipsEl.appendChild(pip);
  }
  $("#roundScore").textContent = `${m.roundsWonA}–${m.roundsWonB}`;
}

function renderFeed() {
  const el = $("#commentary");
  el.innerHTML = "";
  for (const item of FEED) {
    const div = document.createElement("div");
    div.className = "commentary-item " + item.kind;
    div.innerHTML = `<span class="ts">${item.ts}</span><span>${escapeHTML(item.msg)}</span>`;
    el.appendChild(div);
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   SPORTSCASTER COMMENTARY RENDER
   Renders the COMMENTARY[] queue (most-recent first) into the
   dedicated sportscaster panel. Recent entries get a "fresh"
   highlight that fades after a few seconds. The panel handles
   chant lines, openers, play-by-play and color separately so
   each style reads distinctly.
   ============================================================ */
function renderCommentary() {
  if (typeof document === "undefined" || !document.getElementById) return;
  const el = document.getElementById("sportscasterList");
  if (!el) return;
  if (typeof COMMENTARY === "undefined" || !COMMENTARY.length) {
    el.innerHTML = '<div class="cc-line" style="color:var(--mute);font-size:11px;font-style:italic;justify-content:center;"><span>Awaiting next match — sportscaster on standby.</span></div>';
    return;
  }
  const now = Date.now();
  el.innerHTML = COMMENTARY.slice(0, 18).map((c, idx) => {
    const ico = c.kind === "chant"   ? "📣"
              : c.kind === "opener"  ? "🎙️"
              : c.kind === "color"   ? "🎬"
              :                        "▶";
    const flavor = c.flavor ? "flavor-" + c.flavor : "";
    const fresh = idx === 0 ? "fresh" : "";
    const ai = c.isAi ? "is-ai" : "";
    return `<div class="cc-line ${c.kind} ${flavor} ${fresh} ${ai}">
      <span class="ts">${c.ts}</span>
      <span class="ico">${ico}</span>
      <span class="body">${c.line}</span>
    </div>`;
  }).join("");
}
window.renderCommentary = renderCommentary;

/* ============================================================
   BET RENDERING
   - renderBetSummaryRail: read-only summary of active bets in right rail
   - renderBetTab: full betting interface on the Bet tab
   ============================================================ */
function renderBetSummaryRail() {
  const el = $("#betsSummaryRail");
  if (!el) return;
  const countEl = $("#activeBetCountBadge");
  const tabBadge = $("#tabBetCount");
  const count = LEAGUE.bets.length;
  if (countEl) countEl.textContent = count;
  if (tabBadge) {
    tabBadge.textContent = count;
    tabBadge.style.display = count > 0 ? "" : "none";
  }
  el.innerHTML = "";
  if (!count) {
    const empty = document.createElement("div");
    empty.className = "empty";
    empty.textContent = "No active bets.";
    el.appendChild(empty);
  } else {
    for (const bet of LEAGUE.bets) {
      const div = document.createElement("div");
      div.className = "active-bet";
      const label = betLabelFor(bet);
      const tag = bet.kind === "round" ? `<span style="color:var(--blu);font-size:9px;">[round ${bet.roundIndex}]</span> ` : "";
      div.innerHTML = `${tag}<b>${bet.amount}</b> bits on ${label} @ ${bet.payoutMult}× → <b>${Math.round(bet.amount * bet.payoutMult)}</b>`;
      el.appendChild(div);
    }
  }
  const link = document.createElement("a");
  link.className = "place-link";
  link.dataset.goTab = "bet";
  link.textContent = (count ? "Manage / place more bets →" : "Place a bet →");
  link.addEventListener("click", (e) => { e.preventDefault(); switchTab("bet"); });
  el.appendChild(link);
}

function betLabelFor(bet) {
  if (bet.kind === "team" || bet.kind === "round") {
    const t = TEAM_BY_ID[bet.target];
    return t ? `${t.emoji} ${escapeHTML(t.short)}` : "?";
  }
  if (bet.kind === "player") {
    const p = Object.values(LEAGUE.rosters).flat().find(x => x.id === bet.target);
    return p ? escapeHTML(p.name) : "?";
  }
  if (bet.kind === "firstkill") {
    const t = TEAM_BY_ID[bet.target];
    return t ? `${t.emoji} ${escapeHTML(t.short)} 1st kill` : "?";
  }
  if (bet.kind === "totalcas") {
    return bet.target === "over" ? "5+ deaths" : "≤5 deaths";
  }
  if (bet.kind === "rounds") {
    return bet.target === "over" ? "4+ rounds" : "≤3 rounds";
  }
  return "?";
}

function renderBetTab() {
  const am = activeMatchTeams();
  const subEl = $("#betSubLine");
  if (!am) {
    subEl.textContent = "No match is set up. Bets unavailable.";
    $("#betMarketTeamRows").innerHTML = "";
    $("#betMarketRoundRows").innerHTML = "";
    $("#betMarketPlayerRows").innerHTML = "";
    if ($("#betMarketFirstKillRows")) $("#betMarketFirstKillRows").innerHTML = "";
    if ($("#betMarketTotalCasRows")) $("#betMarketTotalCasRows").innerHTML = "";
    if ($("#betMarketRoundsRows")) $("#betMarketRoundsRows").innerHTML = "";
    $("#betPagePlace").disabled = true;
    $("#betSelectionLabel").textContent = "Pick a market above";
    renderBetHistory();
    return;
  }
  const aId = am.teamA, bId = am.teamB;
  const m = LEAGUE.match;
  const phase = m?.phase || "preRound";

  // Sub-line states
  const matchInProgress = phase === "round" || phase === "betweenRounds";
  subEl.textContent = matchInProgress
    ? `Round ${m.currentRoundIndex} / ${m.bestOf} — ${TEAM_BY_ID[aId].short} ${m.roundsWonA}–${m.roundsWonB} ${TEAM_BY_ID[bId].short}.`
    : `Pre-match betting open for ${TEAM_BY_ID[aId].short} vs ${TEAM_BY_ID[bId].short}.`;

  const matchOver = phase === "post";
  const roundLocked = phase === "round"; // round bets locked while round is live
  $("#mwState").textContent = matchOver ? "CLOSED" : "OPEN";
  $("#rwState").textContent = roundLocked ? "LOCKED (round live)" : matchOver ? "CLOSED" : "OPEN";
  $("#lsState").textContent = matchOver ? "CLOSED" : "OPEN";

  // Match Winner market
  const teamRows = $("#betMarketTeamRows");
  teamRows.innerHTML = "";
  // === ROADMAP 2.5: Live odds during a match ===
  // If a match is in progress (between rounds OR mid-round), use live
  // odds that account for round score + remaining lives. Pre-match
  // (no match started yet, or match just finalized), fall back to
  // static teamOdds based on team strength only.
  const oddsAreLive = LEAGUE.match
    && (LEAGUE.match.phase === "round" || LEAGUE.match.phase === "betweenRounds")
    && LEAGUE.match.teamAId === aId && LEAGUE.match.teamBId === bId;
  const odds = oddsAreLive && typeof liveMatchOdds === "function"
    ? (liveMatchOdds(LEAGUE.match) || teamOdds(aId, bId))
    : teamOdds(aId, bId);
  for (const tid of [aId, bId]) {
    const t = TEAM_BY_ID[tid];
    const row = document.createElement("div");
    row.className = "bet-team-row" + (BET_PICK.kind === "team" && BET_PICK.target === tid ? " selected" : "");
    const liveTag = oddsAreLive
      ? `<span style="font-size:8px;color:var(--gold);background:rgba(247,201,72,0.15);padding:1px 4px;border-radius: 0;margin-left:6px;letter-spacing:0.5px;font-weight:700;">LIVE</span>`
      : "";
    row.innerHTML = `
      <div class="em">${t.emoji}</div>
      <div class="info">
        <div class="nm">${escapeHTML(t.name)}${liveTag}</div>
        <div class="od">Pays <b>${odds[tid]}×</b></div>
      </div>
      <div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--dim);font-family:'Courier New',monospace;">${LEAGUE.records[tid].wins}-${LEAGUE.records[tid].losses}</div>
    `;
    if (!matchOver) row.addEventListener("click", () => { BET_PICK = { kind: "team", target: tid }; refreshBetSelection(); });
    teamRows.appendChild(row);
  }

  // Round Winner market (same teams, slightly lower payout)
  const roundRows = $("#betMarketRoundRows");
  roundRows.innerHTML = "";
  for (const tid of [aId, bId]) {
    const t = TEAM_BY_ID[tid];
    const roundPay = +(odds[tid] * 0.85).toFixed(2);
    const row = document.createElement("div");
    row.className = "bet-team-row" + (BET_PICK.kind === "round" && BET_PICK.target === tid ? " selected" : "");
    row.innerHTML = `
      <div class="em">${t.emoji}</div>
      <div class="info">
        <div class="nm">Next: ${escapeHTML(t.short)}</div>
        <div class="od">Pays <b>${roundPay}×</b></div>
      </div>
    `;
    if (!matchOver && !roundLocked) row.addEventListener("click", () => { BET_PICK = { kind: "round", target: tid }; refreshBetSelection(); });
    if (matchOver || roundLocked) row.style.opacity = "0.5";
    roundRows.appendChild(row);
  }

  // Last Standing player market
  const pOdds = playerOdds(aId, bId);
  const playerRows = $("#betMarketPlayerRows");
  playerRows.innerHTML = "";
  for (const tid of [aId, bId]) {
    const players = (LEAGUE.rosters[tid] || []).filter(p => !p.deceased);
    for (const p of players) {
      const pos = POS_BY_ID[p.position];
      const row = document.createElement("div");
      row.className = "pbet-row" + (BET_PICK.kind === "player" && BET_PICK.target === p.id ? " selected" : "");
      const livesText = m && p.lives !== undefined ? ` · ${p.lives}♥` : "";
      row.innerHTML = `
        <span class="pos ${pos.cls}">${pos.icon}</span>
        <span class="nm">${TEAM_BY_ID[tid].emoji} ${escapeHTML(p.name)}<span style="color:var(--dim);font-size:10px;">${livesText}</span></span>
        <span class="od">${pOdds[p.id]}×</span>
      `;
      if (!matchOver) row.addEventListener("click", () => { BET_PICK = { kind: "player", target: p.id }; refreshBetSelection(); });
      playerRows.appendChild(row);
    }
  }

  // First Kill market — already-locked once first kill has occurred
  const firstKillTaken = !!(m && m.firstKillTeam);
  const fkStateEl = $("#fkState");
  if (fkStateEl) fkStateEl.textContent = matchOver ? "CLOSED" : (firstKillTaken ? "LOCKED (1st kill scored)" : "OPEN");
  const fkRows = $("#betMarketFirstKillRows");
  if (fkRows) {
    fkRows.innerHTML = "";
    for (const tid of [aId, bId]) {
      const t = TEAM_BY_ID[tid];
      const fkPay = +(odds[tid] * 0.95).toFixed(2);
      const row = document.createElement("div");
      row.className = "bet-team-row" + (BET_PICK.kind === "firstkill" && BET_PICK.target === tid ? " selected" : "");
      row.innerHTML = `
        <div class="em">${t.emoji}</div>
        <div class="info">
          <div class="nm">${escapeHTML(t.short)} draws first blood</div>
          <div class="od">Pays <b>${fkPay}×</b></div>
        </div>
      `;
      const locked = matchOver || firstKillTaken;
      if (!locked) row.addEventListener("click", () => { BET_PICK = { kind: "firstkill", target: tid }; refreshBetSelection(); });
      if (locked) row.style.opacity = "0.5";
      fkRows.appendChild(row);
    }
  }

  // Total Casualties (over/under 5.5)
  const tcStateEl = $("#tcState");
  if (tcStateEl) tcStateEl.textContent = matchOver ? "CLOSED" : "OPEN";
  const tcRows = $("#betMarketTotalCasRows");
  if (tcRows) {
    tcRows.innerHTML = "";
    for (const dir of ["over", "under"]) {
      const pay = 1.85;
      const row = document.createElement("div");
      row.className = "bet-team-row" + (BET_PICK.kind === "totalcas" && BET_PICK.target === dir ? " selected" : "");
      row.innerHTML = `
        <div class="em">${dir === "over" ? "📈" : "📉"}</div>
        <div class="info">
          <div class="nm">${dir === "over" ? "OVER" : "UNDER"} 5 deaths</div>
          <div class="od">Pays <b>${pay}×</b></div>
        </div>
      `;
      if (!matchOver) row.addEventListener("click", () => { BET_PICK = { kind: "totalcas", target: dir }; refreshBetSelection(); });
      else row.style.opacity = "0.5";
      tcRows.appendChild(row);
    }
  }

  // Rounds played (over/under 3.5)
  const rdStateEl = $("#rdState");
  if (rdStateEl) rdStateEl.textContent = matchOver ? "CLOSED" : "OPEN";
  const rdRows = $("#betMarketRoundsRows");
  if (rdRows) {
    rdRows.innerHTML = "";
    const opts = [
      { dir: "over",  ico: "📈", label: "OVER 3 rounds (long match)", pay: 2.10 },
      { dir: "under", ico: "📉", label: "UNDER 4 rounds (sweep)",     pay: 1.65 },
    ];
    for (const o of opts) {
      const row = document.createElement("div");
      row.className = "bet-team-row" + (BET_PICK.kind === "rounds" && BET_PICK.target === o.dir ? " selected" : "");
      row.innerHTML = `
        <div class="em">${o.ico}</div>
        <div class="info">
          <div class="nm">${o.label}</div>
          <div class="od">Pays <b>${o.pay}×</b></div>
        </div>
      `;
      if (!matchOver) row.addEventListener("click", () => { BET_PICK = { kind: "rounds", target: o.dir }; refreshBetSelection(); });
      else row.style.opacity = "0.5";
      rdRows.appendChild(row);
    }
  }

  refreshBetSelection();
  renderBetHistory();
}

function refreshBetSelection() {
  const labelEl = $("#betSelectionLabel");
  const placeBtn = $("#betPagePlace");
  // === v28.5: lock UI during live rounds ===
  // Mirror the placeBet backend lock so users see why the button is
  // disabled. Bets are accepted in preRound, betweenRounds, post, or
  // when no match exists yet.
  const m = LEAGUE.match;
  const liveRound = m && m.phase === "round";
  if (liveRound) {
    labelEl.innerHTML = '<span style="color:var(--warn,#f7c948);">🔒 Betting locked — round in progress</span>';
    placeBtn.disabled = true;
    placeBtn.textContent = "Locked During Round";
    return;
  }
  // Reset button text in case it was previously locked
  placeBtn.textContent = "Place Bet";
  if (!BET_PICK.kind) {
    labelEl.textContent = "Pick a market above";
    placeBtn.disabled = true;
    return;
  }
  if (BET_PICK.kind === "team") {
    const t = TEAM_BY_ID[BET_PICK.target];
    labelEl.innerHTML = `Match Winner: ${t.emoji} ${escapeHTML(t.name)}`;
  } else if (BET_PICK.kind === "round") {
    const t = TEAM_BY_ID[BET_PICK.target];
    labelEl.innerHTML = `Round Winner: ${t.emoji} ${escapeHTML(t.name)}`;
  } else if (BET_PICK.kind === "firstkill") {
    const t = TEAM_BY_ID[BET_PICK.target];
    labelEl.innerHTML = `First Kill: ${t.emoji} ${escapeHTML(t.short)}`;
  } else if (BET_PICK.kind === "totalcas") {
    labelEl.innerHTML = `Casualties: ${BET_PICK.target.toUpperCase()} 5 deaths`;
  } else if (BET_PICK.kind === "rounds") {
    labelEl.innerHTML = `Rounds: ${BET_PICK.target === "over" ? "OVER 3" : "UNDER 4"} rounds`;
  } else if (BET_PICK.kind === "player") {
    const p = Object.values(LEAGUE.rosters).flat().find(x => x.id === BET_PICK.target);
    labelEl.innerHTML = `Last Standing: ${escapeHTML(p?.name || "?")}`;
  }
  placeBtn.disabled = false;
}

function renderBetHistory() {
  const body = $("#betHistoryBody");
  body.innerHTML = "";
  if (!LEAGUE.bets.length) {
    body.innerHTML = `<tr><td colspan="6" style="text-align:center;color:var(--dim);padding:14px;">No active bets. Place one above.</td></tr>`;
    return;
  }
  for (const bet of LEAGUE.bets) {
    const tr = document.createElement("tr");
    const market = bet.kind === "team" ? "Match Winner" : bet.kind === "round" ? `Round ${bet.roundIndex || "?"} Winner` : "Last Standing";
    tr.innerHTML = `
      <td>${bet.kind === "round" ? "Round " + (bet.roundIndex || "?") : "Match"}</td>
      <td>${market}</td>
      <td>${betLabelFor(bet)}</td>
      <td style="text-align:right;font-family:'Courier New',monospace;">${bet.amount}</td>
      <td style="text-align:right;font-family:'Courier New',monospace;">${bet.payoutMult}×</td>
      <td style="text-align:right;font-family:'Courier New',monospace;color:var(--gold);">${Math.round(bet.amount * bet.payoutMult)}</td>
    `;
    body.appendChild(tr);
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   STORE RENDERING — full grid on the Store tab
   ============================================================ */
function renderStore() {
  const grid = $("#storeGrid");
  if (!grid) return;
  grid.innerHTML = "";
  const am = activeMatchTeams();
  const roundLive = LEAGUE.match && LEAGUE.match.phase === "round";

  // Group items by rarity for sectioned display
  const byRarity = { common: [], rare: [], legendary: [] };
  for (const item of SHOP_ITEMS) {
    (byRarity[item.rarity || "common"] || byRarity.common).push(item);
  }
  const sections = [
    { key: "common", label: "COMMON", color: "var(--ink)" },
    { key: "rare", label: "RARE",   color: "var(--pur)" },
    { key: "legendary", label: "LEGENDARY", color: "var(--gold)" },
  ];

  for (const sec of sections) {
    if (!byRarity[sec.key].length) continue;
    const header = document.createElement("div");
    header.className = "store-rarity-header";
    header.innerHTML = `<span style="color:${sec.color};">●</span> <span>${sec.label}</span>`;
    grid.appendChild(header);

    for (const item of byRarity[sec.key]) {
      const btn = document.createElement("button");
      btn.className = "store-card rarity-" + (item.rarity || "common");
      btn.disabled = LEAGUE.bits < item.cost || roundLive || !am;
      if (btn.disabled) btn.setAttribute("aria-disabled", "true");
      const targetTag = item.target === "opp"
        ? `<div class="store-target-tag">debuff opponent</div>`
        : item.target === "specific_player"
        ? `<div class="store-target-tag store-target-targeted">pick one knight</div>`
        : `<div class="store-target-tag store-target-buff">buff your team</div>`;
      btn.innerHTML = `
        <div class="ico">${item.ico}</div>
        <div class="nm">${escapeHTML(item.nm)}</div>
        ${targetTag}
        <div class="cost">${item.cost} bits</div>
        <div class="desc">${escapeHTML(item.desc)}</div>
      `;
      btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
        if (!am) return;
        if (item.target === "specific_player") {
          // Open knight-picker modal — caller chooses which opponent to sandbag
          if (typeof openSandbagPicker === "function") openSandbagPicker(item, am);
          return;
        }
        const ok = buyItem(item.id, am.teamA);
        if (ok) renderAll();
      });
      grid.appendChild(btn);
    }
  }
}

function renderAll() {
  renderHeader();
  renderTeamPanel("A");
  renderTeamPanel("B");
  renderBracketStrip();
  // v28.28: render the dedicated Ladder tab's full bracket display.
  // Replaces the cramped, vertically-stacking bracket-strip on Game tab.
  if (typeof renderLadder === "function") renderLadder();
  renderRoundStrip();
  renderStandings();
  renderArenaHeader();
  if (typeof renderScorebug === "function") renderScorebug();
  renderFeed();
  renderCommentary();
  renderBetSummaryRail();
  renderBetTab();
  renderStore();
  renderTicker();
}

function renderTicker() {
  if (typeof document === "undefined" || !document.getElementById) return;
  const scoresEl = document.getElementById("tickerScores");
  const contentEl = document.getElementById("tickerContent");
  if (!scoresEl || !contentEl) return;

  // ---- LIVE SCORE PANEL ----
  // Show: current match score + each pending bracket-slot score
  const m = LEAGUE.match;
  let scoresHTML = "";
  if (m && m.teamAId) {
    const ta = TEAM_BY_ID[m.teamAId], tb = TEAM_BY_ID[m.teamBId];
    const liveBadge = m.phase === "round" ? `<span class="live">●LIVE</span>` : "";
    scoresHTML += `
      <div class="ticker-score-pill">${liveBadge}
        <span class="em">${ta.emoji}</span>
        <span style="color:${ta.color};">${ta.short}</span>
        <span style="color:var(--ink);">${m.roundsWonA}</span>
        <span style="color:var(--dim);">–</span>
        <span style="color:var(--ink);">${m.roundsWonB}</span>
        <span style="color:${tb.color};">${tb.short}</span>
        <span class="em">${tb.emoji}</span>
      </div>`;
  }
  // Recent completed matches this season
  if (LEAGUE.matchHistory && LEAGUE.matchHistory.length) {
    const thisSeason = LEAGUE.matchHistory.filter(mh => mh.season === LEAGUE.season).slice(-3);
    for (const mh of thisSeason) {
      const ta = TEAM_BY_ID[mh.teamA], tb = TEAM_BY_ID[mh.teamB];
      const w = TEAM_BY_ID[mh.winner];
      if (!ta || !tb || !w) continue;
      scoresHTML += `
        <div class="ticker-score-pill" style="opacity:0.7;">
          <span class="em">${ta.emoji}</span>
          <span>${ta.short}</span>
          <span style="color:var(--dim);">${mh.score}</span>
          <span>${tb.short}</span>
          <span class="em">${tb.emoji}</span>
        </div>`;
    }
  }
  if (!scoresHTML) {
    scoresHTML = `<div class="ticker-score-pill"><span style="color:var(--dim);">SEASON ${LEAGUE.season} · NO MATCH LIVE</span></div>`;
  }
  scoresEl.innerHTML = scoresHTML;

  // ---- ROLLING COMMENTARY TRACK ----
  // Pull last ~30 feed entries and render them as a single horizontal stream.
  // Adds champion announcement, lost-item callouts, top streaks for color.
  const items = [];
  // Champion of last season
  if (LEAGUE.history.length) {
    const last = LEAGUE.history[LEAGUE.history.length - 1];
    const c = TEAM_BY_ID[last.champion];
    if (c) items.push(`<span class="item season">🏆 S${last.season} CHAMPION: ${c.emoji} ${c.short}</span>`);
  }
  // Top streaks across the league
  const allKnights = [];
  for (const tid in LEAGUE.rosters) {
    for (const p of LEAGUE.rosters[tid]) {
      if (!p.deceased && (p.career.currentStreak || 0) >= 3) allKnights.push(p);
    }
  }
  allKnights.sort((a, b) => (b.career.currentStreak || 0) - (a.career.currentStreak || 0));
  for (const k of allKnights.slice(0, 3)) {
    const t = TEAM_BY_ID[k.teamId];
    items.push(`<span class="item kill">🔥 ${t.emoji} ${escapeHTML(k.name)} on a ${k.career.currentStreak}-kill streak</span>`);
  }
  // Lost legendary items
  if (LEAGUE.lostItems && LEAGUE.lostItems.length) {
    const recent = LEAGUE.lostItems.slice(-3);
    for (const li of recent) {
      items.push(`<span class="item item-feed">📉 ${li.ico || "·"} ${escapeHTML(li.name)} lost (${li.scavengedCount}× scavenged)</span>`);
    }
  }
  // Recent feed entries
  if (typeof FEED !== "undefined" && FEED.length) {
    const recentFeed = FEED.slice(-12);
    for (const f of recentFeed) {
      const txt = (f.text || "").replace(/[\r\n]/g, " ");
      const cls = f.type === "kill" ? "kill" : f.type === "item" ? "item-feed" : f.type === "match" ? "match" : f.type === "season" ? "season" : "";
      items.push(`<span class="item ${cls}">${escapeHTML(txt)}</span>`);
    }
  }
  // Standings teaser
  const sortedTeams = TEAMS.slice().sort((a, b) => {
    const ra = LEAGUE.records[a.id], rb = LEAGUE.records[b.id];
    if (rb.championships !== ra.championships) return rb.championships - ra.championships;
    return rb.wins - ra.wins;
  }).slice(0, 3);
  for (const t of sortedTeams) {
    const r = LEAGUE.records[t.id];
    items.push(`<span class="item">${t.emoji} ${t.short} ${r.wins}–${r.losses}${r.draws ? `–${r.draws}` : ""}</span>`);
  }

  // Repeat content twice so the marquee loop has continuous feel
  const html = items.join('<span class="sep">●</span>');
  contentEl.innerHTML = html + '<span class="sep">●</span>' + html + '<span class="sep">●</span>';
}

/* ============================================================
   UTILS
   ============================================================ */
function escapeHTML(s) {
  return String(s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({
    "&":"&amp;", "<":"&lt;", ">":"&gt;", '"':"&quot;", "'":"&#39;"
  }[c]));
}

let BET_PICK = { kind: null, target: null };

/* ============================================================
   BIOME PREVIEW — render a single biome to a thumbnail canvas.

   The Lore tab's Stadiums section needs a small live preview of
   each of the 33 biomes. Strategy:
   1. Render the biome at full arena dimensions (1280×720) on an
      offscreen canvas, using the same drawBiomeScatter and
      drawCourtMarkings routines the main render uses. To do this
      without rewriting those routines, we temporarily redirect
      the global `ctx` to the offscreen canvas, draw, then restore.
   2. drawImage the offscreen canvas onto the small display canvas
      with high-quality downsampling. This preserves visual fidelity
      (sprites would be unreadable if we drew directly at thumbnail
      scale because stroke widths would round to sub-pixel sizes).
   3. Use a local PRNG for scatter generation so we don't consume
      values from BIOME_RNG (which would perturb the live sim).

   Each biome's preview is deterministic — same biome id always
   produces the same scatter layout — by seeding the local PRNG
   from a hash of the biome id.
   ============================================================ */

// Local mulberry32 — independent from the sim's BIOME_RNG so previews
// don't consume randomness from the live simulation.
function _previewRng(seed) {
  let a = seed >>> 0;
  return function next() {
    a = (a + 0x6D2B79F5) >>> 0;
    let t = a;
    t = Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 15), t | 1);
    t ^= t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), t | 61);
    return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
  };
}

// Hash a biome id to a 32-bit seed for reproducible previews
function _biomeIdHash(id) {
  let h = 0x9E3779B9;
  for (let i = 0; i < id.length; i++) {
    h = ((h ^ id.charCodeAt(i)) * 0x01000193) >>> 0;
  }
  return h;
}

// Generate scatter sprites for a biome at full arena dimensions, using a
// local PRNG. Coordinates match what drawBiomeScatter expects.
function _generatePreviewScatter(biome, W, H) {
  const out = [];
  const rng = _previewRng(_biomeIdHash(biome.id));
  const KEEP = 75; // power-core keep-out radius
  const cx = W / 2, cy = H / 2;
  for (const type in biome.scatter) {
    const cfg = biome.scatter[type];
    let placed = 0, tries = 0;
    while (placed < cfg.count && tries < cfg.count * 4) {
      tries++;
      const x = rng() * W;
      const y = rng() * H;
      // Power-core keep-out — match the live sim's keep-out radius
      const dx = x - cx, dy = y - cy;
      if (dx*dx + dy*dy < KEEP*KEEP) continue;
      out.push({
        type, x, y,
        rot: rng() * Math.PI * 2,
        r: rng() * 1.5,
        c1: cfg.color1, c2: cfg.color2,
      });
      placed++;
    }
  }
  return out;
}

// Render a biome to a small display canvas. Uses a hidden offscreen
// canvas at full arena resolution, then drawImage's it down. This
// reuses drawBiomeScatter and drawCourtMarkings unchanged — we just
// temporarily redirect the global ctx.
const _biomePreviewOffscreen = (typeof document !== "undefined")
  ? document.createElement("canvas") : null;
if (_biomePreviewOffscreen) {
  _biomePreviewOffscreen.width = 1280;
  _biomePreviewOffscreen.height = 720;
}

function drawBiomePreview(displayCanvas, biome) {
  if (!displayCanvas || !biome || !_biomePreviewOffscreen) return;
  // Verify the offscreen canvas has a real 2D context with the methods we
  // need. In some test environments (e.g. node smoke harness) document
  // exists but createElement returns a mock without a working getContext.
  const offCtx = (typeof _biomePreviewOffscreen.getContext === "function")
    ? _biomePreviewOffscreen.getContext("2d") : null;
  if (!offCtx || typeof offCtx.createLinearGradient !== "function") return;
  // Same defensive check on the display canvas
  const dctx = (typeof displayCanvas.getContext === "function")
    ? displayCanvas.getContext("2d") : null;
  if (!dctx || typeof dctx.drawImage !== "function") return;

  const W = _biomePreviewOffscreen.width, H = _biomePreviewOffscreen.height;

  // Save the live ctx, redirect to offscreen
  const saved = ctx;
  ctx = offCtx;

  try {
    // Floor gradient — top→bottom
    const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
    grad.addColorStop(0, biome.floorTop);
    grad.addColorStop(1, biome.floorBot);
    ctx.fillStyle = grad;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // Mowing stripes (subtle alternating bands)
    const stripeCount = 12;
    const stripeH = H / stripeCount;
    ctx.fillStyle = biome.stripeHue;
    for (let i = 0; i < stripeCount; i += 2) {
      ctx.fillRect(0, i * stripeH, W, stripeH);
    }

    // Court markings or generic field grid
    const lineColor = biome.accents.lineColor;
    const brandColor = biome.accents.brandColor;
    if (biome.courtType) {
      drawCourtMarkings(W, H, biome.courtType, lineColor);
    } else {
      // Light grid + center vertical line + center circle (not the full
      // arena treatment, but visually consistent enough for thumbnails)
      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.04)";
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      for (let i = 0; i < W; i += 60) {
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(i, 0); ctx.lineTo(i, H); ctx.stroke();
      }
      for (let i = 0; i < H; i += 60) {
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, i); ctx.lineTo(W, i); ctx.stroke();
      }
      ctx.strokeStyle = lineColor;
      ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(W/2, 0); ctx.lineTo(W/2, H); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(W/2, H/2, 70, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
    }

    // Scatter (full sprite library — drawBiomeScatter handles all 29 types)
    const scatter = _generatePreviewScatter(biome, W, H);
    drawBiomeScatter(scatter);

    // Vignette / sky tint to give the preview some depth
    const vg = ctx.createRadialGradient(W/2, H/2, Math.min(W,H) * 0.4, W/2, H/2, Math.max(W,H) * 0.7);
    vg.addColorStop(0, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");
    vg.addColorStop(1, biome.skyTint);
    ctx.fillStyle = vg;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  } finally {
    // Always restore the live ctx, even if drawing threw
    ctx = saved;
  }

  // Now downsample to the display canvas (dctx was hoisted above)
  dctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = true;
  dctx.imageSmoothingQuality = "high";
  dctx.clearRect(0, 0, displayCanvas.width, displayCanvas.height);
  dctx.drawImage(_biomePreviewOffscreen, 0, 0, displayCanvas.width, displayCanvas.height);
}
window.drawBiomePreview = drawBiomePreview;

</script>

<!-- ============================================================
     UI — Part B
     Event handlers, modals, cloud sync, main loop, bootstrap
     ============================================================ -->
<script>
'use strict';

/* ============================================================
   SPORTSCASTER — AI ENHANCEMENT VIA ai-text-plugin
   When the plugin is present (imported in perchance-top.txt as
   `aiTextPlugin = {import:ai-text-plugin}`), live commentary
   lines fire FIRST from the static phrase pools so the user
   never waits, then we fire-and-forget an AI generation that
   may swap in a more dynamic line if it returns in time.

   Architecture:
   - Static line shows immediately on commentate() call
   - If aiTextPlugin is callable, we issue a request with the
     event context as a prompt, and on success replace the
     entry's `line` field + re-render.
   - We rate-limit (no more than 1 AI request per 1500ms) so
     bursty events don't hammer the plugin.
   - We cache by prompt-hash so repeated identical events
     (e.g. multiple first-kills across seasons) don't re-prompt.
   ============================================================ */
const AI_CACHE = new Map();
let AI_LAST_FIRE_AT = 0;
const AI_RATE_LIMIT_MS = 1500;

function _aiPromptFor(ctx) {
  // Build a tight, controlled prompt. We want short outputs (< 18 words).
  if (!ctx || !ctx.type) return null;
  if (ctx.type === "matchOpen") {
    return `You are a sportscaster for "Float Knights" — a cute mascot tournament where animals in armor fight with futuristic weapons. Write ONE excited 12-word opener for ${ctx.teamA.name} versus ${ctx.teamB.name}. No quotes. Punchy. Sportscaster voice.`;
  }
  if (ctx.type === "firstKill") {
    return `Sportscaster voice. ${ctx.attacker.name} from team ${ctx.attacker.teamId.toUpperCase()} just scored the FIRST KILL of the match against ${ctx.defender.name}. Write ONE line, under 14 words, hyped, no quotes.`;
  }
  if (ctx.type === "lastKnight") {
    return `Sportscaster voice. ${ctx.knight.name} is the LAST knight standing for team ${ctx.team.short}, against a full enemy team. ONE line, under 14 words, dramatic, no quotes.`;
  }
  if (ctx.type === "matchEnd") {
    const margin = Math.abs(ctx.score[0] - ctx.score[1]);
    const tone = margin >= 3 ? "dominant" : "close";
    return `Sportscaster voice. ${ctx.winner.name} just beat ${ctx.loser.name} ${ctx.score[0]}-${ctx.score[1]} (${tone} win). ONE line, under 14 words, no quotes.`;
  }
  return null;
}

// Override the no-op stub from the sim layer with the real implementation
// that uses the ai-text-plugin if it's been imported at the perchance-top.
function requestAiCommentaryEnhancement(entry, ctx) {
  if (typeof aiTextPlugin === "undefined") return;
  if (typeof aiTextPlugin !== "object" && typeof aiTextPlugin !== "function") return;
  const now = Date.now();
  if (now - AI_LAST_FIRE_AT < AI_RATE_LIMIT_MS) return;
  AI_LAST_FIRE_AT = now;

  const prompt = _aiPromptFor(ctx);
  if (!prompt) return;

  // Cache hit — use immediately
  const cacheKey = ctx.type + "::" + (ctx.attacker?.name || ctx.knight?.name || ctx.winner?.name || "x");
  if (AI_CACHE.has(cacheKey)) {
    entry.line = AI_CACHE.get(cacheKey);
    entry.isAi = true;
    if (typeof renderCommentary === "function") renderCommentary();
    return;
  }

  // Fire-and-forget. The plugin's actual API: aiTextPlugin.getResponse(prompt)
  // returns a Promise<string> (per Perchance docs). Some versions are
  // callable directly. Be defensive.
  let req;
  try {
    if (typeof aiTextPlugin === "function") {
      req = aiTextPlugin(prompt);
    } else if (typeof aiTextPlugin.getResponse === "function") {
      req = aiTextPlugin.getResponse(prompt);
    } else if (typeof aiTextPlugin.generate === "function") {
      req = aiTextPlugin.generate({ instruction: prompt });
    } else {
      return;
    }
  } catch (e) { return; }

  if (!req || typeof req.then !== "function") return;

  req.then(out => {
    if (!out) return;
    let text = typeof out === "string" ? out : (out.text || out.output || out.response || null);
    if (!text) return;
    text = String(text).trim().replace(/^["']|["']$/g, "");
    if (text.length > 200) text = text.slice(0, 200);
    if (!text) return;
    AI_CACHE.set(cacheKey, text);
    entry.line = text;
    entry.isAi = true;
    if (typeof renderCommentary === "function") renderCommentary();
  }).catch(() => { /* swallow; static line stays */ });
}

/* ============================================================

let MODAL_AFTER_CLOSE = null;

function openModal(title, bodyHTML, footerHTML, onCloseCallback) {
  $("#modalTitle").textContent = title;
  $("#modalBody").innerHTML = bodyHTML;
  $("#modalFooter").innerHTML = footerHTML || "";
  $("#modalBack").classList.add("show");
  MODAL_AFTER_CLOSE = onCloseCallback || null;
}
function closeModal() {
  $("#modalBack").classList.remove("show");
  const cb = MODAL_AFTER_CLOSE;
  MODAL_AFTER_CLOSE = null;
  if (cb) cb();
}

$("#modalClose").addEventListener("click", closeModal);
$("#modalBack").addEventListener("click", (e) => {
  if (e.target.id === "modalBack") closeModal();
});

/* ============================================================
   INTERMISSION OVERLAY (after each match)
   ============================================================ */
/* ============================================================
   ROUND INTERMISSION — non-blocking
   Posts a summary to the commentary feed, fires toast notifications,
   and schedules an auto-advance countdown. User can manually skip
   via the countdown pill in the arena header.
   ============================================================ */
function showRoundIntermission() {
  const m = LEAGUE.match;
  if (!m) return;
  const lastRound = m.rounds[m.rounds.length - 1];
  if (!lastRound) return;
  const winner = TEAM_BY_ID[lastRound.winner];

  // Summary in feed
  feed("match", `📊 Match score after R${m.currentRoundIndex}: ${TEAM_BY_ID[m.teamAId].short} ${m.roundsWonA}–${m.roundsWonB} ${TEAM_BY_ID[m.teamBId].short}.`);

  // Permanent casualties this round → individual toasts
  const thisRoundCasualties = LEAGUE.graveyard
    .filter(g => g.season === LEAGUE.season && g.slot === m.slot && g.round === m.currentRoundIndex);
  for (const c of thisRoundCasualties) {
    toast(`☠️ <b>${escapeHTML(c.name)}</b> (${TEAM_BY_ID[c.teamId].short}) ran out of lives. Slain by ${escapeHTML(c.killer)}.`, "lose", { ico: "☠️", ttl: 8000 });
  }

  // === v28.5: refresh UI at intermission start ===
  // This unlocks the bet button (round phase ended → betweenRounds),
  // refreshes the odds rail with post-round live odds, and updates
  // the bet history readout. Without this the UI stays in "round live"
  // state until the next round begins.
  if (typeof renderAll === "function") renderAll();

  // Schedule next round (auto-advances after 60s if AUTOPLAY enabled)
  scheduleAutoAdvance("round", () => {
    continueAfterRound();
    renderAll();
  });
}

/* ============================================================
   MATCH INTERMISSION — non-blocking
   ============================================================ */
function showIntermission() {
  const m = LEAGUE.match;
  if (!m) return;
  const winner = TEAM_BY_ID[m.winnerId];
  const isFinal = m.slot === "final";
  // Generalized slot label — handles 4-team (semi/final), 8-team (qf/sf/final),
  // and 12-team (qualifier/qf/sf/final) brackets without crashing on unknowns.
  const slotLabels = {
    "qual1": "Qualifier 1", "qual2": "Qualifier 2", "qual3": "Qualifier 3", "qual4": "Qualifier 4",
    "qf1": "Quarterfinal 1", "qf2": "Quarterfinal 2", "qf3": "Quarterfinal 3", "qf4": "Quarterfinal 4",
    "sf1": "Semifinal 1", "sf2": "Semifinal 2",
    "semi1": "Semifinal 1", "semi2": "Semifinal 2",
    "final": "Final",
  };
  const matchLabel = slotLabels[m.slot] || (m.slot ? m.slot.toUpperCase() : "Match");

  if (winner) {
    // Match-end toast: green if user won bets on this team
    toast(`🏆 ${winner.emoji} <b>${escapeHTML(winner.name)}</b> win ${matchLabel} ${m.roundsWonA}–${m.roundsWonB}.`, "info", { ico: "🏆", ttl: 8000 });
  } else {
    // Draw — no winner, but match still finalized (advancement was coin-flipped).
    const ta = TEAM_BY_ID[m.teamAId], tb = TEAM_BY_ID[m.teamBId];
    const taTxt = ta ? `${ta.emoji} ${escapeHTML(ta.short)}` : "?";
